title: Associate Security Engineer - 11925
description: Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins. Why join Coupa? Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend. Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence. Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other. Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa. The Impact of an Associate Security Engineer at Coupa: Coupa's Security Engineers keep our enterprise, product, platform, and customer data safe. As an Associate Security Engineer, you'll build your foundation in cloud, application, and infrastructure security by contributing to real, well-scoped engineering work alongside experienced teammates. You'll partner with Engineering, IT, and Compliance, learn how we build durable, automated security tooling instead of one-off fixes, and grow your root-cause analysis skills with mentorship and regular feedback. This is a role for someone early in their security career who wants hands-on ownership of growing scope — with the support to get there. What You'll Do: Support the design and implementation of multi-cloud security controls — VPC segmentation, security groups/NACLs, and least-privilege IAM policies — on well-scoped tasks, with guidance from senior engineers. Build familiarity with permission boundaries and Organizations/SCPs along the way. Contribute to policy as code and IaC security guardrails in CI/CD pipelines: write and tune rules, reduce false positives, and help keep pre-merge and pre-deploy checks reliable. Assist in hardening containerized workloads and Kubernetes clusters, including image scanning, admission control, pod security standards, and network policies. Triage vulnerability findings from application packages, container images, and third-party dependencies. Gather context on exploitability and business impact, and escalate complex or ambiguous findings to senior teammates. Help the Risk & Compliance team gather technical evidence for audit frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP), and learn what auditable evidence looks like. Write and maintain scripts and small automations that make security work faster and more repeatable. Learn from mentors through pairing, design reviews, and feedback on your remediation plans. Document what you learn and help improve runbooks. Support the secure design, deployment, and operational monitoring of enterprise AI systems, models, and agentic workflows. Help design and develop internal AI-driven security tools, automation scripts, and guardrails to improve threat detection and vulnerability remediation. What You Will Bring to Coupa: 0–2 years of experience in security, cloud, DevOps, IT, or software engineering. Internships, co-ops, research, and hands-on personal or lab projects count. Foundational knowledge of cloud security concepts (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — IAM, networking, and common misconfigurations — gained through work, coursework, labs, or certifications. Working scripting skills in Python, Bash, or JavaScript, and interest in building or extending internal security tooling. Familiarity with vulnerability scanning concepts (dependency and container scanning). Exposure to CI/CD pipelines is a plus. Basic awareness of common compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP) and a willingness to learn how they translate into technical controls. Curiosity and a habit of asking why — you want to understand the cause of a vulnerability, not just what the scanner reported. Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort asking questions, asking for help, and escalating early. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamps, military, self-directed learning, or similar). Entry-level certifications are a plus: Security+, ISC2 CC, AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS/GCP/Azure security certifications. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive: Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally) Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together . Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month . Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about . Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents . Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel . Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles . Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process. Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees. Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description: About the team / Role In today's software development landscape, collaboration, E2E accountability, problem solving and streamlined workflows are key to achieving efficiency and delivering high-quality solutions that solve customer problems and generate business outcomes. We believe in the power of integrated engineering, where development, quality, and agility skills blend together throughout the solution delivery pipeline. In this role, you'll be a champion for this approach, fostering a culture of shared ownership and breaking down silos to ensure a smooth and efficient flow of innovation to customers. How you'll make an impact Collaborate with stakeholders throughout the SDLC to translate requirements into high-quality, reliable, cost-effective, and maintainable solutions that solve customer problems and generate business outcomes. Design, develop, and implement high quality software components with a focus on Continuous Delivery principles and practices. Champion integrated engineering practices within the organization, fostering collaboration and shared ownership between development, operations, and security teams. Deliver technical and administrative support for live applications, promoting automation and proactive monitoring and self-recoverability, rapid incident response, and continuous improvement. Analyze existing systems and processes to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvements to flow. Full-Stack / Backend Development:Design, develop, test, and deploy clean, maintainable, and efficient code using Java and JavaScript . Database Management : Write optimized queries, design data schemas, and manage both relational ( MySQL , Oracle ) and NoSQL database integrations. Component Design : Apply Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS) principles and design patterns to translate functional requirements into scalable technical modules. Algorithm & Data Structure Application : Select and implement optimal data structures and algorithms to solve performance bottlenecks and ensure low-latency system behavior. Collaboration & Code Reviews: Actively participate in peer code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions to lift code quality and team standards. SystemQuality & Reliability: Write unit, integration, and functional tests to maintain high code coverage and minimize production defects. Core Skills: Programming/Software Development: This skill remains the foundation. Proficiency in programming languages and development methodologies is essential for designing, developing, and implementing software components in an integrated engineering environment. A strong focus on continuous delivery practices is crucial. Testing Quality assurance is paramount. The ability to design, execute, and analyze various types of tests to ensure deployments meet established acceptance criteria remains essential. Requirements Management : Understanding requirements throughout the software delivery lifecycle is critical. This ensures alignment with business needs, avoids rework, and fosters collaboration with stakeholders. Software Design: While automation might play a larger role in integrated engineering, a combined understanding of software development practices and design principles is still valuable. This ensures creating maintainable, scalable, and secure applications. Measurement: Data-driven decision making is crucial. The ability to define and establish measurement frameworks, along with KPIs related to software delivery and performance, helps identify areas for improvement. Additional Valuable Skills: Configuration Management: Managing configurations with IaC tools is essential for consistent and repeatable deployments. However, the specific emphasis on configuration management might be slightly lower since integrated engineering often emphasizes infrastructure automation. Application Support : While IT Service Support (SERV) covers some aspects of application support, this skill can be relevant if the role has a stronger focus on troubleshooting and supporting specific applications. Systems Integration: While integration activities might be streamlined, understanding system integration principles can be valuable, especially if the role involves integrating various software components. Release and Deployment Management: Effectively managing software releases and deployments is crucial. However, in an integrated engineering environment, automation tools and streamlined processes might reduce the manual effort involved compared to traditional release cycles. Methods and Tools : The right tools automate tasks, improve decision-making, and ensure consistent practices. This is crucial for efficiency, data-driven development, and staying current in a rapidly evolving field. Experience you will bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Minimum of 2 years of experience in software engineering and delivery. Strong understanding of continuous delivery principles and practices. Exposure to Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines. Proficiency in multiple programming languages and technologies (Java, JavaScript, Python). Familiarity with Java frameworks such as Spring Boot or Hibernate. Thorough understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS) concepts (Abstraction, Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism). Strong foundation in Data Structures & Algorithms (Arrays, Linked Lists, Trees, Graphs, Hashing, Sorting/Searching). Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Junior Software Engineer
description: About the Job The Opportunity As a Junior Software Engineer at Emetlab , you will contribute to building the technology infrastructure behind elite AI training data that powers frontier models worldwide. Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company delivering expert-produced, rigorously validated datasets and end-to-end AI solutions to laboratories, Fortune 500 enterprises, ambitious startups, and sovereign AI programmes across the globe. In this role, you will work alongside senior engineers to develop, test, and ship features across our data platform, contributor tools, and client-facing systems. You will gain hands-on experience with large-scale data pipelines, quality assurance automation, and the infrastructure that enables over 5,000 domain experts across 120+ countries to produce world-class training data. You will be trusted with meaningful work from day one, not sidelined with tasks that don't matter. This is a rare opportunity to begin your engineering career at the intersection of AI and data infrastructure, where your contributions will be visible, valued, and directly tied to the quality of datasets that train the next generation of intelligent systems. What You'll Do Write clean, well-tested code that contributes to Emetlab 's core platform, data pipelines, and internal tooling. Collaborate with senior engineers on the design and implementation of new features across our contributor platform, quality assurance systems, and client delivery infrastructure. Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving feedback that elevates the quality of the entire team's work. Assist in debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving issues across the platform with attention to detail and persistence. Contribute to building and improving automation that supports our multi-stage quality assurance processes and 98%+ accuracy benchmarks. Learn and grow rapidly by engaging with modern tools, frameworks, and AI-adjacent technologies in a production environment. What You'll Need to Succeed A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience through bootcamps, self-directed learning, or personal projects. Foundational knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript. Familiarity with web development fundamentals including APIs, databases, and version control with Git. A genuine desire to learn, improve, and take ownership of your growth as an engineer. Strong communication skills and a collaborative disposition, comfortable working within a team and asking thoughtful questions. Genuine interest in AI, data systems, or machine learning infrastructure is highly valued. Role Details Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Growth stage, operational About Emetlab Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company built on a single conviction: the quality ceiling of any AI system is determined by its training data, not its architecture or compute. We produce expert-crafted, rigorously validated training datasets across 12 specialised domains, delivered by a global network of over 5,000 vetted domain specialists spanning 100+ languages and 50+ specialisations. Beyond datasets, we offer end-to-end AI solutions including Fine-Tuning, RLHF & Alignment, Red Teaming, Model Evaluation, Data Annotation, Synthetic Data Generation, and Pre-Training Data Pipelines. We are not a crowd-sourcing platform. We are the data partner that matches the ambition of the teams building the next generation of AI, delivering measurable results: 42% accuracy improvements, 3x faster time-to-production, and 99.4% regulatory precision. Equal Opportunity Emetlab is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that extraordinary products are built by extraordinary teams, and extraordinary teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin. If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to our team and we will ensure your needs are met with care. Let's build the future of AI training data, together. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: AI Implementation Intern
description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto 's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. title: Telesales Executive - Kannada
description: About Lokal : In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved. We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (Agri Lokal ) Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs) Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (Astro Lokal ) Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives. We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital. Role Overview : We are looking for a driven Telesales Executive (Kannada - speaking) to support Lokal App’s growth by engaging potential users through outbound calls and converting leads into customers. This role involves understanding user needs, pitching relevant solutions, managing the sales funnel end-to-end, and consistently achieving monthly sales targets. You’ll work closely with the marketing team to capitalize on campaigns, maintain accurate CRM records, and provide on-ground customer insights that influence future strategies. This is an ownership-heavy role suited for someone who enjoys targets, conversations, and real impact. Responsibilities Conduct outbound calls to prospective clients and effectively promote Lokal App's services. Engage with users to identify their needs and create tailored solutions that fit their requirements. Maintain accurate records of calls, interactions, and leads in the CRM system. Follow up on leads and manage the sales process from initial contact through to closing. Collaborate with the marketing team to leverage campaigns and enhance sales efforts. Provide feedback on customer interactions and market trends to help shape future strategies. Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of Lokal App. Requirements Fluency in Kannada and a good command of English . Previous experience in tele sales or sales roles is preferred. Excellent verbal communication and persuasive skills. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Familiarity with CRM software, Excel and sales tracking tools is a plus. Motivated and goal-oriented individual with a passion for sales. Experience required: 1 Year (Minimum). Why Join Us? We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal , you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Junior Ubuntu Software Engineer
description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring junior engineers to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation - engineers who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, engineers who are just as comfortable designing and engineering new software as they are packaging, integrating, testing and shipping the incredible catalog of open source software provided by the Ubuntu repositories. Our engineers integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world’s most deployed open source operating system, it's a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments. The four key teams that ship Ubuntu are Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities Server: leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution Desktop: driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter Debcrafters: a new team responsible for the forward movement, maintenance and overall health of the Ubuntu archive: one of the most abundant repositories of open source software available today Bring your existing expertise and learn new skills by working on one of the most prolific pieces of open source software. As an engineer working on Ubuntu you could work on any or all of the following categories: Development : design, build and ship new foundational systems software and applications in Rust, Go, Flutter, and Python Architecture : engineer the integration of open source from boot firmware to cloud applications deployment Packaging : a combination of Debian and Snap packaging to ship software in the distribution Automation : build and maintain the machinery responsible for building, testing and shipping Ubuntu Distro Engineering : the maintenance and evolution of a Linux distribution and its repositories If you have skills in those areas, or you have other skills you believe could contribute to Ubuntu, and you're keen to get started building your career in open source, then this is the role for you. Our junior career path caters for both new graduates and early careers engineers. At Canonical , you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies. Location : We have remote roles open in every time zone. The role entails Based on the first round of interviews, we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit and conduct second-round interviews with those teams. Our engineers are: Designing, building and shipping software in Rust, Go, Python and C/C++ Packaging, integrating, testing and uploading open source software to the Ubuntu repositories Debugging issues, then designing and delivering robust solutions Authoring and improving technical and community documentation Contributing to upstream and neighboring open source projects Collaborating as part of a globally distributed team Continuously learning and progressing their technical and professional skills What we are looking for in you An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations A passion for open source software Experience with Rust, Go, Python, Flutter or C/C++ Professional written and spoken English Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each Nice-to-have skills Familiarity with Linux distributions Familiarity with system debugging tools and techniques Familiarity with automation tooling and CI/CD systems Experience contributing to open source projects What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Junior Software Engineer - Remote (Global), Full-Time
description: Who we are MixRank processes petabytes of data every month from web crawling. We have hundreds of customers using our data products including Google, Amazon, Facebook, Intel, and Adobe, across industries Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Security. Our team is 50+ full-time, full-remote from 20+ countries. We're growing, profitable, employee-owned, no dependence on outside funding. Applicants from all geographies and backgrounds are welcome. We are looking for passionate individuals for whom programming is not just a job but it’s something they love to do. We're obsessed with computers, programming, big data, databases, compilers, hardware, math, data science, and the internet. Does this sound like you? Please apply to join our team. Our code base is very friendly to new contributors. You'll have a fully-functional development environment within hours (fully automated) and be pushing commits on your first day. Deployments to production happen multiple times per day and finish in less than 2 minutes. Effectively all of our codebase is written in Python, Rust, SQL, Javascript/TypeScript, and Nix. The core technologies you'll need familiarity with to be productive are Python, PostgreSQL, Linux, and Git. We operate at a larger scale than typical startups. We operate two datacenters with high performance servers we've built that are capable of dealing with the volumes of data we process. We've implemented our own distributed file system. We do full-scale web crawls. We download and perform static analysis on the entire universe of Android APKs and iOS IPAs that are published. Unlike a typical startup where you'll spend half of your time in meetings, and the other half fixing bugs from Jira tickets— at MixRank you'll get to challenge yourself with difficult technical problems that will help you to grow as an individual. Who we’re looking for We're looking for remote junior engineers that have 0-3 years of professional experience in software, and 5+ years of curiosity exploring computers, programming, and technical hobby projects. This is an open-ended entry role with mentorship and diverse opportunities to work on all areas of our product: databases, distributed systems, infrastructure and tooling, data analysis, machine learning, frontend/backend web development, APIs, data mining, data modeling, and more. To stand out, please highlight what makes you unique: passion for computing, curiosity and side projects, work ethic, niche research, etc. Ideally you've already graduated, but if you still have one or more years left of school, please feel free to apply anyway, and if you're the right fit for the team we'll figure out a way to accommodate your schedule. Beneficial (but optional!) experience includes PostgreSQL, Python, Rust, Linux, TypeScript, Nix, frontend/backend web development, and data mining. We'll reply from a @ an email address. Check your spam folder if you don't see a timely reply. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Junior Software Engineer - Cross-platform C++ - Multipass
description: Use your deep C++ skills on Windows and MacOS to build an amazing open source developer experience with Multipass, the workstation mini-cloud at your fingertips which provides Ubuntu and appliance VMs on demand for build, test and prototyping. The Multipass team is hiring a Software Engineer to join our distributed team. We greatly value quality in our code, and great user experience. Multipass is published for macOS, Windows, and also Linux. Think of it as a workstation mini-cloud. At its simplest you can simply say multipass launch and you will get a new VM on your workstation. You can feed that VM data, just as you would on a public cloud like AWS, Azure or GCP. The goal is not to be a full cloud of course. title: Fundraising & Grants Member Advisors
description: OVERVIEW Fractured Atlas is seeking two full‐time Member Advisors - one Grants & Member Advisor and one Fundraising & Member Advisor. Fractured Atlas is a national, fully remote nonprofit arts service organization. Our work is guided by the belief that some of the boldest, most urgent creative work happens outside of institutions, led by individual artists, emerging collectives, and grassroots organizations. Our mission is to make the journey from inspiration to living practice more accessible and equitable for artists and creatives. We run the largest fiscal sponsorship program in the country, supporting thousands of active projects in every creative medium across all 50 states. Through fundraising tools, educational resources, visa letters, community programming, and 1-on-1 support, we help artists access the funding, time, and community they need to make the art the world needs. A successful candidate in both roles will be a creative problem solver and quick learner who has an enthusiasm for the arts, is incredibly personable over the phone and email, possesses a high level of patience and understanding (particularly as it relates to explaining the same information multiple times), and is able to operate and respond in a fast-paced environment while remaining calm and collected. The Grants & Member Advisor will have expertise around supporting our fiscally sponsored projects through the grant process from application through reporting. The Fundraising & Member Advisor will have expertise around advising our fiscally sponsored projects on fundraising and donation processes, including individual appeals, crowdfunding, giving day campaigns, donation policies and processes, and donation investigation. Candidates with a work history that includes grant writing, fundraising, development, and/or customer service will likely excel. Since Fractured Atlas works virtually, these positions require strong self-motivation and both will be remotely supervised by the Associate Director of Education & Engagement. At Fractured Atlas , we individually and collectively work hard to carry out our organization’s mission. We also understand that work is just one part of life and, through a culture of care, support team members having full and robust lives outside of work. With that foundation, our organizational culture embraces people who are open to: Building trust with others and addressing equitable distribution of responsibilities when collaborating. Learning new ways of working while welcoming change as a way to reshape processes/policies/programming that no longer serve our values. Transparency in communications, decision making, and feedback. Centering care and connection in our individual work and in relation to our colleagues. We recognize that the culture and core values of an organization should continue to evolve to reflect the world we live in. At any given time, we recognize that there might be emerging values other than ourstated values and we continue to have conversations about stated and emerging values. Additionally, at Fractured Atlas we work to adhere toanti-racism and anti-oppression principlesin all areas of our internal and external work. This commitment is grounded in our belief that change is possible, and that our work and that of the artistic community as a whole will grow stronger as oppression is eliminated. In our current phase of this journey towards being an Anti-Racist Anti-Oppressive organization, the whole staff is engaged in all staff ARAO meetings led by rotating teams and undergo training as part of their onboarding process. We recognize that we do not have all of the answers as we pursue this work. This work will continue to shift as the Fractured Atlas team changes. We ask that new team members join us as we continue to learn, practice, and grow in this work. Learn more about what it’s like to work at Fractured Atlas here. MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES BOTH MEMBER ADVISOR ROLES: Manage ongoing email communication with artist members through Zendesk. Conduct consultative and onboarding calls using Calendly and Zendesk Talk. Review and approve fundraising materials, including grant applications, individual appeals, and crowdfunding campaigns. Demonstrate Fractured Atlas ’ software tools and provide walk-through support to members and fellow Member Advisors as needed. Troubleshoot login, navigation, and other basic access issues. Other duties as assigned to support the team and our members GRANTS & MEMBER ADVISOR ROLE: Provide member advising and grant administration support for Fractured Atlas ’ fiscally sponsored projects: Manage a high volume of grant application reviews while meeting funder deadlines and maintaining accuracy and consistency. Review grant guidelines, applications, budgets, and supporting materials to assess eligibility, ensure compliance, and provide constructive feedback. Advise members on applying for grants through fiscal sponsorship and communicate revisions, missing information, deadlines, and next steps. Review and approve grant-related fundraising materials before submission. Review and approve grant final reports, including narrative and financial reporting requirements. Process grant award payments, review award documentation, and track payment and reporting requirements. Correspond with members and funders regarding applications, awards, payments, required documentation, and final reports. Maintain accurate grant records and handle sensitive member, funder, and financial information with care and discretion. Collaborate with the Grants Manager and Programs team to improve grant-review processes and strengthen member education. FUNDRAISING & MEMBER ADVISOR ROLE: Provide member advising and financial administrative oversight for Fractured Atlas ’ fiscal sponsorship and fundraising tools: Manage a high volume of support queries and reviews while meeting deadlines and maintaining accuracy and consistency. Advise artist members on the use of Fractured Atlas ’s fiscal sponsorship program, including its fundraising and financial tools, and how to follow donation and financial procedures. Review and approve fundraising materials: including profile/general support edits, individual appeals, third-party giving campaigns, and crowdfunding campaigns. Support donation tracking and investigation, including logging donations in Airtable, confirming matching gifts, and resolving donation-related issues. Correspond with members and donors regarding returned or disputed donations. Provide back up support with artist visa services program. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR BOTH MEMBER ADVISOR ROLES: Knowledge of the fundraising landscape and grant application processes 1-2 years experience or strong familiarity with web-based software (Slack, Google Drive, Airtable, Trello, Zendesk, Calendly, or any ticketing or CRM software) Experience with individual time management in a remote-work environment Possesses self awareness of their professional needs in the workplace Strong collaboration and team communication skills Experience handling sensitive information and tracking specific details with accuracy Experience explaining policies, procedures, or technical processes to non-expert audiences A successful Member Advisor, Programs on the Programs team will be passionate about or committed to: Advising and/or educating artists and creative business owners Streamlining processes and training others to do the same Exercising research, analytical, and investigative skills to problem solve. Using and exploring new technologies Efficient, effective, understanding communication Managing a personal workload Staying flexible and juggling changing priorities Knowing when to take initiative, follow direction, and when to pause Engaging in collaboration and teamwork Experience in arts administration, arts management, or information technology - a plus! Direct experience with financial oversight - a plus! GRANTS & MEMBER ADVISOR ROLE: 2+ years Direct experience with grants oversight or grant application review. Direct experience with New York State Council on the Arts grants - a plus! FUNDRAISING & MEMBER ADVISOR ROLE: 2+ years of experience in a member, customer, or client support role - financial, fiscal sponsorship, or compliance-related experience a plus! Experience reviewing materials or requests against established guidelines and making approval decisions Knowledge of donation, payment, or transaction processing LOCATION This position is U.S.-based and 100% virtual (with travel about 1-2 times per year*). You can live anywhere in the country but most meetings fall during a 9 AM-6 PM ET window. *We have full staff and team in person/hybrid gatherings 1-2 times a year, but we respect that individuals have different risk levels with travel and will work with employees to determine what is possible, with consideration for what is unsafe or uncomfortable for team members. COMPENSATION This is a full-timenon-exempt position. Salary is $32.70/hr ($68,016 annualized). Fractured Atlas has fixed-tier compensation, so everyone at each tier makes the same. Learn more about our compensation structure here. Benefits include employer-contributed dental, vision, medical insurance; flexible spending account; employer-contributed 401K plan; commuter benefits; professional development allowance; ticket and staff donation allowance for artist member projects; internet and cell-phone stipend; workplace supplies allowance; unlimited paid vacation days; paid sick days; paid family and medical leave; half-day Fridays (full time is 36 hours), and a casual but hard-working, friendly, and supportive work environment.Learn more about our benefits here. TO APPLY When submitting your application, you will be asked which role you are applying for and if you are open to and interested in being considered for both. To be considered for the position, please use the application portal to upload all the items below in one PDF-formatted file: Answers to the following prompts (please keep responses to 200 words or less per prompt) Tell us about a time you successfully helped someone achieve their goal(s). Incomplete submissions will not be considered, nor will submissions sent outside of the application portal. When applying, you can use any name that you’d like to be referred to—it does not need to be your legal name. If at any point in the process you’d like for us to update your name in our applicant tracking system, please email and we can update it for you. We receive many applications for each job and cannot respond to questions about the position unless you are having a technical issue with the job portal or are requesting accommodations for the process. If you need help with a technical issue or are requesting accommodations, please email . Want to know what’s next after you apply?Here is a breakdown of the steps of the hiring process. title: Full-Stack Engineering Intern
description: About Rivet Rivet is an AI-native accounting firm. In less than 3 years, we've built a T500 firm in the US, combining corporate and personal income tax, sales tax, R&D credits, and bookkeeping into a single, all-inclusive experience that eliminates the worst parts of tax season for real businesses and the people who run them. Our platform is designed to feel invisible: it guides clients through their tax to-dos, automates the drudgery for preparers, and gets out of the way when it's not needed. We measure success in time saved and returns completed, not vanity usage metrics. We run Rivet (the firm) on Rivet (the platform) because owning the stack makes it possible to deeply embed AI into every step of our workflows, far more than our competition will ever be able to relying on third-party/off-the-shelf tooling. Our team of 50 supports more than 1,300 clients, including some of the most innovative companies in the US — Cursor, Cognition, and ModRetro — and their executives, investors, and employees. And while we may have just gotten started a little over two years ago, this isn't our first rodeo: Nick Abouzeid (cofounder & CEO) comes from Ramp, where he ran three of their Growth teams from $100M → $600M in ARR Kyle Christenson (cofounder & Head of Tax) comes from the IRS, where he spent six years as an auditor before leaving to start his own firm over a decade ago We're well-funded, growing quickly, and sustainable. We've raised over $7M to date, from investors like XYZ Ventures, Susa Ventures, Haystack Ventures, and 40+ executives from Ramp, Anduril, Physical Intelligence, & more. Why this role is different We don't run an internship program. There's no cohort, no intern project graveyard, no summer showcase. We open this role when we meet someone we're excited to work with, and the work is the same work everyone else is doing. That means a few things you should take literally: You'll ship to production. Not a sandbox, not a prototype someone archives in September. Real users, real returns, real consequences. Ownership from first commit to production. You design, build, ship, and maintain your work — with someone experienced sitting close, not reviewing from a distance. Decisions happen at the edge. Engineers talk to clients and tax preparers directly. You will too. Clear is kind. You'll get direct feedback early and often. We're kind by being honest, not by being vague. We're hiring you for slope, not credentials. What you've built on your own matters more than where you're enrolled. Our stack Six engineers today, five languages. You'd work across the first two: Platform: Go, as a modular monolith — Connect RPC over protobuf, Go Fx for wiring, sqlc and goose against Postgres, River Pro for background jobs, Watermill for pub-sub over RabbitMQ. Frontend: React and TanStack, deployed to Cloudflare Workers. AI and eval: Python, in their own repos — ModelBridge (a gRPC service for AI building blocks) and TaxBench, our internal eval suite. Legacy integration: a C# Windows agent that drives Drake, one of the tax platforms our industry never built APIs for. Infrastructure: AWS — ECS Fargate, Amazon MQ, AMP, Loki, Tempo — provisioned by Pulumi, itself written in Go. Around the edges: Buildkite for CI, OpenTelemetry throughout, Doppler for secrets, Linear for tracking. What you'll do Own a scoped feature end to end — Postgres schema, Go service, protobuf contract, React screen. Scoped so you can finish it, not so it doesn't matter. Pair with the engineer who owns that module. You'll have a named mentor from day one and a standing weekly with them. Work on the automation problems. Our industry never built APIs. Parsing filings that arrive as scanned paper and reconciling ledgers that disagree with each other is most of the interesting work here, and plenty of it is well-scoped. Talk to accountants every day. They're on Slack, they'll tell you exactly what's broken, and they're the reason the thing you build matters. Ask questions in public. We'd rather you ask in a channel than spend two days stuck. We're fully distributed. Higharc is seeking a hands-on Sr. Software Engineer to bring framing and structural analysis to the products homebuilders use every day. You'll be an early member of a new team, working on emerging technology where the roadmap, and the team around it is still taking shape. What You'll Do You'll help set technical direction as much as you write code, and you'll be comfortable with priorities shifting as the team finds its footing. It's primarily an individual-contributor seat with room to grow into a tech lead. You don't need to be a career structural engineer, but structural or mechanical engineering experience is a real asset as you'll be the person who understands how framing and structural systems actually work and can turn that into software. Expect to: Design and implement the algorithms and systems behind framing and structural analysis, from early prototypes to a shippable MVP. Use AI-assisted workflows to build quickly while owning the correctness, maintainability, and behavior of everything you ship. Partner with product, customer success, and other engineers to define expected behavior, surface gaps, and keep customers happy. Bring structural engineering judgment to the team, translating how framing and structural systems work into robust software. Write tests that hold up against the worst corner cases. Help shape a new team's technical direction and mentor others as it grows. Navigate ambiguity as scope and priorities evolve on an emerging team. About You You prioritize working software over perfection. You like to ship, get user feedback, and iterate, and you're happy to dig deep into a codebase to contribute effectively to it. You're hands-on but keep the bigger strategic picture in view, and you're energized by building something new where the path isn't fully mapped yet. A genuine interest in homebuilding, construction, or home design is a plus, because you'll be helping elevate an entire industry. You have: 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally in TypeScript. Structural or mechanical engineering experience, whether academic or professional. description: This is a remote position. About the Role We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Renewable Energy Market Research Analyst to join our international Energy Research team. The role combines renewable energy market intelligence, data research, project and workstream management, and the preparation of high-quality research outputs. The successful candidate will independently manage defined research workstreams and selected projects while contributing to recurring market intelligence products, client-specific studies, awards and other research-based initiatives. The position requires a strong understanding of global renewable energy markets, with a particular focus on photovoltaics, battery energy storage systems, heat pumps and e-mobility. Key Responsibilities Market Research and Intelligence Conduct in-depth research on global renewable energy markets, with a particular focus on photovoltaics, battery energy storage, heat pumps and e-mobility. Monitor and analyse renewable energy installations and market volumes, electricity-market dynamics and prices, tenders, political and regulatory frameworks, market incentives, downstream stakeholders, macroeconomic developments, technology trends and key industry news. Identify reliable primary and secondary sources, including regulatory authorities, industry associations, data providers, company publications and specialist media. Evaluate sources critically and ensure that all research outputs are transparent, traceable and properly documented. Data Research and Management Maintain and regularly update structured databases containing renewable energy market, regulatory, technology and stakeholder information. Collect, validate, clean and structure quantitative and qualitative data. Spport the development of market estimates, market shares, forecasts, rankings and comparative market assessments. Document data sources, assumptions, methodologies and update processes. Improve the accessibility and reusability of data across different research products and client projects. Project and Workstream Ownership Independently plan and manage defined research workstreams and selected projects from initial research planning through to final delivery. Translate project objectives into clear tasks, milestones and deliverables. Coordinate inputs from colleagues and contributors and proactively follow up on timelines and open items. Identify risks, data gaps and potential delays at an early stage and communicate them transparently. Review and quality-check research and data work packages prepared by junior or supporting resources where required. Support senior analysts and project leads in the delivery and further development of larger recurring products and complex client assignments. Take increasing ownership of recurring products or project modules based on experience and demonstrated performance. Translate complex market information into clear findings, visualisations and management-relevant insights. Contribute to whitepapers, client-specific studies, market assessments, workshops and Advisory-related projects. Support the combination of different data sources and research assets to answer specific client and business questions. Collaborate with colleagues responsible for Primary Research, product development and client solutions. Awards and Stakeholder Coordination Support selected research-based awards and ranking programmes. Conduct company, market and technology research required for award evaluations. Coordinate defined communication with applicants, industry experts and evaluators. Support the documentation, evaluation and quality-assurance processes associated with awards and rankings. Process Improvement, Technology and Automation Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of research, data-management and reporting processes. Identify repetitive research or data tasks that can be supported through digital tools, automation or AI-assisted workflows. Use AI-supported research tools responsibly, ensuring that all information is verified through reliable sources. Support the development of templates, dashboards, documentation and reusable research workflows. Share knowledge, sources and best practices proactively with the wider team. Key Skills, Knowledge and Abilities Strong understanding of renewable energy markets, particularly photovoltaics and battery energy storage. Knowledge of heat pumps or e-mobility is an advantage. Strong research skills and the ability to identify, evaluate and synthesise information from a wide variety of sources. Very good quantitative and qualitative analytical skills. Ability to manage defined projects and workstreams independently, including priorities, timelines, contributors and deliverables. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. High level of ownership, reliability and proactive communication. Ability to identify risks or unclear requirements and raise them early. Strong written and spoken English. Willingness to learn, document knowledge and support the development of other team members. Required Education and Experience Master’s degree in economics, business administration, energy economics, environmental sciences, data analytics, public policy or another relevant discipline. Two to four years of professional experience in renewable energy market research, market intelligence, consulting, Advisory or a comparable analytical role. Experience in a reputable research, consulting, energy, data or market-intelligence organisation is preferred. Previous responsibility for defined projects, workstreams or recurring research products is strongly preferred. Location and Working Model India-based, remote-working position. Full-time employment, 40 working hours per week. Regular collaboration with colleagues based in India and Germany. Collaboration with an international and interdisciplinary team. Exposure to market intelligence, Primary Research, client projects, product development, awards and emerging Advisory services. title: Data QA Engineer - Remote
description: At Zyte , we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte . Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data. Role Overview Data QA is how we make sure the data we deliver is right before the customer sees it. As a Data QA Engineer, you will check the data our spiders and AI-assisted projects produce against what the customer asked for, find what is wrong and tell the team exactly what you found. Quality assurance is more useful as a question asked at the start than a gate at the end. Is this requirement testable and how would we know if it were wrong? Part of this role is asking that question early, so problems are fixed before they reach the customer. Key Responsibilities Turn customer scraping and data requirements into a clear test approach and own QA from the start on new projects. Combine exploratory manual and visual testing with automated tests where automation pays for itself. Run test cycles on extracted data and report the results clearly. Write up defects with enough detail that a developer can reproduce and fix them without a conversation. Use descriptive statistics, summaries and charts to show how good the data is: completeness, accuracy, consistency and drift. Produce test reports and quality scores that give the team, and the customer where needed, a true picture. Say what was tested, what was not, and what risk that leaves. Work with project managers and clients to clear up unclear or untestable requirements before QA begins. Feed into our test automation framework, with a focus on coverage and performance. Suggest and take ownership of improvements to QA process and tooling, including browser add-ons, spreadsheet add-ons and UI-based test automation tools. Work with QA leadership, project managers and developers, with minimal supervision. Requirements 5+ years in a QA Engineer or similar role - testing software or data. Python preferred language - Pandas and Jupyter for data analysis and validation. SQL: basic to intermediate queries, and comfort with at least one relational database and its tools. A solid grasp of web technologies and protocols: HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP and CSS. Experience writing tests against HTTP/REST APIs. Proactive and detail-oriented QA professional with a strong sense of ownership over project quality. Fast learner adept at rapidly understanding complex project domain requirements and adapting to new technologies. Leveraging AI and LLM tools to optimize test case generation and accelerate data validation processes. Good test case design and test data management. Experience working in an agile team (Scrum or Kanban) alongside developers. An understanding of data quality concepts such as completeness, accuracy, consistency and drift. Strong attention to detail, and the confidence to hold the quality line under delivery pressure. Clear written and spoken communication in English. Nice to Have Working knowledge of Scrapy and other Python-based scraping frameworks. Experience with test automation frameworks. Interest in data science concepts as they apply to data analysis and validation. Interest in using AI and LLM tools to speed up data validation. Benefits As a new Zytan, you will: Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team. Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work. Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools. 35 days paid holidays Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Staff Engineer, Imunify360 (remote work)
description: CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful. Check out our website for more information: We are currently hiring Staff Engineers for various projects within the Imunify360 product. Imunify360 is CloudLinux 's multi-layer security suite for Linux web servers: antivirus and malware cleanup, WAF, IDS/IPS, Proactive Defense, patch management (KernelCare/Patchman), and IP/domain reputation. It runs on hundreds of thousands of shared, VPS and dedicated hosting servers, under cPanel, Plesk, DirectAdmin and standalone. The engineering org is 60+ engineers in squads covering backend, core, server agent, malware research, WAF/WebShield, and Patchman. Core services are Python; agents and performance-critical paths are Go and Rust. We run on Hetzner and our own bare metal. Check out our website for more information: Role Mission & Scope Most complex technical challenges in Imunify360 go beyond individual squads. A single detection change can impact the scanner, agent, UI, reputation backend, and release process. While squad leads own delivery within their teams, the Staff Engineer ensures technical alignment across the product. As a Staff Engineer, you'll be a hands-on technical leader working across the entire product , focusing on the most critical and high-impact challenges as priorities evolve. You'll drive technical decisions, improve architecture, establish engineering standards, and help teams build sustainable solutions. This is an individual contributor role , without direct people management responsibilities. You'll remain actively involved in development, spending approximately 30–50% of your time writing production code , rather than focusing solely on architectural design. While deep expertise in a particular area is valued, this role requires the flexibility to work across different components, collaborate with multiple squads, and tackle challenges wherever your expertise can make the greatest impact. What you will own Architecture and technical direction Own the end-to-end architecture of Imunify360 as a product: agent ↔ server ↔ cloud backends, data flows, and the contracts between them. Write and drive ADRs and RFCs for cross-squad changes. Run the Wed/Fri architecture sync together with the Technical Director. Keep a living tech-debt and risk register (security / compliance / uptime) with owners and dates, and get the top items funded on the roadmap. Hard cross-cutting problems (examples of what lands on your desk) Agent resource footprint on dense shared hosts: CPU, memory and I/O budgets for scanning, file monitoring (inotify/fanotify) and WAF, measured on real kernels, not benchmarks from elsewhere. Detection pipeline quality: false positive / false negative rates, signature and ML model rollout with staged gates and rollback. Upgrade and release safety across a large, heterogeneous fleet (CentOS/AlmaLinux/ CloudLinux /Ubuntu, multiple control panels, old kernels). Backend scale and cost of reputation, ThreatIntel and telemetry services. Migrating hot paths from Python to Go/Rust where the data shows it pays off, and saying no where it doesn't. Engineering standards Set the bar for design reviews, code review, testing strategy, observability (Prometheus/Grafana/Sentry) and secure SDLC (OWASP ASVS, CIS Benchmarks as relevant). Lead or co-lead SEV1/SEV2 incidents when the cause is unclear or cross-squad; make sure the blameless post-mortem ships within 24 h and its actions get closed. Drive the AI-augmented SDLC in practice: show what good agentic coding looks like (prompt specificity, context provision, review quality, tool boundaries) on real changes, not slides. People multiplier (no direct reports) Mentor senior engineers and squad leads toward staff-level scope. Act as the technical bar-raiser in hiring loops for senior and lead roles. Be the engineering voice in product and sales discussions: estimates, feasibility, and no dated customer commitment without a written squad-lead estimate. Key Milestones 30 days: Shipped at least one non-trivial change to production. Can explain the full request path from agent to backend. Has a personal list of top 10 technical risks. 90 days: Owns one cross-squad initiative with an approved ADR, a measured baseline, and a staged rollout plan. Published risk register reviewed in arch sync. 6 months: That initiative is in production with before/after metrics. At least one engineering standard (e.g. release gating, agent perf budget, design review template) is adopted by 3+ squads. 12 months: Recognized by squad leads as the default escalation point for cross-cutting technical decisions. At least one senior engineer grown into broader scope with your mentorship. Requirements Must have 10+ years building and operating production software, with 3+ years in a Staff/Principal/Tech Lead scope spanning several teams. Strong production experience in Python and at least one of Go or Rust . Deep Linux internals : processes, filesystems, networking, kernel interfaces (inotify/fanotify, eBPF or similar), packaging (RPM/DEB), systemd. Track record of designing and running distributed systems at scale: async backends, queues, databases, caching, failure modes. You have owned systems that run on customer machines (agents, daemons, on-prem software) and know what upgrade safety, backward compatibility and resource budgets mean there. Security mindset: threat modeling, secure coding, handling of untrusted input (files, HTTP traffic, user content). Writes clear, short technical documents and drives decisions in async, remote teams across time zones. Uses AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude, MCP-based tooling) daily and can judge their output critically. Nice to have Experience in server security: AV/malware detection, WAF (ModSecurity/Coraza), IDS/IPS, rootkit detection, CVE/patch management. Experience with WordPress and Node.JS web application hosting at scale ML in production for classification/detection, including evaluation and safe model rollout. Observability at scale: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry, ClickHouse or similar. CI/CD ownership: GitLab CI, Jenkins, build systems for multi-distro packaging. Open-source contributions in security or systems tooling. Benefits What's in it for you? Stay hands-on technically while owning complex, high-impact engineering work. Work on challenging Linux, automation, and cybersecurity problems across mature and newer products. Influence technical direction and make meaningful architectural decisions. Work independently with a high level of ownership and autonomy. Fully remote work with flexible working hours. 24 paid vacation days, 10 national holidays, and unlimited sick leave. Private medical insurance compensation. Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement. Education budget. Opportunity to receive a reward for innovative ideas that the company can patent. By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy ( ), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data. description: This is a remote position. About Securin Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems. Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team-wide use. description: 🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Maintain comprehensive records of test results, defects, decisions and resolutions in Jira and Confluence for full traceability and auditability. Collaborate with Product, Payment Experience, Infrastructure and Operations stakeholders to ensure testing feedback is understood and translated into product and process improvements. 💻 Technology stack & way of working Testing & API tools: REST APIs, JSON, Postman, Bruno, API scripting and automation, Fime test tools Tracking & collaboration: Jira, Confluence Ways of working: Agile methodology, daily stand-ups, cross-functional collaboration and close interaction with external partners 🕵🏻‍♀️ To succeed, you should meet at least 70% of these requirements +3 years of professional experience in QA, testing, technical operations or a similar role, ideally within payments, banking or fintech. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience. Fluent in English (CEFR C1 or C2); French, German, Dutch or other European languages are a plus. Thrive in a remote-first, multicultural and fast-paced environment. Strong experience in end-to-end and integration testing across multi-tier or distributed architectures. Hands-on proficiency with REST APIs, JSON data contracts and API testing or scripting tools such as Postman or Bruno. Solid experience reading system logs, debugging integration errors and troubleshooting issues across distributed services. Demonstrated experience working directly with external partners, member institutions, clients or technical stakeholders such as Project Leads and Test Managers. Proficiency with test management workflows, issue tracking and documentation using tools such as Jira and Confluence. Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to haves Familiarity with European payment schemes and rails such as SEPA, Instant Payments, SWIFT or card schemes. Experience with payment gateways, processors, core banking platforms or mobile banking integrations. Understanding of regulatory and scheme certification standards such as PSD2 or scheme compliance. Knowledge of reconciliation, clearing and settlement workflows. 🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are: A first call with one of our recruiters A culture interview with the hiring manager A technical interview with Test Engineer Hopefully, an offer you can’t refuse ⛔ Turn back if … You prefer working in a purely internal or isolated testing environment without direct external partner or bank interaction. You shy away from digging into logs, investigating API discrepancies or multitasking across several onboarding and certification tracks. You are looking for a rigid, fully static environment rather than an evolving, agile pan-European initiative. 🎁 What we can offer Remote-first culture with quarterly and annual all-staff in-person meetups to keep teams connected and collaborative Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year Competitive compensation package, featuring salary, performance-based bonus and a thoughtfully designed, high-quality benefits programme The opportunity to be part of a true pan-European company Learning & development budget: €5,000 training budget per year Otherwise apply! 🫶 Our commitment to equal employment opportunities EPI offers the same job opportunities to all, without distinction of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability or age. title: Principal Software Engineer – Large-Scale LLM Memory and Storage Systems
description: NVIDIA Dynamo is a high-throughput, low-latency inference framework for serving generative AI and reasoning models across multi-node distributed environments. Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility, Dynamo orchestrates GPU shards, routes requests, and manages shared KV cache across heterogeneous clusters so that many accelerators feel like a single system at datacenter scale. As large language models rapidly outgrow the memory and compute budget of any single GPU, this platform enables efficient, resilient deployment of cutting-edge LLM workloads. We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to define the vision and roadmap for memory management of large-scale LLM and storage systems. What you'll be doing: Design and evolve a unified memory layer that spans GPU memory, pinned host memory, RDMA-accessible memory, SSD tiers, and remote file/object/cloud storage to support large-scale LLM inference. Architect and implement deep integrations with leading LLM serving engines (such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM), with a focus on KV-cache offload, reuse, and remote sharing across heterogeneous and disaggregated clusters. Co-design interfaces and protocols that enable disaggregated prefill, peer-to-peer KV-cache sharing, and multi-tier KV-cache storage (GPU, CPU, local disk, and remote memory) for high-throughput, low-latency inference. Partner closely with GPU architecture, networking, and platform teams to exploit GPUDirect, RDMA, NVLink, and similar technologies for low-latency KV-cache access and sharing across heterogeneous accelerators and memory pools. Mentor senior and junior engineers, set technical direction for memory and storage subsystems, and represent the team in internal reviews and external forums (open source, conferences, and customer-facing technical deep dives). What we need to see: Masters or PhD or equivalent experience 15+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, high-performance storage, or ML systems infrastructure in C/C++ and Python, with a track record of delivering production services. Deep understanding of memory hierarchies (GPU HBM, host DRAM, SSD, and remote/object storage) and experience designing systems that span multiple tiers for performance and cost efficiency. Distributed caching or key-value systems, especially designs optimized for low latency and high concurrency. Hands-on experience with networked I/O and RDMA/NVMe-oF/NVLink-style technologies, and familiarity with concepts like disaggregated and aggregated deployments for AI clusters. Strong skills in profiling and optimizing systems across CPU, GPU, memory, and network, using metrics to drive architectural decisions and validate improvements in TTFT and throughput. Excellent communication skills and prior experience leading cross-functional efforts with research, product, and customer teams. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Prior contributions to open-source LLM serving or systems projects focused on KV-cache optimization, compression, streaming, or reuse. Experience designing unified memory or storage layers that expose a single logical KV or object model across GPU, host, SSD, and cloud tiers, especially in enterprise or hyperscale environments. Publications or patents in areas such as LLM systems, memory-disaggregated architectures, RDMA/NVLink-based data planes, or KV-cache/CDN-like systems for ML. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our special engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you! Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD. title: Software Engineer
description: About Dispensed At Dispensed ,we are passionate about empowering individuals to reach their full potential by supporting better health outcomes. We believe that access to innovative and alternative therapies can transform lives. Through our telehealth platform, we facilitate patient access to affordable, efficient, and reliable alternative medicine services across Australia, NZ and the UK. title: Founding Engineer
description: About Us Do you want to change money? At Tuyo , that's what we are doing. We are redefining the relationship between people and money by giving back individuals control of their money. We envision a world where money is truly sovereign and where people can completely fulfill their financial needs without intermediaries or actors who arbitrarily take control of their money. We’re leveraging the power of crypto to build this new financial system, and we need talented trailblazers to join us on this groundbreaking journey. Our team is fueled by collaboration, and we value the soft skills that build strong, cohesive bonds as much as the hard skills that get the job done. Why Tuyo ? Shape the Future: Be at the forefront of a financial revolution, making decisions that directly influence the future of our company and the world of finance and crypto. At the forefront of crypto: Work with cutting-edge technology and be empowered to explore and implement creative solutions. We believe in working hard: Greatness requires hard work and leads to fulfillment and enjoyment. Continuous Growth: Grow with a company that’s on a rapid trajectory. Proven Experience: You’ve successfully worked on medium to large-scale software projects and are ready for your next challenge. Team Player: Collaboration is second nature to you, but you’re also comfortable working independently when needed. title: Product Engineer (Full-stack)
description: We're looking for a talented Full Stack Product Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to the development of our cutting-edge employee hiring and onboarding software.
