Companies across staffing, gig work, and franchising trust us to onboard thousands of employees each month—securely, compliantly, and efficiently. We believe the future of onboarding isn't just forms and checklists. It's intelligent agents, dynamic workflows, and automation that adapts to regulatory complexity. Our stack powers the most critical, high-stakes moments of employment—like verifying work authorization, collecting withholdings, and guiding candidates through industry-specific training. What you'll do Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement new features and improvements for our software platform. Create Workflow Automations that streamline and optimize the employee onboarding process. Build robust and user-friendly React UIs for seamless user interactions. Contribute to a product with meaningful impact and the potential to revolutionize HR processes. Engineers at Onboarded are entrusted with autonomy and ownership of their domains. You will witness the result of your own decisions and how they help shape the product and support our customers. Opportunity to work on a wide range of technical challenges, from UI development to complex API integrations, using the latest technologies. title: Manager, Professional Services (Enterprise SaaS) | ELN
description: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics , a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. What do we need? As Manager, Professional Services, North America , you will lead a team of technical and scientific Professional Services consultants delivering complex solutions to our enterprise R&D customers. This role has a particular focus on Lab Orchestration . You will bring experience of laboratory automation, instrument integration and scientific workflows, helping Dotmatics develop and scale its Lab Orchestration services capability while ensuring successful delivery for our customers. You will combine strong people leadership, customer consulting and commercial Services management with sufficient technical and domain expertise to provide direction and challenge on complex implementations. You will work closely with customers and with Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering and Project Management throughout the customer lifecycle, from early solution definition and proof of concept through implementation, adoption and expansion. As an inspiring manager, you will build a high-performing team, develop individual capabilities and career paths, and create an environment in which consultants can deliver consistently high-quality outcomes. You will have particular responsibility for developing Lab Orchestration capability within the team, coaching specialists and helping establish repeatable implementation approaches, standards and best practices. You will also play an important role in evolving how Professional Services operates. We are looking for someone who can combine the fundamentals of running a successful Services organisation with a forward-looking approach to automation, AI-enabled delivery, reusable intellectual property and scalable service offerings. In this role you will get to Lead and develop a high-performing team of technical and scientific Professional Services professionals across North America. Build capability within the team through coaching, career development, skills planning and recruitment. Provide leadership and subject-matter guidance for Lab Orchestration and laboratory automation engagements , including instrument integration, scientific data flows and laboratory workflow transformation. Support the development of Dotmatics ' Lab Orchestration delivery methodology, implementation patterns, best practices and reusable knowledge. Provide oversight and governance for complex and strategic customer programmes, particularly where multiple technologies, workstreams or delivery teams are involved. Lead or support strategic customer engagements from discovery and proof of concept through implementation and production adoption. Act as a senior consultant to customers, helping translate scientific and laboratory workflows into practical technical and service solutions. Work closely with Sales and Solutions teams during pre-contract and solution-definition activities to ensure proposed solutions are achievable, appropriately scoped and commercially viable. Partner with Product and Engineering to provide structured feedback from customer implementations and help shape capabilities required to successfully deploy and operate Lab Orchestration solutions. Encourage new and scalable approaches to Services delivery, including automation, AI-assisted delivery, reusable assets and standardised offerings. Develop and standardise Professional Services offerings that improve customer outcomes while increasing delivery predictability and scalability. Drive utilisation, revenue and margin performance across the team. Review commercial delivery plans to maximise margin while protecting customer outcomes and delivery quality. Review Statements of Work and Services agreements in partnership with Sales and Legal, providing Services, delivery and contractual input where appropriate. Monitor project and contract performance, including Work in Progress, forecast, delivery risk and financial performance. Manage subcontractors and delivery partners where appropriate, ensuring quality and accountability remain consistent with Dotmatics standards. Conduct solution and delivery peer reviews on strategically important or high-risk engagements. Identify operational improvements that increase quality, repeatability, efficiency and scalability across Professional Services. Communicate and collaborate effectively within a multinational, cross-functional organisation including Project Management, Solutions Architects, Application Scientists, Developers, Sales, Engineering, Customer Success and Product. We are looking for people who have significant experience within Professional Services, consulting or enterprise technology delivery, combined with demonstrated people leadership experience. The ideal candidate will have worked within scientific software, laboratory informatics, laboratory automation or a related enterprise SaaS environment , and will understand both the commercial realities of Professional Services and the complexities of delivering technology into scientific R&D organisations. The key skills we are looking for Leading, coaching and developing technical or scientific Professional Services teams. Laboratory automation, Lab Orchestration, scientific instrument integration or closely related laboratory technologies. Understanding laboratory workflows and translating scientific and operational requirements into implementable solutions. Delivering complex enterprise SaaS, laboratory informatics or scientific software implementations. Working across interconnected laboratory systems, instruments, software and scientific data workflows. Acting as a trusted consultant to enterprise customers and engaging confidently with both scientific and technical stakeholders. Supporting complex solutions through discovery, proof of concept, implementation and production adoption. Working collaboratively with Sales, Solutions, Product and Engineering during pre-contract, implementation and post-implementation phases. Providing technical or architectural oversight without needing to personally own every aspect of solution delivery. Managing Services financial performance, including utilisation, revenue, margin and delivery forecasting. Developing repeatable methodologies, reusable assets or standardised Services offerings. Identifying opportunities to use automation and emerging technologies, including AI, to improve the efficiency and scalability of Professional Services delivery. Managing multiple concurrent customer engagements and identifying delivery, technical and commercial risk. Operating effectively in a global, matrixed organisation with stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies. You may also have Laboratory robotics and automation platforms. Scientific instrument connectivity and integration. Laboratory informatics environments involving ELN, LIMS, SDMS, CDS or related scientific systems. Designing or implementing end-to-end laboratory workflows spanning multiple instruments and software platforms. Building new consulting or Professional Services capabilities within an emerging technology area. Developing services that scale beyond traditional time-and-materials consulting through standardisation, automation or reusable intellectual property. Working within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, chemicals or other scientific R&D organisations. Total Rewards Dotmatics utilises a national market-based approach to base pay benchmarking and pay band development. The candidate's final starting pay is based on job-related skills, experience, job specific qualifications & location. In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details. Other Total Rewards Offered Medical, Dental, Vision, Insurance Health Spending Accounts Wellness Benefits (Mental Health Apps and Fitness Perks) Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance 401k Retirement Plan (with 4% company match; immediate vesting) Flexible Time off Plan (for US exempt employees) This is the range that we, in good faith, believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. Base Pay Range $123,567—$167,178 USD Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Founding GPU Engineer
description: Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. As data centres become one of the largest and fastest-growing sources of electricity demand, Fuse is expanding into high-performance compute infrastructure at the intersection of energy and AI, optimising how power-dense GPU workloads are scheduled, cooled and balanced against grid conditions in real time. We're looking for a Founding GPU Engineer to develop and optimise GPU-accelerated software for data centre systems: low-level performance engineering for large-scale compute clusters, tying GPU workload behaviour to energy availability and grid demand. This puts CUDA/GPU performance engineering at the centre of how Fuse scales its compute infrastructure. Responsibilities Design, implement, and optimise CUDA kernels for high-throughput, latency-sensitive workloads Profile and tune GPU performance across compute, memory bandwidth, and interconnect (NVLink/PCIe) bottlenecks Build tooling to correlate GPU cluster power draw and utilisation with real-time energy pricing and grid signals Optimise multi-GPU and multi-node scaling using NCCL, MPI, or similar communication libraries Work with data center infrastructure teams on power capping, dynamic voltage/frequency scaling, and workload scheduling strategies that reduce energy cost and carbon intensity Collaborate with ML/systems engineers to integrate custom kernels into training/inference pipelines Benchmark against CPU/GPU baselines and drive continuous performance improvements Contribute to internal libraries, documentation, and best practices for GPU performance engineering Requirements 4+ years writing production CUDA code, or equivalent strong project/industry experience Deep understanding of GPU architecture (SMs, warps, memory hierarchy, occupancy) Proficiency in C++ and CUDA; experience with Python for tooling/orchestration Experience with performance profiling tools (Nsight Systems/Compute) Familiarity with multi-GPU/multi-node scaling (NCCL, MPI, RDMA/InfiniBand) Strong grasp of memory optimisation, kernel fusion and parallel algorithm design Comfortable working across the stack, from low-level kernels to system-level infrastructure Bonus: Triton, cuDNN, cuBLAS or custom ML inference/training frameworks; data centre power/thermal management or demand-response systems; HPC, quantitative finance or large-scale distributed systems; Kubernetes/Slurm for GPU cluster orchestration; interest in energy markets, grid systems or sustainability-focused compute Benefits Competitive salary and eligibility for equity Biannual bonus scheme Fully expensed tech to match your needs Private health insurance Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees As we hire globally, benefits vary by location. title: AI Engineer, Forward Deployed (Copilot and Azure AI Foundry)
description: Role Overview The AI Engineer is a hands-on builder who works directly with Client teams to design, build, and ship production AI solutions on Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI Foundry (now Microsoft Foundry). This is an individual contributor role. You will write the code, configure the agents, wire up the data, and get solutions into the hands of real users. You will work inside a Collectiv delivery team alongside a project lead, architects, and data engineers. You will partner directly with Client business and IT stakeholders to turn a business problem into a working AI solution, then harden it for production. Key Responsibilities Copilot Solutions Build declarative agents, Copilot connectors, and plugins that extend Microsoft 365 Copilot with Client data and workflows Build Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, and autonomous agents for business processes Connect Copilot to SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, and line-of-business systems Write and iterate on prompts, instructions, and agent configurations based on test results and user feedback Azure AI Foundry Solutions Build custom agents and AI applications in Azure AI Foundry for use cases that go beyond out-of-the-box Copilot Select, deploy, and configure models from the Foundry model catalog, and explain the trade-offs in cost, quality, and latency Implement agentic workflows with tool calling, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems through APIs, Azure Functions, Power Automate, and Logic Apps Retrieval and Data Foundations Build end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines including ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector and hybrid search, and grounding Use Azure AI Search and Azure AI Document Intelligence to index and extract knowledge from Client content Partner with Collectiv data engineers to connect AI solutions to Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and other enterprise data platforms Evaluation and Production Readiness Build evaluation sets and test harnesses that measure answer quality, groundedness, hallucination rate, safety, latency, and cost Implement logging, monitoring, and tracing for deployed agents and models Apply security, identity, and governance controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, and Azure AI Content Safety Use version control, CI/CD, and code review standards for all AI solution code and configuration Consulting and Collaboration Work directly with Client stakeholders to gather requirements, run working sessions, demo progress, and manage expectations Translate business problems into scoped, buildable AI use cases with clear success metrics Train Client users and administrators on the solutions you build and support adoption after go-live Contribute reusable patterns, accelerators, and documentation to Collectiv 's AI practice Eligibility for this engagement This engagement requires US citizenship under the client's contract terms. This is a condition of the specific client project, not a Collectiv policy; Collectiv regularly hires non-US citizens and people based outside the US for other roles. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Good knowledge of CPU and/or GPU hardware architecture and low-level GPU performance optimization Familiarity with technologies such as multi-frontal factorizations, iterative solvers, preconditioners, and algebraic multigrid Experience with adopting and advancing software development practices such as CI/CD systems and project management tools such as JIRA Understanding of large-scale computing technologies such as PDE solvers, eigenvalue solvers and time-domain simulation methods (e.g., CFD, FEA) Working experience in a globally distributed and agile organization NVIDIA ’s invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing for science and engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. What We Offer A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. description: ABOUT US ARRISE sets the benchmark for service delivery and excellence in the iGaming industry. ABOUT THE ROLE You will join our Data Science team as a Data Scientist working at the applied-research end of computer vision. You will frame open-ended problems as testable hypotheses, develop prototypes to validate them, and choose the model architectures and methods best suited to each. Computer vision is the core domain, with scope to work across text, audio, and tabular data. Working with ML Engineers, you will help take validated prototypes into production and see them run at scale. Even if you don't meet every requirement, your skills and ability to deliver impact are what matter most. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Design and prototype ML and deep learning models, with computer vision as the primary domain (object detection, classification, tracking). Frame business problems as testable hypotheses and develop proofs-of-concept to validate them, iterating on the results. Evaluate and benchmark competing model architectures and pre-trained models to identify the best-fit approach. Collaborate with ML Engineers to scale validated prototypes into production systems and stay engaged through deployment. Track experiments, manage model and data versioning, and define evaluation metrics to compare approaches objectively. Work with product, engineering, and business teams to turn objectives into applied ML solutions. WHAT WE ASK OF YOU Master's degree in a relevant field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline. Hands-on experience developing ML and deep learning models, including demonstrated computer vision work. Strong proficiency in Python and a deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow). Experience with computer vision models for object detection, image classification, and tracking. Solid grounding in deep learning, traditional computer vision, and classical ML. Strong experimentation mindset: benchmarking, ablation studies, and structured evaluation of competing approaches. Experience working with large, complex datasets. Nice to have Experience collaborating with ML Engineers to bring models into production. Experience with any major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) for ML training and deployment. Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, vision transformers, or self-supervised / representation learning. Exposure to generative AI: prompt engineering, RAG, LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack), or LLM fine-tuning. Background in gaming, iGaming, e-commerce, or other consumer-facing applications at scale. How we work Our stack includes Python with PyTorch and TensorFlow, experiment tracking and model versioning, containerized deployment with Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Data Scientists and ML Engineers work together across the full lifecycle, from early research through to models running in production. WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE Work on substantial, real-world computer vision and deep learning problems at scale. End-to-end involvement, from research and prototyping through to production. Opportunities for professional and personal development. A collaborative, cross-functional environment with visible impact. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Director, Market Growth Strategy, Molecule to Market (Lab Automation)
description: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics , a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. What do we need We are looking for an experienced market leader, thought leader and SME in Lab Automation and Orchestration. Lab automation is where science meets engineering. Robotics, liquid handlers, instruments, and scheduling software are moving labs from manual work toward automated, data driven, and eventually autonomous operation. While we are supporting fully automated labs, most labs still run as islands. Instruments speak different languages, workflows are hard to change, and the data that comes off the line rarely arrives ready for analysis or AI. We’re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. Lab Orchestration and automation are core to our Molecule to Market story, and they connect directly to the strengths of Siemens in industrial automation. We need someone to own the market strategy for it. This is a customer and market facing role. You’ll spend real time with lab automation leaders at pharma, biotech, CDMOs, and research institutes across the UK and Europe, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You’ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to the lab automation market with confidence and one consistent story. You’ll work with industry thought leaders to shape the conversation on autonomous labs and AI. Your job is to drive software adoption and AI use cases in lab automation. You will shape where we play, who we sell to, how we position, and how we win. How you’ll spend your time Customer engagements: meeting automation leaders, scientists, and engineers, joining pursuits, and bringing what you hear back to the business Market analysis: sizing segments, tracking competitors and automation vendors, and spotting trends early Sales enablement: giving teams across regions the talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and proof points to win Solution marketing: partnering with the Siemens Solution Marketing team on content, campaigns, events, and messaging for the lab automation audience Thought leadership: working with industry thought leaders, inside and outside Siemens, to shape the conversation on self driving labs and the future of the automated lab Adoption and AI use cases: identifying, proving, and spreading the use cases that get labs running on Luma and putting AI to work on automated workflows and data Partner and ecosystem engagement: working with instrument makers, robotics providers, and integrators so our joint story is clear to customers Cross organization alignment: working across Siemens DISW and DI Automation teams so we show up as one company with one story for the lab automation market The goal is simple. Drive excellence in how we represent ourselves to lab automation buyers, and turn that into real software adoption. What you’ll do Own the market strategy for Luma in lab automation, including workflow orchestration, scheduling, instrument integration, data capture, and autonomous lab concepts Define target segments, buyer personas, and priority accounts, including Heads of Lab Automation, Automation Engineers, Discovery Technologies, Research IT, Core Facilities, and Operations leaders Build positioning trends, including autonomous labs, AI driven discovery, robotics, and data standards, and turn them into action We are looking for people who have 10 or more years in life sciences, lab automation, or scientific technology, with hands on experience in a pharma, biotech, CDMO, research institute, or automation vendor setting. You will bring Strong analytical skills, including sizing markets and building a business case excellent writing and presentation skills. title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
description: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects. Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software. AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve. We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company. You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently. Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important. This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend. Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations. Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review. Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria. Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations. Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures. Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting. Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks. Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies. Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners. Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification. Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes. Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies. Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback. Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead. Required Qualifications Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications. Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling. Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs. Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified. Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery. Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies. Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents. Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills. Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery. Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams. The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget. Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility. Especially Valuable Experience Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup. Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time. Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation. Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments. Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation. Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring. Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team. Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years. For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. What We Offer A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives. The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team. Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery. Close collaboration with startup leadership. The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops. Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process. Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning. Please submit your CV and a short overview covering: A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions. An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results. Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities. A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes. Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables. Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Staff Security Engineer, Imunify360 (remote work)
description: CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful. Check out our website for more information: We are currently hiring a Staff Security Engineer within the Imunify360 product. Imunify360 is CloudLinux 's security suite for Linux web servers. It protects hundreds of thousands of hosting servers and the websites running on them, so it sees most large-scale web attacks early — often in the first hours. Check out our website for more information: Role Mission & Scope At Imunify360, protecting customers from evolving cyber threats requires close collaboration between security research, engineering, and other teams. Responding to complex attack campaigns involves more than identifying threats — it requires understanding attack techniques, developing effective detection and mitigation strategies, and ensuring customers are protected. As a Staff Security Engineer , you'll take end-to-end technical ownership of complex security challenges, from initial threat discovery and analysis to detection, mitigation, and post-incident review. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on practical security engineering rather than SOC monitoring, compliance, or purely theoretical research. You'll analyze malware and exploit code, develop detection and mitigation tools, anticipate emerging attack techniques, and ensure security findings translate into production-ready detections, mitigations, and fixes. You'll work closely with engineering, security research, support, external partners, and the broader security community to coordinate responses and drive continuous improvements in our security capabilities. As an individual contributor , you won't have direct reports or people management responsibilities. All security research and testing are conducted within authorized boundaries, with clearly defined scope and responsible disclosure practices. Your mission is to strengthen Imunify360's ability to detect, prevent, and respond to emerging threats, delivering measurable security improvements that protect customers at scale. What you will own Malware and campaign mitigation Lead response to large-scale exploitation and malware campaigns: triage, root cause, and mitigation across every protection layer of the product. Reverse-engineer malware and exploits targeting Linux servers and web applications. Track campaigns over time, not just individual samples: cluster indicators, connect activity to known actors and toolkits, anticipate the next variant. Define and run measurable outcomes per campaign: time to detect, time to protect, cleanup effectiveness, reinfection rate. Security response coordination Own the security incident and response process, both for threats against our customers and for vulnerabilities in our own product: severity model, runbooks, communication, escalation. Coordinate with external parties — software vendors, partners, CERTs/CSIRTs, abuse desks, other security vendors. Drive responsible disclosure where we find vulnerabilities. Be the technical voice in security advisories and partner briefings, together with Product and Support. Triage external vulnerability reports. Offensive security on our own product Red-team our product and infrastructure. Assume a capable attacker who already has a foothold. Threat-model new features before they ship; own the security review gate for high-risk changes. Turn findings into fixes with the owning teams, not just reports. Detection engineering and tooling Raise the quality bar of detections: false-positive budgets, test corpora, staged rollout with measurement gates and fast rollback. Build and automate the analysis pipeline: dynamic analysis, honeypots, telemetry-driven hunting, ML-assisted triage where it measurably helps. Write production code for these tools; expect 30–50% of your time to be hands-on building. Turn telemetry into intelligence: emerging exploits, attacker infrastructure, trends — shared as internal briefs and selected public research. People multiplier (no direct reports) Mentor analysts and engineers; raise the security skill level across teams. Bar-raiser in security hiring loops. Key Milestones 30 days: Analyzed real threats end-to-end. Mapped the current response flow and where it breaks. Shipped at least one detection or mitigation to production. 90 days: Security response process and severity model published and agreed. Led at least one real campaign response with a written post-mortem. Baseline response metrics in place. 6 months: Time from first sighting to protection measurably reduced vs. baseline. First red-team review completed, top findings fixed. Working relationships with key external partners. 12 months: Recognized internally and externally as the owner of security response. Public research or disclosures published. Teams can run a standard campaign response without you. Requirements Must have 10+ years in security engineering, malware research, incident response, or offensive security, with several years leading cross-team work at Staff/Principal/Lead scope. Deep hands-on malware analysis and reverse engineering skills. Strong web application security and practical exploitation experience. Deep Linux knowledge from both the attacker's and the defender's side. Proven incident response leadership on large-scale events: you have run the response, written the advisory, and closed the post-mortem. Production coding in Python plus a systems language (Go, Rust or C). Experience with coordinated vulnerability disclosure and working with the security community. description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X. The Opportunity: Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise. The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculations, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts. This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana Cloud scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana Labs also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope. What You’ll Be Doing: The Usage squad owns the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations and customer usage calculations. Our domain encompasses maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, cost management and billing applications, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the customer user portal. Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. We build full-stack web applications, customer portals, backend services, APIs, and data integrations across internal Grafana platforms and third-party systems like NetSuite and Salesforce. When this domain works well, customers get clear usage visibility, reliable billing, and seamless account management workflows. This role is about 75% FrontEnd and 25% BackEnd. Design, build, operate, and evolve reliable full-stack web applications, customer-facing account portals, and backend services that power core customer usage and billing workflows Build and maintain backend APIs (Golang, Node.js) and intuitive user interfaces using modern frontend technologies (TypeScript, React) Design and maintain integrations between Grafana systems and external business platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, and cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP) Develop and automate business logic for customer usage metering, pricing structures, promotions, and billing reconciliation Collaborate across product management, DealOps, GTM, Support, and adjacent AppCore squads to deliver robust end-to-end features Address technical debt, optimize CI/CD pipelines, strengthen test coverage, and improve system observability and operational resilience Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while shaping pragmatic solutions for complex systems challenges Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations You will help own the production behavior of the systems you build. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks What Makes You a Great Fit: At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. We encourage our engineers to thoughtfully leverage AI tools to enhance every stage of the lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, documentation, and operations. We also look for strategic opportunities to embed agentic capabilities within our services to eliminate toil, bolster reliability, and ensure that complex customer workflows remain resilient and safe. We are seeking a Staff FullStack Engineer who thrives on building production systems where correctness, scalability, and user experience are paramount. As a remote-first organization, you should be comfortable collaborating asynchronously across time zones and taking full ownership of the critical systems powering Grafana Cloud. Our team is small and operates with a high degree of independence; you will be expected to lead major projects, coordinate across service boundaries, and help define the technical direction for our domain. You will be particularly successful in this role if you enjoy solving challenges related to stateful systems, eventual consistency, and reconciliation loops. title: Senior Software Engineer | Virscidian
description: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics , a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. What do we need We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to take primary responsibility for maintaining and supporting our existing Virscidian product portfolio. Our current products will remain important to customers for the next several years. During that time, they will require ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, bug fixes, customer support, and selected new features. This role is intended to provide clear technical ownership of that existing product stack while allowing other engineering resources to remain focused on our future product development. This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone who is comfortable working with the Microsoft-based technology stack and enjoys solving practical product and customer problems. The primary focus is keeping our existing products stable, supportable, and responsive to customer and business needs. When appropriate, the engineer may also contribute to new product development, including our SaaS platform, scientific algorithms, performance improvements, and other engineering initiatives. The ideal candidate has strong C#/.NET experience, understands desktop and server-side applications, and is comfortable working across application code, databases, APIs, deployment, and customer environments. In this role you will get to Take primary engineering ownership for the maintenance and support of existing Virscidian products. Investigate and resolve software defects, production issues, and customer-reported problems. Work with Support, Business Development, Product Management, and engineering teams to understand issues, priorities, and customer impact. Implement new features and product enhancements on a case-by-case basis as customer and business needs evolve. Maintain and enhance existing C#/.NET applications, including desktop UI (WPF, WinForms), services, Web APIs, and supporting components. Work with SQL Server databases, data access layers, stored procedures, and application data models. Support Azure hosted resources and existing DevOps, build, deployment, and release processes. Troubleshoot issues across software, database, configuration, deployment, and customer environments. Help improve the visibility and communication of product issues so priorities are clear to engineering and business stakeholders. Collaborate with engineers working on future products when knowledge of the existing products, workflows, or domain is needed. Contribute to new product development when appropriate, including SaaS platform work, scientific algorithms, performance and scalability improvements, and related engineering efforts. What we are looking for We are looking for an experienced software engineer who is comfortable taking ownership of mature products and keeping them reliable for customers. This role is well suited to someone who values practical engineering, understands that established products still require active development, and is comfortable working independently across a broad technical stack. The person should be able to investigate issues with limited initial information, communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and drive problems through to resolution. The key skills we are looking for C# / .NET: Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining applications using C# and the .NET platform. Desktop Application Development: Experience maintaining Windows desktop applications and user interfaces. SQL Server: Strong experience with relational databases, SQL Server, data access, troubleshooting, and performance considerations. Web APIs: Experience developing and supporting REST APIs and application integrations. Azure: Experience working with applications and services deployed in Microsoft Azure. DevOps / Build and Release: Experience with source control, automated builds, deployment, release management, and troubleshooting deployed applications. Product Maintenance: Experience supporting mature production software, including bug fixes, maintenance releases, and incremental feature development. Troubleshooting: Strong analytical skills and the ability to diagnose problems across application, database, infrastructure, and customer environments. Ownership: Comfortable taking responsibility for a product area, managing priorities, and following issues through to completion. Communication: Ability to work directly with Support, Business Development, Product Management, developers, and other stakeholders to clearly understand and communicate technical issues. Autonomy: Comfortable working independently and making practical engineering decisions within an established product architecture. Collaboration: Able to work constructively with multiple engineering teams and share knowledge across existing and future product development. New Product Development: Ability to contribute beyond maintenance when needed, including SaaS architecture and development, scientific and analytical algorithms, performance optimization, and scalability work. You may also have Experience with scientific or laboratory software. Experience with chromatography, mass spectrometry, CDS, LIMS, ELN, or other laboratory informatics systems. Experience maintaining software used in regulated or enterprise customer environments. Experience with legacy or long-lived Microsoft technology stacks. Experience supporting customer-specific configurations and integrations. An electrical engineering, software engineering, computer science, or related technical background. Ultimately, we are looking for someone who enjoys owning and improving established software products, solving real customer problems, and providing the engineering continuity needed to keep our current product portfolio stable and effective for the next several years, while also being able to contribute to new product development when it makes sense. Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Product Engineer
description: Become a part of our caring community Humana ’s Digital Health Platform (DHP) is the engineering platform behind many of Humana ’s consumer digital experiences. DHP Product Engineering builds the shared pieces other Humana teams build on, including a micro-frontend catalog, accessibility tooling, and API foundations, and we build them with AI coding agents at the center of how we work. We are hiring a Senior Product Engineer who wants a say in what gets built as well as the craft of building it, from accessible interfaces to the services behind them. You will own features across the whole stack, and you decide the technical approach for the work you own. You use AI coding tools like Claude Code every day, and you help build the shared skills and tooling behind that workflow. We measure your work by the results it produces for Humana ’s members and patients and for the teams who build on our platform. The Senior Product Engineer helps decide what we build, not just how we build it. This is a senior engineering role at its foundation. You design, develop, and deploy scalable web applications end to end, and you meet a high bar for engineering craft. You also own the product: you shape what we build, influence what goes on the roadmap, and are measured by the outcomes your work produces rather than the tickets you close. You explore before you commit, propose the work as often as you receive it, and sharpen requirements rather than simply implement them. You will build accessible user interfaces, implement robust back-end microservices, and integrate the two with GraphQL, all while exercising considerable latitude over technical approach. Strong product instinct here does not lower the engineering bar; it raises the overall one. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field 5 or more years of software engineering experience, including 3 or more years of full-stack web development 2 or more years each with React, Node.js, and GraphQL, including building accessible user interfaces that meet WCAG 2.2 Experience owning product or technical direction, such as shaping a roadmap or turning ambiguous problems into shipped outcomes Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor in daily development, including reviewing and refining what they produce Preferred Qualifications Test-driven development with Vitest, Jest, or Playwright Deploying microservices to Azure with Docker or Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines Micro-frontend architecture with Module Federation, including shared modules and cross-app dependencies Building React applications with TanStack Query, TanStack Router, TanStack Start, or Next.js Integrating AI into production features, or writing AI agent skills Use your skills to make an impact How we work: Our practice is skills-driven. A skill is a set of reusable instructions that an AI agent follows for a recurring task. You will write and improve those skills as part of your regular work. The practice is still emerging, and on this team you will help establish how it works. What helps you succeed here: Working independently and making sound technical decisions with incomplete information Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, in writing and in person Giving and receiving constructive feedback in code reviews and design discussions Bringing structure to ambiguous problems and to processes that are still taking shape Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana 's offices for training or meetings may be required. title: Senior Systems Engineer
description: Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide. Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you. Make an impact — from near or far At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming. We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states. The opportunity The Senior Systems Engineer will work closely with application teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and other IT teams to troubleshoot complex problems, implement solutions, improve system processes, and ensure reliable data exchange across the University's technology ecosystem. You will focus on Southern New Hampshire University 's Student Information System (Ellucian Banner), working in collaboration with our CRM, Learning Management System, and other platforms to ensure the best experience for our students and business partners. The position requires strong technical problem-solving skills, the ability to understand complex interconnected systems, and the judgment to balance immediate production needs with longer-term technical improvements. You will report to the Senior Director of SIS Platform and Development. What you'll do: Provide advanced production support for the Student Information System (SIS) and related enterprise applications, including troubleshooting complex application, database, integration, and data issues. Serve as a technical subject matter expert for the SIS and the broader ecosystem of applications and services that support University operations. Maintain, and troubleshoot integrations between the SIS and other institutional systems using APIs, web services, middleware, database interfaces, and other integration technologies. Analyze complex technical issues across multiple systems and identify root causes. Work closely with application developers, database administrators, infrastructure teams, functional teams, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver technical solutions. Monitor system performance, reliability, and data flows and proactively identify opportunities for improvement. Develop and maintain technical documentation, system diagrams, support procedures, and operational standards. Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, implementations, and other technology initiatives, including requirements analysis, technical design, testing, deployment, and post-production support. Collaborate with software vendors and external partners to troubleshoot issues, evaluate solutions, and coordinate technical activities. Participate in incident response, problem management, and change management activities for critical systems. Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other members of the IT organization. Contribute to architectural discussions and help establish sustainable, scalable, and supportable solutions across the University's technology ecosystem. Maintain awareness of higher education technology trends, vendor roadmaps, and emerging technologies relevant to the University's systems and integrations. What we're looking for: 4+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications, systems, integrations, or related technology environments. Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related field. Equivalent experience in lieu of degree acceptable Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex production systems and resolving issues across multiple technology layers. Strong experience with relational databases and SQL. Experience working with APIs, web services, data integrations, and enterprise application interfaces. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand complex systems and trace issues across applications, databases, integrations, and infrastructure. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and take ownership of complex technical problems. We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for. If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to fully engage in any part of the application or hiring process, please complete the Accommodation Request form or contact us at 603-626-9447. A member from the Employee Accommodation Support Center will be in contact with you within two business days to discuss your request. Compensation The annual pay range for this position is $96,954.00 - $155,153.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $107,132.00 - $144,945.00. Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional) You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get: High-quality, low-deductible medical insurance Low to no-cost dental and vision plans 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays) Employer-funded retirement Free tuition program Parental leave Mental health and wellbeing resources Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Agentic Engineer [Zeal]
description: Zeal is an AI-enabled software consultancy purpose-built for Fortune 1000 companies, and we’re now part of Livefront . We help companies navigate technology to drive business outcomes by attracting, retaining, and growing exceptional talent and empowering them to use innovative technologies and process frameworks. We’re a values-driven technology company grounded in kindness, generosity, and integrity. Our mission is to build a place where our employees love their future and where clients trust us to deliver what we promise: to improve their business through technology. Love your future. We’re looking for an outstanding Agentic Engineer to join our team. This role is available across our primary LATAM hub in Peru. Who you are You are a pragmatic, hands-on engineer who has built and shipped agentic AI systems into production. You understand that getting an agent to work is only part of the challenge. You know how to build systems that continue to work safely and reliably with real data, enterprise security requirements, and meaningful consequences when something goes wrong. You communicate clearly with clients and technical peers, make thoughtful architectural decisions, and are comfortable explaining why an agent behaved the way it did. You have strong software engineering fundamentals and the judgment to recognize when an agent is the right solution and when a simpler, deterministic approach is better. What you will be doing Work directly with clients to understand complex business problems and translate them into scalable, production-ready agentic AI solutions. Design and implement multi-step agent systems, including orchestration, tool and function calling, task decomposition, and, when appropriate, multi-agent coordination. Build integrations between agents and enterprise systems by exposing APIs as tools, implementing MCP servers, and developing structured tool contracts. Design evaluation frameworks, guardrails, grounding and citation checks, and human-in-the-loop workflows that identify and manage agent failures before they reach users. Instrument agent systems for traceability and observability, including agent actions, model behavior, token and cost usage, latency, and system performance. Design and maintain state and memory across long-running workflows and implement model routing, retries, idempotency, and other patterns required for reliable production systems. Build and deploy AI solutions using cloud platforms and services such as: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, AKS, or related Azure technologies; Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, ECS, EKS, or related AWS technologies. Apply strong software engineering practices using Python, Java, APIs, containers, source control, automated testing, and CI/CD. Work directly with client engineering and security teams through architecture reviews, threat modeling, security reviews, audits, and other enterprise delivery requirements. Evaluate when agentic architectures are appropriate and when deterministic pipelines, traditional machine learning, or other approaches are more reliable and cost-effective. Turn successful approaches from client engagements into reusable patterns and solutions that can be applied across Zeal. Build trust with clients and internal teams through strong communication, technical judgment, problem-solving, and execution. Why you should apply You want to work with passionate, talented people who are always looking for ways to make things better. You value a work environment where kindness, mutual trust, and egoless collaboration are paramount. You have a history of keeping promises, doing what is right, and spending energy on what matters. You enjoy the variety and growth that comes with consulting for Fortune 1000 companies across industries and technical stacks. You want to work on projects that have outsized impact and reach. You believe in sweating the details, committing to quality, and taking pride in going the extra mile. What you bring to the table We expect candidates to demonstrate a strong software engineering foundation, hands-on experience building agentic AI systems in production, and a keen interest in consulting. Agentic AI: Hands-on experience designing and shipping production agent systems involving tool and function calling, multi-step workflows, orchestration, task decomposition, or multi-agent architectures. You can explain the architectural decisions you made, what failed, and what you learned. Evaluation & Reliability: Real-world experience evaluating agent behavior and measuring system failures, including building evaluation harnesses, guardrails, grounding checks, human-in-the-loop controls, and other mechanisms that prevent or mitigate errors. Cloud Technologies: Deep hands-on experience with either Azure or AWS and the AI and infrastructure services surrounding them, such as Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Search, AKS, Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, ECS, or EKS. Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python or Java, API design, containers, automated testing, source control, and CI/CD, with enough machine learning knowledge to determine when traditional ML or deterministic approaches are more appropriate than an LLM. Enterprise Delivery: Experience delivering software within large organizations and working through requirements such as role-based access, data isolation, security reviews, compliance, change control, and production governance. Agent Observability: Experience designing systems for traceability, state and memory management, model routing, latency and cost visibility, retries, idempotency, and other operational concerns associated with production agent systems. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to explain complex AI systems, architectural decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Problem-Solving: Strong technical judgment and a demonstrated willingness to challenge assumptions, including recognizing when an agentic solution introduces unnecessary complexity and a deterministic approach would be more appropriate. Experience with MCP and emerging tool-interoperability standards, evaluation frameworks such as RAGAS, fine-tuning, model distillation or optimization, and highly regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, or manufacturing is helpful, but not required. What to expect When applying, please include a short note about yourself, a summary of your work experience, and a link to any public profiles you actively maintain (e.g., GitHub, LinkedIn). Our hiring process moves quickly and consists of several stages for candidates who capture our attention with their initial submission, sometimes including but not limited to a short preliminary phone interview, a series of video interviews, and a short take-home exercise, which you'll have up to a week to complete. Additional information We go out of our way to evaluate all employees and job applicants equitably based on merit, competence, and qualifications. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply, and we consider every applicant with an open mind. Don't worry, every application will be reviewed by a human.
