title: Senior QA Analyst
description: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full. Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare. AI Proficiency at Sword AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work. Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role. Role At Sword, quality isn't a final checkpoint, it's a mindset the whole team owns, and as a QA Analyst, you're the one who leads it. This goes way beyond executing tests: you'll own quality end-to-end, shaping the experience long before a line of code is written and long after a feature goes live. Before a feature is even built, you're already in the room, asking the sharp questions that stop issues before they're born. From there, you'll design and run test cases with real autonomy, trusted to make the calls that matter. And when a feature ships, your job isn't done: you'll stay close, supporting the team through whatever comes up. At every step, you're not just checking specs, you're pushing the entire experience to be better, sharper, more seamless. You'll do this inside a cross-functional team and across others when needed, which means your your communication and ability to lead carry weight. What you’ll be doing Work closely within a cross-functional team (Frontend, Backend, Design, Product, etc.) and collaborate across teams when needed; Get involved early — contribute to design and development discussions to help prevent issues before they reach testing; Design, execute, and maintain test plans and test cases; Build and maintain QA processes and procedures that the whole team can benefit from; Identify, document, and track defects through to resolution; Maintain thorough testing documentation; Invest in test automation over time. What you need to have +4 years of experience as a QA Analyst; Experience testing web apps; Experience in test case design, creation, execution, and reporting; Good analytical, communication, and teamwork skills; A critical mindset and attention to detail; Autonomy and initiative; Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Nice to have: Experience with test automation; Familiarity with tools like Postman, Jira, Git, Xray, Android Studio. *The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role. This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact. Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation. Total Compensation Range €29.750—€46.750 EUR Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately. title: Enterprise Account Executive-E-Invoice
description: Job Description: This position is responsible for generating revenue for Vertex through the sale of Vertex tax solutions to prospects and existing clients. Develop strategies and account plans to penetrate a defined territory and targeted accounts. This will include navigating through an organization to leverage Vertex solutions as an enterprise-wide, global value proposition. Understand customer business and service requirements to develop tailored Vertex solutions, including development of long-term relationships with customers as well as development of account plans for new relationships. Target accounts include new and existing customers within an assigned territory. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Generate revenue for Vertex by selling Vertex transaction tax solutions in a defined territory. Includes targeting specific accounts, developing strategy, gaining a clear understanding of companies' tax and technical environments, and selling Vertex solutions that best fit such requirements. Drive opportunities at the strategic and tactical level by selling the enterprise-wide value proposition associated with Vertex solutions to the highest levels within our customers’ organizations. Includes establishing relationships with key customer and partner contacts and selling into complex, multi-department enterprises; leveraging and developing strategy with Sales Management to manage and maximize accounts' value to Vertex. Understand customer’s business requirements, direction, and strategic vision of tax by building customer relationships at the highest levels, providing valuable input that influences their vision and tactics, and developing plans to assist them in achieving their goals. Developing and responding to RFPs, developing joint proposals with Vertex Consulting, and fostering relationships/partnerships between Vertex, customer(s), and/or partners. Gain support for customer initiatives by working with key customer contacts to help sell their ideas throughout their organization; assist in building business cases and work with stakeholders to sell ideas internally at Vertex; help influence partners' development of new interfaces that utilize Vertex products. Build customer awareness and understanding of Vertex’s business direction by managing accounts in a way that keeps key Vertex customers informed of Vertex's business direction. Stay informed of internal initiatives, related partner and industry developments and, as appropriate, communicate these to the customer and connect the customer with key people at Vertex. description: About Scento Scento is Europe's largest perfume decant website. title: Director, Analyst, Workday Contract Negotiations & Licensing
description: About the role: Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Director serves as an expert within Gartner ’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group. Utilizing research and analytical skills, a Director plays a role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner ’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations. Candidates must have current knowledge of Workday’s commercial programs, contracting and pricing models, and discounting approaches as well as an understanding of Workday’s go-to-market, sales and negotiation strategies. What you will do: Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” on Workday Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to negotiate favorable Workday SaaS deals. Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive negotiation strategies forward Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts Bring provocative, independent insights and ideas to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business Provide high quality and timely content peer feedback Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions What you will need: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred 10+ years of relevant field or industry experience 7+ years work experience in SaaS/software contract negotiations, technology procurement, category management, vendor management or software asset management within a buying organization, outsourcer, consulting firm, or reseller. Extensive, recent, hands-on experience negotiating with Workday (within last 12 months). Subject matter expertise in Workday licensing with understanding of the negotiation process, software and cloud services market trends, the global landscape, and reseller ecosystem. Experience with software license compliance risk assessment, management, and/or mitigation in a software audit context, particularly with Workday, is desired. Experience negotiating with other major vendors (e.g., AWS, Google, Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or ServiceNow) is desired. Provide clients and prospects with compelling, actionable advice regarding their Workday pricing and contracting needs, including negotiation strategies and ongoing vendor management, via virtual or face-to-face interactions. Develop and publish innovative, high-impact insights on software pricing and contracting, especially Workday, via research articles, webinars, events, and client briefings. Research, analyze, and forecast trends in software, SaaS, and cloud licensing to deliver forward-looking guidance. Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility and gain trust with senior executives and additional stakeholders Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high-quality deliverables Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply Subject expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements Strong business and financial acumen Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments Ability to represent Gartner 's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable) # Who are we? At Gartner , Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities. Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here. What makes Gartner a great place to work? Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance. We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients. Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations. We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work. Gartner is the world authority on AI At Gartner , you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes. It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner , with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you. What do we offer? Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers. In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring. Ready to grow your career with Gartner ? Join us. Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 148,000 USD - 175,500 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, SQA Engineers, other Principal Engineers, and Leadership to turn business priorities and objectives into technical plans and product value shipped to our Customers. Co-own the product roadmap with the squad's Product Manager, matching delivery commitments to team capacity so releases are predictable, on time, and high quality. Own key technical decisions and document them in design documents and architecture decision records, with the trade-offs between performance, scalability, cost, and delivery time stated openly, so anyone can see why a call was made and challenge it. Keep the squad aligned with org-wide architecture, cloud infrastructure, and engineering standards, and contribute to broader engineering initiatives with your peers. Run regular technical reviews to surface technical debt and risk, and turn the findings into a prioritized plan that keeps the platform healthy for years, not just the next release. Hands-on Delivery Write, review, and ship production code in the squad's main repositories. Build proofs of concept quickly to test new or uncertain ideas, so the squad learns by doing before it commits. Take the lead on the hardest problems, including customer-impacting production incidents, performance issues, and scalability challenges, and see them through to root cause. Set the standard for effective use of AI coding agents and tools in the squad. Engineering Standards & Quality Define and refine standards across the development lifecycle: coding standards, code review, unit testing, test automation, CI/CD, and release practices. Work with SQA to shift quality left through test automation, so defects are caught early and releases go out clean. Build secure coding into daily work with InfoSec, including threat modelling for new designs and security controls in code and pipelines. Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to improve reliability, observability, and deployment practices. Leadership, Mentoring & Communication Lead, coach, and mentor the engineers in your squad, including SQA engineers, through pairing, design reviews, and code reviews. Develop future technical leaders and help set hiring and interview standards for engineering roles. Raise technical disagreements early and directly, and build agreement across squads before decisions are locked in. Explain technical concepts, risks, and solutions clearly to engineers, product, executive leadership, and customers when needed, and keep technical documentation (design docs, architecture diagrams, specs) to a high standard. Large-scale systems — a track record of designing and delivering distributed production systems that handle high traffic and heavy load. Stack depth — deep expertise in a stack such as C#/.NET, ASP.NET, TypeScript, Angular, Go, etc and working knowledge of the others. Architecture fundamentals — strong grasp of design patterns, design principles, and distributed systems concepts such as caching, load balancing, messaging, and data consistency. AI-native engineering — hands-on experience with multiple AI coding agents and LLMs, and an informed point of view on AI-native workflows. Leadership & communication — proven ability to lead, mentor, and influence engineers, and to communicate clearly in writing and in person, including with executive and non-technical audiences. title: Agentic AI Architect I
description: Overview We are looking for an Agentic AI Architect I to help design scalable, reliable, and reusable architectures for production-grade AI agents. You will work across product, engineering, AI Platform, infrastructure, QA/Eval, operations, and support teams to translate business and workflow requirements into practical agent architectures. Your work may span agent orchestration, runtime services, tool and system integrations, workflow execution, observability, evaluation, responsible AI controls, and production support. This is a hands-on architecture role for someone who can balance technical design, implementation practicality, reliability, and delivery speed. The successful candidate will help teams avoid fragile one-off solutions by identifying reusable patterns that can be adopted across AI agent products. Responsibilities Primary Responsibilities Design end-to-end architectures for agentic AI solutions, including orchestration, runtime execution, workflow management, tool invocation, system integrations, evaluation, observability, and supportability. Translate product requirements, business workflows, and customer use cases into clear technical designs and implementation plans. Partner with AI Platform teams to use shared orchestration, runtime, evaluation, reporting, monitoring, and developer-tooling capabilities. Identify repeated solution patterns and recommend when they should become shared product or platform capabilities. Contribute to architecture standards, reference designs, technical decision records, implementation guidance, and reusable documentation. Help teams apply responsible AI, privacy, security, governance, and human oversight requirements throughout the solution lifecycle. Communicate technical decisions, dependencies, risks, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, operations, and business stakeholders. Qualifications Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Experience designing or building backend systems, distributed applications, workflow platforms, integration services, developer platforms, cloud applications, or AI-enabled solutions. Working knowledge of APIs, asynchronous processing, service coordination, event-driven architectures, stateful systems, and enterprise integrations. Understanding of architecture principles related to scalability, reliability, performance, availability, maintainability, security, and production support. Familiarity with LLM-based applications, AI agents, retrieval techniques, prompt and context management, tool calling, workflow automation, or model-driven products. Ability to convert business and workflow requirements into practical technical architectures. Experience with cloud services, deployment pipelines, monitoring, logging, dashboards, and production troubleshooting. Understanding of testing, evaluation, regression coverage, release readiness, and operational support for production systems. Ability to evaluate technical alternatives and explain architecture tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear diagrams, design documents, decision records, and implementation guidance. Strong collaboration skills across engineering, product, QA/Eval, security, infrastructure, operations, and support teams. Ability to work effectively in an evolving technical environment where requirements and agentic AI patterns may continue to mature. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing or implementing production LLM applications, AI agents, workflow automation, or intelligent assistant solutions. Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks, model gateways, evaluation frameworks, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI observability. Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise platforms, internal services, APIs, data sources, and third-party tools. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol, tool integration primitives, structured outputs, agent memory, workflow state, and multi-agent patterns. Experience with responsible AI practices, including safety controls, access management, data protection, human oversight, and auditability. Experience creating reusable reference architectures, platform patterns, technical standards, or architecture governance. Relevant cloud, software architecture, data, security, or AI certifications are beneficial but not required. title: AI/ML Lead
description: About ISACA ISACA ® (www.isaca.org) champions the global workforce advancing trust in technology. For more than 55 years, ISACA has empowered its community of 195,000+ members with the knowledge, credentials, training and network they need to thrive in fields like information security, governance, assurance, risk management, data privacy and emerging tech. With a presence in more than 195 countries and with more than 230 chapters worldwide, ISACA offers resources tailored to every stage of members’ careers—helping them to thrive in a rapidly changing digital landscape, drive trusted innovation and ensure a more secure digital world. Through the ISACA Foundation, ISACA also expands IT and education career pathways, fostering opportunities to grow the next generation of technology professionals. Overview The AI/ML Lead is a senior, hands-on engineer and the first member of ISACA 's AI implementation team, a new internal capability that will take on AI engineering work currently delivered by external vendors. Reporting to the VP, Application Engineering, and working within the platform architecture, standards, and governance set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture, Platforms & Agentic Systems, this role builds and hardens the AI solutions that serve ISACA 's members and business, both those in delivery today and those that emerge as ISACA 's AI portfolio grows. The initial focus is ISACA 's personalized member experience, a production RAG and knowledge graph-based recommendation system that integrates ISACA 's Body of Knowledge, certification details, workforce skills data, and member profile information. The majority of the role is spent implementing: writing production code, building data and retrieval pipelines, and operationalizing the engineering practices that keep AI systems reliable. Success is measured by production stability, the share of AI engineering work brought in-house, and the implementation team's growing ability to deliver ISACA 's current and future AI needs without vendor dependency. Responsibilities AI Platform Technical Contribution Provide hands-on engineering for the development, integration, and production delivery of ISACA 's AI solutions, beginning with the AI-driven member experience, working within the platform architecture and standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture. Build and maintain core AI components, including knowledge graph ontology and configuration (Graphwise or a comparable enterprise knowledge graph platform), embedding and retrieval pipelines, recommendation logic, and LLM-powered and agentic application components. Implement the APIs and service contracts that connect AI capabilities to ISACA 's digital experiences and business systems. Ensure all components are built for reuse, long-term internal ownership, and maintainability. AI Vendor Oversight & Insourcing Serve as the key internal technical counterpart to external AI development vendors and contractors. Participate in vendor architecture reviews and review vendor code and pull requests, evaluating AI solution designs, including RAG pipelines, knowledge graph implementation, and LLM integration, against ISACA 's technical requirements and the engineering standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture. Define and maintain acceptance criteria for vendor deliverables, support production readiness validation, and surface technical risk or delivery misalignment to the Senior Director, AI Architecture, and IT leadership. Lead knowledge transfer so that vendor-built components move to internal ownership on a planned timeline, progressively reducing vendor dependency. AI Engineering Practices & Operations Implement and operate MLOps and LLMOps practices in line with the platform standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture, including CI/CD for ML and LLM pipelines, model and prompt versioning, evaluation, monitoring, drift detection, and token cost tracking. Establish team-level engineering practices, including code review, documentation, runbooks, and reusable components, that promote quality and consistency across the implementation team and sustain ISACA 's AI solutions beyond any single initiative. Foster knowledge sharing so that expertise is built into the organization rather than held by individuals. Implement the security, responsible AI, and auditability controls defined by the Senior Director and Security within the AI solutions the team builds. Data Infrastructure & AI Data Enablement Build and maintain the data foundations that supply ISACA 's AI solutions with reliable, well-structured inputs. Implement ingestion and transformation pipelines from source systems such as CRM, third-party content and learning platforms, and external workforce and market trend data. Implement data contracts with source-system owners, plus data quality checks and monitoring aligned to the standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture. Identify and document gaps in ISACA 's current data architecture that limit AI performance or extensibility, and work with data, engineering, and product teams to close them. AI Implementation Team Building Serve as the first engineer on ISACA 's AI implementation team. Recommend roles and hiring sequence to bring outsourced AI engineering in-house, participate in hiring and onboarding, and mentor engineers and contractors. Stakeholder Communication Translate AI system decisions, technical risks, and engineering tradeoffs into clear, actionable communication for product, engineering and IT stakeholders. Collaborate across product, architecture, security, and data teams to ensure AI initiatives integrate coherently into ISACA ’s broader enterprise. Other Duties Evaluate emerging AI tools, platforms, and architectures through hands-on experimentation and proofs of concept, providing practical recommendations that support the Senior Director's build-versus-buy and platform decisions. Qualifications Required Field of Study: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Minimum Years of Experience Required: 8+ years of professional software, data, or application development experience, including 2+ years of hands-on experience developing, implementing, or integrating AI, generative AI, LLM-powered, or agentic AI solutions in production environments, beyond proof-of-concept work. Description of Minimum Relevant Experience Required: Production delivery of LLM-powered or AI solutions in cloud environments (Azure strongly preferred or equivalent), including experience with LLM integration, RAG pipeline architecture, and model evaluation beyond proof-of-concept work. Proficiency in Python and LLM application frameworks and SDKs; working knowledge of LLM evaluation, RAG pipeline performance tracking, and prompt versioning practices using tools such as Microsoft Foundry, Azure Promptflow, or equivalent evaluation frameworks. Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, prompt engineering, embedding-based semantic retrieval, vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, Pinecone, or Weaviate), and LLM orchestration. Familiarity with multi-agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Microsoft AutoGen, or comparable) is a plus. Hands-on experience with knowledge graph architectures and ontology design; direct Graphwise experience is a strong plus. Working knowledge of Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or Azure Cosmos DB provides transferable graph reasoning skills and is helpful. Foundational MLOps and LLMOps capability: CI/CD for ML and LLM pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), containerized deployment (Docker/Kubernetes), model and prompt versioning, monitoring, token cost tracking, and drift detection. Familiarity with data and workflow pipeline orchestration tools such as Azure Data Factory or Apache Airflow is a plus. Demonstrated ability to oversee AI vendor work through technical architecture review, acceptance criteria definition, and delivery validation. Strong stakeholder communication skills: proven ability to translate AI architecture decisions, risks, and tradeoffs for non-technical audiences including product and engineering stakeholders. Experience working in agile delivery environments with cross-functional product, engineering, data, and security teams. Preferred Field of Study: Masters Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or Artificial Intelligence Preferred Years of Experience: 10+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience developing, implementing, or integrating AI, generative AI, LLM-powered, or agentic AI solutions, ideally including early-stage or greenfield AI systems delivered at enterprise scale. Description of Preferred Relevant Experience: Experience contributing to or helping shape an AI or data practice — establishing engineering practices and delivery patterns. Experience helping build or scale an engineering team is beneficial. Domain literacy in IT governance, cybersecurity risk management, or professional certification ecosystems — sufficient to collaborate effectively with ISACA 's internal subject-matter experts and align AI outputs to organizational standards. Experience with knowledge graph reasoning, or GraphRAG patterns relevant to professional knowledge and competency ontology use cases. Familiarity with bias and fairness evaluation for AI-driven recommendation systems, including output-level testing for demographic or professional skew Prior experience working in a non-profit, professional association, standards body, or other mission-driven organization is a plus. Experience collaborating across hybrid delivery models including in-house staff, contractors, and external development vendors. Proficiency with Azure AI platforms, or equivalent services on AWS or GCP. Azure is the primary cloud platform for this role. Familiarity with enterprise platforms commonly used in ISACA 's ecosystem, such as Salesforce, Sitecore, and Microsoft Azure environments, is a plus. Working familiarity with responsible AI principles and general awareness of relevant AI regulatory trends. Certification and Licensing Preferred: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI App and Agent Developer Associate (AI-103) or MLOps Engineer Associate (AI-300); prior Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) also recognized AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional or Machine Learning Engineer – Associate, or Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer Competencies/Skills Required: Strong customer and member focus, with the ability to design and deliver AI systems that reflect ISACA ’s commitment to professional excellence and digital trust A senior hands-on engineer who writes production code, reviews vendor work, and helps grow an internal implementation team. Intellectual adaptability and continuous learning orientation; ability to rapidly develop fluency in new architectures and tools as they emerge. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking; ability to evaluate tradeoffs between innovation, delivery constraints, cost, and risk in early-stage AI programs Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to explain AI architecture decisions, technical risks, and engineering tradeoffs to technical and product stakeholders Collaborative working style, with the ability to build alignment across engineering, product, data, and security teams without direct authority. Self-starter capable of operating autonomously in environments with evolving requirements and incomplete information Commitment to ISACA ’s mission, purpose, and values; cultural sensitivity and awareness appropriate for a global professional membership organization. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Role: Senior Software Engineer Location: Wilmslow / Remote (UK) We are The Citation Group - a collective of businesses dedicated to supporting small and medium-sized enterprises across a range of essential services. We know that running a business means juggling a lot. Our mission is to ease these pressures by providing expertise, guidance, and solutions that enable business leaders to focus on what they do best. From HR and Health & Safety to Cybersecurity, E-Learning, and ISO compliance, we’ve got you covered. Citation Group has achieved strong growth through a combination of organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, continually broadening our expertise, services, and reach to create a one-stop shop that supports businesses across the UK, Canada and Australia. Role Purpose This is a hands-on engineering role at the heart of a significant platform transformation. You will be a core contributor to a squad that is actively changing how it builds, owns, and delivers software, and you will have real influence over the quality and direction of that work. We are moving from a traditional release cycle to CI/CD, shifting shared services into team-owned boundaries, and embedding AI into how the team thinks and delivers. This is not a role where you maintain the status quo. You will be working alongside a Tech Lead to drive those changes forward, bringing technical craft and an AI-native approach to everything you build. The right person for this role is someone who takes genuine pride in their work, wants to grow in a team that holds itself to a high standard, and is excited by the idea of building something better rather than just keeping things running. Key Responsibilities Hands-on Delivery Write production-quality code every day across the full stack, covering backend, front-end, and the infrastructure that supports it. Take ownership of features and workstreams from design through to deployment, delivering working software in shippable increments. Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, bringing well-reasoned input and a practical perspective. Run technical spikes and proofs-of-concept to explore approaches and reduce uncertainty before committing to a direction. Manage your own technical debt responsibly, keeping the codebase in a state you are proud of. Platform Transformation Play an active part in the decomposition of shared services into team-owned components, taking on defined pieces of that work and delivering them with care. Support the move to CI/CD by contributing to pipeline work, writing automated tests, and adopting trunk-based development as the default way of working. Build with observability in mind from the start, covering instrumentation, logging, and monitoring so that your team can see what their systems are doing in production. Contribute to the team's growing DevOps capability, taking on operational responsibility for the systems you build. Code Quality and Engineering Practice Write clean, testable, secure code and hold that standard consistently, not just when it is convenient. Practise test-driven development and contribute to a culture where good testing is the norm, using AI to generate scaffolding and explore edge cases as part of that workflow. Participate actively in code review, giving and receiving feedback that improves the work and raises the bar for the whole team. Apply secure coding practices as a matter of course: dependency management, threat awareness, and security testing. AI-Native Engineering Use AI natively in your engineering work, as part of how you think through problems, generate and review code, and build and test solutions. Contribute to AI-powered workflows that improve the team's delivery capability, whether that is in automation, testing, code generation, or observability. Engage actively with the team's AI agents and tooling, helping to refine and improve them as your understanding of what works deepens. Bring a critical eye to AI-generated output, verifying quality and maintaining the standards you would apply to anything else you ship. Collaboration and Growth Work closely with your Tech Lead and teammates through pairing, mob programming, and shared problem-solving. Support less experienced engineers where you can, sharing knowledge through code review, pairing, and day-to-day conversation. Contribute to planning, refinement, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives as an engaged and thoughtful team member. Take an active interest in your own development, staying current with the technologies and practices the team uses and bringing new ideas back to the team. Required Experience and Skills Technical Solid experience as a software engineer with a proven ability to deliver complex features on production systems. Strong full-stack capability across backend and front-end development, with experience working with databases and cloud infrastructure. Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code. Working knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) and containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes). Sound security fundamentals: secure coding, dependency management, and an awareness of common vulnerabilities. Experience working on evolving systems, including refactoring and improving existing codebases. AI-Native Engineering Practice Demonstrable experience using AI as a genuine part of your engineering workflow, not just as a code completion tool. Comfortable working with AI-generated output critically, knowing how to verify, refine, and take responsibility for what ships. Behavioural High standards: you care about the quality of your work and take pride in shipping something you can stand behind. Collaborative: you work well with others, share openly, and make the people around you better. Self-directed: you can take a piece of work, make sensible decisions, and see it through without constant oversight. Comfortable with change: you adapt well when priorities shift or approaches evolve, and you contribute positively to that process. Curious and committed to learning: you keep developing your skills and bring new thinking back to the team. Nice to Have Experience in B2B SaaS or Citation domains such as HR, Health and Safety, Compliance, Certification, or eLearning. Experience building or contributing to AI agents or automated workflows in a production context. Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, or reactive systems. Contributions to open source or active participation in technical communities. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description: Lumexa Imaging is one of the country's largest providers of outpatient medical imaging. With over 5,000 team members and more than 185 outpatient imaging centers across 13 states, our team conducts more than 4 million outpatient studies annually. We are the partner of choice for health systems and radiologists, delivering best-in-class clinical excellence, operations, and state-of-the-art technology across our platform. We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer with deep expertise in public cloud Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) across AWS and Microsoft Azure, with strong skills in cloud networking, identity, automation, and platform engineering. The ideal candidate will excel in designing, deploying, and optimizing scalable cloud environments, with a strong emphasis on virtual network architecture (AWS VPC / Azure VNet), inter network connectivity, cloud routing, private service endpoints (AWS PrivateLink / Azure Private Endpoints), DNS (Route 53 / Azure DNS), and hybrid network integrations using VPN and dedicated circuits (AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute). This role requires hands on experience implementing secure, high performance solutions using core cloud services such as compute (EC2 / Azure VMs), identity (IAM / Azure AD), serverless (Lambda / Azure Functions), API management (API Gateway / Azure API Management), monitoring (CloudWatch / Azure Monitor), logging (CloudTrail / Azure Activity Logs), object storage (S3 / Azure Blob), relational databases (RDS / Azure SQL), and load balancing (ELB/ALB/NLB / Azure Load Balancer & Application Gateway). The engineer will leverage cloud native networking and security controls—including security groups / NSGs, NACLs / Azure Firewall rules, AWS Network Firewall / Azure Firewall, WAF (AWS/Azure), and DDoS protection (AWS Shield / Azure DDoS Protection)—to build resilient, well architected systems aligned with best practices. The Senior Cloud Engineer will play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, improving network resiliency, and driving automation through services like CloudFormation / Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Terraform, Systems Manager / Azure Automation, and AWS Config / Azure Policy. Essential Duties and Responsibilities – Design, implement, and manage multi cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure) with a focus on high availability, scalability, performance, and security. Architect and maintain cloud networking solutions including AWS VPCs / Azure VNets, subnets, routing, load balancing, Transit Gateway / Azure Virtual WAN, PrivateLink / Azure Private Endpoints, and hybrid connectivity using VPN, Direct Connect, and ExpressRoute. Collaborate closely with development, security, and operations teams to deploy and support cloud based applications, services, and platforms across AWS and Azure. Automate provisioning, configuration, and operational workflows using AWS CloudFormation, Azure ARM/Bicep, Terraform, Ansible, and other infrastructure as code tools. Monitor system health, analyze performance metrics, and conduct capacity planning using CloudWatch / Azure Monitor, ensuring reliable and efficient cloud operations. Implement and enforce cloud security best practices, including IAM / Azure AD RBAC governance, network segmentation, encryption, and compliance with frameworks such as HIPAA and Sarbanes Oxley. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure and networking issues across AWS and Azure, performing root cause analysis and driving long term remediation. Continuously evaluate emerging cloud services, tools, and architectural patterns across AWS and Azure to improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency. Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers and cross functional team members. Create and maintain detailed documentation for architecture, operational processes, standards, and troubleshooting procedures. Required Skills Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Minimum of 6 years of hands on experience in cloud engineering or similar roles, with strong experience in AWS and Microsoft Azure. Deep expertise with core cloud services including EC2 / Azure VMs, S3 / Azure Blob, VPC / VNet, IAM / Azure AD, Lambda / Azure Functions, CloudWatch / Azure Monitor, CloudTrail / Azure Activity Logs, RDS / Azure SQL, Route 53 / Azure DNS, ELB/ALB/NLB / Azure Load Balancer & Application Gateway, and Auto Scaling / Azure VM Scale Sets. Strong proficiency in cloud networking concepts such as VPC/VNet design, subnetting, routing, Transit Gateway / Virtual WAN, PrivateLink / Private Endpoints, Direct Connect / ExpressRoute, VPN, NACLs / NSGs, security groups, and load balancing strategies. Experience with additional cloud services commonly used in enterprise environments, such as CloudFront / Azure Front Door, SQS/SNS / Azure Service Bus & Event Grid, KMS / Azure Key Vault, EFS/EBS / Azure Files & Managed Disks, SSM / Azure Automation, AWS Config / Azure Policy, and AWS Backup / Azure Backup. Familiarity with cloud security services including AWS WAF / Azure WAF, Shield / Azure DDoS Protection, Network Firewall / Azure Firewall, GuardDuty / Azure Defender, and Security Hub / Azure Security Center. Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Azure ARM/Bicep, or similar automation frameworks. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline / Azure DevOps Pipelines. Strong understanding of cloud networking, security principles, identity management, and troubleshooting methodologies across AWS and Azure. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, ECS, AKS, and Kubernetes/EKS. Hands on experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as CloudWatch / Azure Monitor, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana. Familiarity with Linux system administration, shell scripting, and operational tooling. Experience with both AWS and Azure is strongly preferred. AWS and Azure certifications (Solutions Architect, SysOps, DevOps Engineer, or Advanced Networking) are highly desirable. Lumexa Imaging provides a competitive compensation program to attract, retain, and motivate a high-performance workforce. Lumexa Imaging is an equal opportunity employer. You like being part of a team with a reputation for excellence that gives back to the community by educating, mentoring, and sponsoring. You want to work on products and accounts with outsized impact and reach. You believe in sweating the details, committing to quality, and taking pride in going the extra mile. What you bring to the table At least 7-10 years of software engineering experience, preferably in a consulting environment or as part of an in-house, cross-functional product team. Experience building consumer-facing native mobile and web applications, with a fluent command of the native languages and core frameworks. Demonstrated expertise architecting, building, maintaining, and scaling modern software on various platforms. title: Senior Staff Software Engineer

Older modernization roadmaps lacked long-term retirement strategies for core mainframes so IRS leadership rolled out a new technical framework stretching through 2029 with heavy emphasis on building a Unified API Layer to unlock legacy data. The IRS plans to wrap up its move toward a single, unified Enterprise Case Management (ECM) system. This platform will consolidate siloed databases and allow employees to support taxpayers from a single interface. Fiscal Year 2028 Target : This is the projected completion window for updating the critical Individual Master File (IMF). By establishing a solid data structure and robust DevOps pipeline (using tools like SFDX and Git), the subcontractor we are hiring for helps create the stable infrastructure required for the IRS Office of Chief Counsel, the Taxpayer Advocate Service, and the Office of Appeals to safely adopt these modern AI systems. Please read the below for the job requirements and qualifications needed for this exciting multi-year project for the IRS and apply immediately if you are interested. title: Full Stack Microsoft Developer
description: At The Battery Network , we are leading the charge to turn yesterday’s batteries into tomorrow’s power. As the nation’s premier battery collection and recycling nonprofit, we’ve spent over three decades leading the charge toward a cleaner planet and a circular economy. We connect consumers, businesses, manufacturers, and municipalities through one trusted network. We provide education, collection, logistics, and compliance expertise, helping our partners stay ahead of regulation while capturing the critical materials that power the future. We keep valuable materials in circulation and out of landfills—reducing reliance on foreign supply chains, strengthening America’s energy independence, and protecting people, property, and the planet. We’re looking for passionate changemakers to help us scale our impact and shape the future of sustainability. If you're ready to turn purpose into action, you’ll thrive in our mission-driven, collaborative environment.Learn more at and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, or LinkedIn. POSITION SUMMARY The Full Stack Microsoft Developer designs, builds, integrates, and supports secure, production-ready solutions across The Battery Network ’s Microsoft application environment. The role supports business leaders, product owners, operations teams, and technical partners by connecting customer-facingapplications with enterprise platforms including Dynamics 365 CRM, Business Central, Power Platform, and Azure services. The work is weighted toward backend and integration delivery while also requiring practical frontend development capability. Success is measured through reliable releases, maintainable code, secure integrations, responsive user experiences, and timely resolutions of production issues. MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Duties and responsibilities of this role include but are not limited to the following: Design, develop, test, deploy, and support secure APIs, services, and integrations using C#, modern .NET, Azure API Management, App Services, Azure Functions, Durable Functions, and related Azure services so that business systems exchange data reliably. Build and maintain integrations among Dynamics 365 CRM, Business Central, Power Platform, Microsoft Graph, web applications, and external systems using reusable APIs, events, workflows, and service components. Implement secure authentication, authorization, secret management, logging, and cloud-hosting practices using OAuth 2.0, Microsoft Entra identity patterns, Azure Key Vault, telemetry, and Application Insights. Develop responsive, accessible, and user-friendly web experiences using React, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and component-based development practices. Translate business requirements, wireframes, and prototypes into pragmatic technical designs and working features that balance maintainability, performance, security, delivery speed, and long-term platform health. Monitor and troubleshoot production applications and integrations, complete root-cause analysis, resolve defects, and reduce recurring issues and technical debt. Use GitHub and/or Azure DevOps for source control, pull requests, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, work tracking, and documentation to improve release quality and team continuity. Collaborate with developers, architects, business analysts, product owners, PMO, QA, vendors, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve delivery blockers, document solutions, and continuously improve development practices. CORE QUALIFICATIONS Demonstrated ability to deliver full-stack web applications through professional work, substantial projects, technical training, military service, community experience, or another relevant path. Strong hands-on capability with C#, modern .NET, RESTful APIs, JSON, API security, and Azure-hosted application or integration services. Ability to design and troubleshoot integrations with enterprise business systems such as Dynamics 365 CRM, Business Central, Power Platform, or comparable CRM/ERP platforms. Ability to build API-connected user interfaces using React, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design practices. Ability to review, refactor, test, and document code so that solutions remain secure, understandable, and supportable. Must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States for The Battery Network , with or without sponsorship. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with Azure services such as API Management, App Services, Functions, Durable Functions, Storage, Key Vault, Application Insights, Service Bus, Event Grid, and Azure SQL. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field and 5+ years of relevant full-stack development, application integration, or Microsoft cloud platform experience; OR 7+ years of equivalent experience preferred. Experience integrating Dynamics 365 CRM and Business Central through APIs, Dataverse, Power Automate, webhooks, events, or middleware patterns. Experience with Microsoft Graph, Microsoft 365 APIs, Power Platform, Power BI integrations, or Power Pages. Familiarity with Bootstrap, JSON Forms, Liquid templates, Blazor, Entity Framework, SignalR, or other Microsoft web technologies. Experience with accessibility, localization, responsive design, cross-browser testing, automated testing, observability, and production support. SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, & EXPERIENCE Technical judgment demonstrated by translating ambiguous business needs into practical options and clearly identifying dependencies, risks, and trade-offs. Ownership demonstrated by following work from design through release and production support, documenting decisions, and resolving issues rather than passing them forward. Collaboration demonstrated through constructive code reviews, clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and reliable follow-through across teams. Problem-solving demonstrated through structured troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and improvements that reduce repeat defects or support burden. Adaptability and curiosity when priorities, technologies, or business needs change, including willingness to work across backend, integration, frontend, cloud, and support responsibilities. Demonstrates a genuine commitment to thriving in a mission-based organization where culture and values are paramount, and where diversity, equity, inclusion, collaboration, and innovation are embedded in the way work gets done. WORKING CONDITIONS This position is remote based within the United States. Candidates must be able to work from a U.S.-based location and be eligible to work lawfully in the United States for The Battery Network . Limited travel (estimated 3-4 times per year) as needed. Travel could include, but not be limited to, attending conferences, customer meetings, or team/organization-wide meetings. Standard work hours are Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day. Some roles may require additional hours during peak periods. We prioritize the quality and timeliness of work over rigid schedules and recognize the importance of connection, collaboration, and work-life balance. To support this, we offer flexible schedulingwhere roles allow, and in alignment with current policy, while ensuring operational needs and team collaboration are met. ABOUT THE BATTERY NETWORK At The Battery Network , we enjoy a culture of teamwork, innovation, and fun. Our team is the primary reason for our unique culture. We hire energetic and dedicated people who are committed to helping us achieve our goals. Each one of our employees is a valued contributor, not just a number. We work in teams to benefit from our collective talents to make a real impact on the environment. The way we operate contributes to the success of our employees and our organization. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion as core values, and believe everyone’s unique perspective is critical to our success . Diversity and intercultural collaboration are fundamental to what we do. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, marital status, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Sr. Engineer, Product Cyber Security
description: As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. We are the people who give possibilities purpose BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. Job Description Summary We are seeking a Senior Product Cyber Security Engineer to own the cybersecurity deliverables for assigned products end to end and to build the automation that lets a small team cover a large portfolio. You will plan the security activities for each release, lead threat modeling, run composition and static analysis, produce and monitor Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), coordinate penetration tests, and write the documentation that goes into our design history files, regulatory submissions and customer assurance packages. This is a product security engineering role, not an IT security, SOC or penetration testing role. You will read code, work in build pipelines, and defend your risk assessments in front of auditors, regulators and customers. You will work daily with R&D, Software Engineering, DevOps, Systems Engineering, Quality and Regulatory Affairs, and with our corporate product security and cyber risk teams. This position is remote within the United States, with regular overlap with Pacific time working hours. Key Responsibilities Product Cybersecurity Planning and Deliverables Own the cybersecurity plan and the Product Security Management Plan for assigned products, covering new development, major releases and sustaining changes, in line with our product cybersecurity procedures. Produce the required deliverable set for each product: product security requirements gap analysis, threat model and data flow map, Product Security White Paper, Incident and Vulnerability Management Plan, Patch Management Plan, Cybersecurity Risk Summary Report, and third-party vendor assessments. Decide with the team which deliverables apply to each product, scale them to the product's risk and regulatory status (research-use-only versus IVD), and document every exemption with its justification. Keep the Product Security Management File complete, traceable and ready for FDA inspections and notified-body audits. Threat Modeling and Risk Assessment Lead STRIDE-based threat modeling sessions with product teams: assets, data flows, trust boundaries, threats, controls, and the risk register entries that result. Assess products against our product security requirements, score findings with CVSS, and work with R&D on remediation or documented risk acceptance. Document unresolved and accepted risks in the Cybersecurity Risk Summary Report that supports release decisions, and feed cybersecurity hazards into the product risk management file where patient safety is affected. Security Testing, SBOM and Vulnerability Management Run static code analysis and software composition analysis (e.g., Snyk) on product releases, triage findings with engineering, and archive the reports. Generate and validate CycloneDX SBOMs from the actual release artifacts of every software-enabled product, integrate SBOM generation into build and release pipelines, and load SBOMs into our post-market vulnerability monitoring tool (e.g., CyBeats). Monitor post-market vulnerability reports against product SBOMs, assess impact with R&D, and drive remediation within the timelines our procedures set. Coordinate penetration tests with our corporate product security engineering team: define scope from the roadmap, schedule tests early in development and before submissions, evaluate results and assess mitigations. Support investigation of externally reported vulnerabilities and potential cybersecurity complaints together with our corporate cyber risk team. Patch Management and Secure Baselines Maintain product Patch Management Plans and author or review Security Patch Verification Protocols and Reports. Deliver the annual operating system patch verification bulletins for IVD products in the patch verification program. Contribute to hardened Windows 11 baseline images for instrument workstations and to the process for managing product-level exceptions. Customer and Regulatory Assurance Assemble cyber assurance packages for key customers (SBOMs, Product Security White Papers, penetration test attestations, SOC 2 summaries) and answer customer security questionnaires. Prepare the cybersecurity content of regulatory submissions (FDA premarket cybersecurity requirements, EU IVDR) and support internal reviews, audits and regulator interactions. Review third-party security checklists and SOC 2 reports for third-party software and services used in or with our products. Automation, Metrics and Scaling Build and maintain scripts and pipeline steps that generate SBOMs, scan results and audit evidence automatically, so deliverables stay current with every release instead of being rebuilt by hand. Produce cross-portfolio security risk reporting and in-market risk metrics for leadership, and keep work-item tracking for security activities current. Help evaluate and adopt AI-assisted tooling for drafting and checking security documentation. Contribute to updates of our product security procedures and security requirements as corporate policy, FDA expectations and submission feedback evolve. Cross-Functional Guidance Act as the product security subject matter expert for R&D, DevOps, Quality, Regulatory and partner teams. Provide practical guidance on secure design, secure update and installation mechanisms, vulnerability remediation and compliance expectations. What Success Looks Like in the First Year Within 90 days: you own the cybersecurity deliverables for one product release end to end, from the cybersecurity plan to the Cybersecurity Risk Summary Report. Within six months: SBOM generation and composition analysis run automatically in the build for the products you support, with results loaded into post-market monitoring. Within twelve months: you cover two to three products in parallel, penetration tests and patch verification bulletins for your products are delivered on schedule, and leadership receives regular in-market risk metrics for them. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of experience in software engineering, product or application security, or cybersecurity engineering, including hands-on security work on software products that shipped to customers. Basic software engineering fluency: you read and write code in some language, you are comfortable with commandline, you are aware of build systems and package ecosystems (npm, pip, NuGet) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar). Hands-on experience with threat modeling (STRIDE or similar), vulnerability assessment, CVSS scoring, remediation workflows and risk acceptance. Experience with static analysis and software composition analysis tools and with SBOM formats (CycloneDX or SPDX). Experience producing formal security deliverables (threat models, risk assessments, vulnerability reports, SBOMs) that have been reviewed in audits or regulatory submissions. Strong written communication: clear, structured technical documentation in English suitable for auditors, regulators and customers. Demonstrated ability to run several product workstreams in parallel in a procedure-driven, documentation-heavy environment, with a bias toward automation and reuse over manual effort. Preferred Qualifications Experience in medical devices, in vitro diagnostics, life sciences or other regulated software, including familiarity with FDA premarket cybersecurity guidance (section 524B), EU MDR/IVDR, ISO 14971, AAMI TIR57, IEC 81001-5-1 or UL 2900. Experience with Snyk, CyBeats or similar composition analysis and SBOM monitoring platforms, and with vulnerability scanners such as Tenable or Qualys. Experience with Windows operating system hardening, image management and security patch verification. Experience coordinating penetration tests and performing supplier security assessments (third-party checklists, SOC 2 report reviews). Experience building security metrics, dashboards or operational reporting. Experience using AI and large language model tools to accelerate documentation and analysis while keeping outputs reviewable and traceable. Experience supporting FDA inspections, notified-body audits or ISO 13485 quality system audits. Why Join Us? To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD , you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success. To learn more about BD visit . title: Head of Engineering
description: ﻿ ﻿ Welcome to MICE DESK ﻿ MICE DESK is the leading European company automating the sales process in the hospitality industry — and we are now expanding to the US. Our platform, Rocket , turns event, meeting, and group inquiries into autonomous end-to- end workflows: from RFP to signed contract, across email, CRM, and PMS systems. We are a Series A-stage company with a deliberately small team and real enterprise traction: major hotel groups across Europe run their group sales on Rocket. The people joining now shape the product, the deployment playbook, and the culture. ﻿﻿ The Role You own engineering at MICE DESK . Fully. There is no CTO layer above you — our technical co-founder is moving into the CPO role, and engineering direction, architecture, delivery, and team are yours. You report directly to the founders. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will lead the engineering team including our AI/Data function, own the interface to Product, and be accountable for everything that ships. ﻿ What You Will Own 1. Engineering, end-to-end. Architecture, system design, delivery against the roadmap, reliability, and technical debt. Backend, frontend, DevOps, QA, and the AI/Data team all roll up to you. You set lightweight processes that make a small team ship fast without breaking things. 2. An AI-enabled engineering pipeline. We don't just build AI products — we build with AI. You will push the engineering organization itself to be AI-native: agentic coding workflows, AI-assisted review and testing, automation of everything repetitive. A team of [10] should ship like a team of 30, and making that true is your job. 3 . AI as a core system capability. Architect the integration of LLMs and agentic workflows into production systems: combining deterministic logic with AI-generated outputs, with real validation, fallback, and reliability strategies. Hospitality operations run on our platform — non-determinism is not an excuse for unreliability. 4. The team. Hire, mentor, and scale. You inherit a strong small team and grow it into a high-performance engineering organization with a culture of ownership and speed. You will also own our distributed hiring strategy [Germany + Armenia — confirm]. 5. Product and business alignment. Work directly with the founders and Product. Challenge requirements, simplify complexity, and connect engineering work to outcomes: revenue, automation, customer impact. As we enter the US market, engineering has to keep pace with enterprise-scale customers on two continents. ﻿ What Success Looks Like 6 months : Delivery is predictable, the AI-enabled dev pipeline is running, and the team has grown with A-players you hired. 12 months: The platform scales with US enterprise customers, core systems are reliable and observable, and engineering is a competitive advantage — not a bottleneck. ﻿ Who You Are ﻿ Must-have ﻿﻿ 10+ years of software engineering, 5+ in engineering leadership at high-growth product companies Strong hands-on backend or full-stack background — you can still go deep Proven experience scaling engineering teams at Series A–C startups Strong architecture expertise: APIs, distributed systems, event-driven design, cloud LLM / agentic AI systems in production — and conviction about AI-assisted engineering itself Product mindset; you connect technical decisions to business outcomes Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and full accountability ﻿Nice-to-have Hospitality tech, CRM, PMS, or revenue management background Enterprise integration experience (Salesforce, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Microsoft Graph API) Experience leading distributed/international teams Hiring Process I ntro i nt e rv ie w — background, leadership experience, motivation Tech n ical & leade rs hi p dee p di v e — architecture, system design, team scaling, AI-native development F oun de r i nt e rv ie w — product vision, ownership, long-term impact Wh y MICE DESK Full ownership ofengineering at the European market leader, now going to the US Real enterprise integrations and real-world workﬂows — not a demo product A Series A company where your decisions shape the product, the architecture, and the culture ﻿ Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. You will leverage your expertise in Azure, Python, SQL, and modern data platforms to develop scalable data pipelines, integrate data from multiple sources, and ensure the reliability, security, and performance of enterprise data ecosystems. Build and optimize data transformation solutions using Python and SQL, ensuring efficient processing of large and complex datasets. Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, governance, security, and modern data architecture principles, including Lakehouse and cloud-native data platforms.
