title: Senior AI Engineer
description: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full. Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare. AI Proficiency at Sword AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work. Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role. Role: The Internal AI Solutions Team leads the transformation of the company’s internal processes through Generative AI, improving how teams operate across the organization. We work closely with business teams to understand how work actually gets done, identify opportunities to simplify and redesign processes, and build AI powered solutions that create measurable operational impact. We’re a small, highly autonomous team with a working style similar to an early stage company. Roles are highly generalist, and we value people who are proactive, pragmatic, and comfortable moving from understanding a business problem to designing and implementing the solution. For this role, you will work particularly closely with the Operations team, helping identify and solve both complex and repetitive operational challenges through process improvement, automation, and AI. What you’ll be doing: Working closely with business stakeholders to deeply understand existing workflows, pain points, bottlenecks, and manual processes; Proactively identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or redesign processes, rather than only responding to predefined technical requirements; Translating operational problems into pragmatic AI powered tools, automations, and software solutions; Owning solutions end-to-end, from process discovery and solution design through implementation, deployment, adoption, and iteration; Building and integrating AI-driven applications using LLMs, APIs, internal systems, and workflow automation; Handling both front-end and back-end development when needed, ensuring seamless integration across our tech stack; Measuring the impact of implemented solutions and continuously improving them based on user feedback, operational metrics, and observed outcomes. What you need to have: At least 3 years of experience in software engineering, automation, AI engineering, or a similarly technical role; Strong hands-on proficiency in JavaScript (React, Node.js) and/or Python; Experience building practical software solutions and integrating multiple systems through APIs; Hands-on experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent models; Proficiency in SQL and confidence working with data to understand processes and measure outcomes; A strong continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to analyze how a process works today and identify ways to make it simpler, faster, more reliable, or more scalable; Experience working directly with business or operational stakeholders to turn ambiguous problems into concrete solutions; Strong analytical and problem solving skills, particularly in environments where the problem is not fully defined upfront; High levels of ownership and autonomy, with a bias toward experimentation and execution; Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non technical teams. What we would love to see: Experience with Lean, Kaizen, continuous improvement, process engineering, or operational excellence methodologies; Experience automating operational workflows or transforming manual business processes; Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and integrating structured and unstructured data into LLM workflows; Practical experience building or orchestrating AI agents; Experience with workflow automation platforms or agentic systems; Familiarity with cloud services such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud; Understanding of AI governance principles. *The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role. This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact. Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation. Total Compensation Range €50.400—€72.000 EUR Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately. Sword Health complies with applicable Federal and State civil rights laws and does not discriminate on the basis of Age, Ancestry, Color, Citizenship, Gender, Gender expression, Gender identity, Gender information, Marital status, Medical condition, National origin, Physical or mental disability, Pregnancy, Race, Religion, Caste, Sexual orientation, and Veteran status. title: Sr. Software Engineer (TCF)
description: Job Title: Sr. Software Engineer (TCF) Job Description We're Concentrix . The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. In our Information Technology and Global Security team, you will deliver the latest technology infrastructure, transformative software solutions and industry-leading global security for our staff and clients. You will work with the best in the world to design, implement and strategize IT, security, application development, innovation, and solutions in today’s hyperconnected world. You will be part of the technology team that is core to our vision of develop, build and run the future of Integrated Services. Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year. We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are. Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures. Design, build, and integrate the patient, clinic staff, and doctor applications on a cloud-native, AI-enabled healthcare platform running on GCP and Azure. You will work across all Experience and Care apps and their integrations with external healthcare systems, and you’ll extend the existing .NET clinic app rather than start over. Responsibilities Build features end to end: React/Next.js web screens, React Native mobile screens, .NET (ASP.NET Core) APIs, and the PostgreSQL data behind them. Deliver Phase 2 features: the mobile app, teleconsultation, medication management, the feedback/survey platform, and AI assistants for patients, clinic staff, and doctors/specialists. Build and maintain connectors to labs, EHRs, imaging (PACS), pharmacies, payers, and devices using FHIR, HL7v2, DICOM, REST/SOAP, SFTP, and webhooks. Map partner data to FHIR resources and validate it. Match patients and orders, quarantine records that don’t match, and support reconciliation and replay. Build long-running clinical workflows in Temporal (.NET SDK), such as lab orders, result review, critical result alerts, and medication change approvals. Use idempotency, the outbox pattern, and event messaging (Kafka, Pub/Sub, or Service Bus) so no clinical action is lost or duplicated. Connect AI assistant features to care services through secure, permission-scoped tools, and require clinician approval before AI output affects clinical records. Build secure login, consent, and access rules by tenant, patient, and purpose of use (OIDC, OPA). Secure partner connections with mTLS/OAuth. Package and deploy services as containers on Kubernetes (GKE/AKS) through CI/CD and GitOps, with health checks and autoscaling. Keep patient data out of logs, caches, and the browser. Write unit and integration tests. Review code and mentor engineers. Complete all assigned, mandatory training within the timeframe provided Conduct and/or participate in regularly scheduled 1:1 meetings with direct manager and/or direct reports Requirements 5+ years in full stack development. Strong C#/.NET skills (ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, Web API). Strong React/TypeScript skills (Next.js). React Native experience. Hands-on healthcare integration experience with at least one of FHIR, HL7v2, or DICOM. Experience with PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL, messaging/event-driven systems, and OIDC/OAuth2. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes (GKE or AKS), and CI/CD pipelines. Experience integrating LLM/AI features into applications, such as calling model APIs, retrieval (RAG), or tool calling. Strong plus: Temporal or another workflow engine, Mirth Connect, HAPI FHIR, WebRTC/LiveKit, OPA, and HIPAA or data privacy experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. Location: PHL Work-at-Home Language Requirements: Time Type: Full time Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Agentic Engineer [Zeal]
description: Zeal is an AI-enabled software consultancy purpose-built for Fortune 1000 companies, and we’re now part of Livefront . We help companies navigate technology to drive business outcomes by attracting, retaining, and growing exceptional talent and empowering them to use innovative technologies and process frameworks. We’re a values-driven technology company grounded in kindness, generosity, and integrity. Our mission is to build a place where our employees love their future and where clients trust us to deliver what we promise: to improve their business through technology. Love your future. We’re looking for an outstanding Agentic Engineer to join our team. Who you are You are a pragmatic, hands-on engineer who has built and shipped agentic AI systems into production. You understand that getting an agent to work is only part of the challenge. You know how to build systems that continue to work safely and reliably with real data, enterprise security requirements, and meaningful consequences when something goes wrong. You communicate clearly with clients and technical peers, make thoughtful architectural decisions, and are comfortable explaining why an agent behaved the way it did. You have strong software engineering fundamentals and the judgment to recognize when an agent is the right solution and when a simpler, deterministic approach is better. What you will be doing Work directly with clients to understand complex business problems and translate them into scalable, production-ready agentic AI solutions. Design and implement multi-step agent systems, including orchestration, tool and function calling, task decomposition, and, when appropriate, multi-agent coordination. Build integrations between agents and enterprise systems by exposing APIs as tools, implementing MCP servers, and developing structured tool contracts. Design evaluation frameworks, guardrails, grounding and citation checks, and human-in-the-loop workflows that identify and manage agent failures before they reach users. Instrument agent systems for traceability and observability, including agent actions, model behavior, token and cost usage, latency, and system performance. Design and maintain state and memory across long-running workflows and implement model routing, retries, idempotency, and other patterns required for reliable production systems. Build and deploy AI solutions using cloud platforms and services such as: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, AKS, or related Azure technologies; Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, ECS, EKS, or related AWS technologies. Apply strong software engineering practices using Python, Java, APIs, containers, source control, automated testing, and CI/CD. Work directly with client engineering and security teams through architecture reviews, threat modeling, security reviews, audits, and other enterprise delivery requirements. Evaluate when agentic architectures are appropriate and when deterministic pipelines, traditional machine learning, or other approaches are more reliable and cost-effective. Turn successful approaches from client engagements into reusable patterns and solutions that can be applied across Zeal. Build trust with clients and internal teams through strong communication, technical judgment, problem-solving, and execution. Why you should apply You want to work with passionate, talented people who are always looking for ways to make things better. You value a work environment where kindness, mutual trust, and egoless collaboration are paramount. You have a history of keeping promises, doing what is right, and spending energy on what matters. You enjoy the variety and growth that comes with consulting for Fortune 1000 companies across industries and technical stacks. You want to work on projects that have outsized impact and reach. You believe in sweating the details, committing to quality, and taking pride in going the extra mile. What you bring to the table We expect candidates to demonstrate a strong software engineering foundation, hands-on experience building agentic AI systems in production, and a keen interest in consulting. Agentic AI: Hands-on experience designing and shipping production agent systems involving tool and function calling, multi-step workflows, orchestration, task decomposition, or multi-agent architectures. You can explain the architectural decisions you made, what failed, and what you learned. Evaluation & Reliability: Real-world experience evaluating agent behavior and measuring system failures, including building evaluation harnesses, guardrails, grounding checks, human-in-the-loop controls, and other mechanisms that prevent or mitigate errors. Cloud Technologies: Deep hands-on experience with either Azure or AWS and the AI and infrastructure services surrounding them, such as Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Search, AKS, Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, ECS, or EKS. Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python or Java, API design, containers, automated testing, source control, and CI/CD, with enough machine learning knowledge to determine when traditional ML or deterministic approaches are more appropriate than an LLM. Enterprise Delivery: Experience delivering software within large organizations and working through requirements such as role-based access, data isolation, security reviews, compliance, change control, and production governance. Agent Observability: Experience designing systems for traceability, state and memory management, model routing, latency and cost visibility, retries, idempotency, and other operational concerns associated with production agent systems. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to explain complex AI systems, architectural decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Problem-Solving: Strong technical judgment and a demonstrated willingness to challenge assumptions, including recognizing when an agentic solution introduces unnecessary complexity and a deterministic approach would be more appropriate. Experience with MCP and emerging tool-interoperability standards, evaluation frameworks such as RAGAS, fine-tuning, model distillation or optimization, and highly regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, or manufacturing is helpful, but not required. What to expect When applying, please include a short note about yourself, a summary of your work experience, and a link to any public profiles you actively maintain (e.g., GitHub, LinkedIn). Our hiring process moves quickly and consists of several stages for candidates who capture our attention with their initial submission, sometimes including but not limited to a short preliminary phone interview, a series of video interviews, and a short take-home exercise, which you'll have up to a week to complete. Compensation is $130,000 - $165,000 per year Additional information We go out of our way to evaluate all employees and job applicants equitably based on merit, competence, and qualifications. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply, and we consider every applicant with an open mind. Don't worry, every application will be reviewed by a human. title: Staff Product Marketing Manager, Cloud Risk & Developer Security
description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role: CrowdStrike is looking for a Staff Product Marketing Manager to lead product marketing for the Proactive Security portfolio within Falcon Cloud Security, spanning Cloud Risk and Developer Security. This senior individual contributor will define how we help customers identify and prioritize risk, prevent issues from reaching production, and remediate them at the source. You will own positioning, launches, core marketing materials, field readiness, analyst engagement, and adoption. As a strategic thought partner to Product and CTO leaders, you will bring a clear, evidence-backed view of market direction and customer needs to help inform product strategy and establish CrowdStrike's leadership in proactive security. The ideal candidate combines deep cloud and application security expertise with independent strategic judgment, exceptional storytelling, and hands-on execution. You are comfortable shaping future-facing strategy and personally producing high-quality work that earns credibility with practitioners, analysts, Product leaders, and executives. What You'll Do: Own portfolio strategy and launches – Define the market thesis, target audiences, customer problems, priority use cases, positioning, messaging architecture, competitive strategy, and core marketing bill of materials. Lead launches with clear owners, milestones, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes. Help shape the future of proactive security – Partner with Product and CTO leaders on market direction, category evolution, competitive shifts, and technical trends. Bring customer, field, and analyst insight into strategic discussions. Identify capability gaps, emerging use cases, packaging opportunities, and product experience improvements, and recommend priorities and tradeoffs that inform Product-led roadmap planning and go-to-market strategy. Build technical credibility and proof – Create demos, architecture walkthroughs, technical content, customer stories, and code-to-cloud use cases for developers, DevSecOps, AppSec, platform engineers, and cloud security teams. Explain workflows, differentiation, outcomes, and limitations, grounding claims in validated documentation, customer evidence, threat intelligence, or subject-matter expertise. Establish thought leadership – Develop a differentiated point of view on cloud risk, developer security, software supply chain threats, shift-left security, code-to-cloud remediation, AI-driven risk investigation, and the convergence of cloud security and exposure management. Bring it to market through technical content, presentations, events, and executive narratives. Lead portfolio analyst engagement – Own briefings, inquiries, evaluations, research responses, and competitive assessments in partnership with Analyst Relations. Align portfolio narratives with broader CNAPP positioning and major market evaluations. Drive field readiness, adoption, and competitive success – Equip sellers and sales engineers with discovery questions, technical proof, demo paths, competitive guidance, and objection handling. Engage customers to validate messaging and buying criteria, identify adoption barriers, and inform Product and go-to-market planning. Use pipeline, win/loss, product usage, and customer feedback to refine priorities and measure impact. What You'll Need: 8+ years of relevant experience in product marketing, product management, technical marketing, or related enterprise cybersecurity roles, including significant cloud security, application security, DevSecOps, or exposure management experience. End-to-end portfolio ownership, including market strategy, roadmap input, positioning, launches, analyst engagement, field readiness, adoption, and competitive response. Deep knowledge of proactive cloud and application security, including CNAPP, CSPM, KSPM, CIEM, cloud vulnerability management, attack paths, exposure analysis, risk prioritization, software supply chain security, and code-to-cloud remediation. Strong developer security expertise, including infrastructure as code, software composition analysis, secrets, CI/CD security, container and image security, Kubernetes admission controls, ASPM, and the relationship between build-time risk and runtime context. Strong understanding of AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud, including cloud architectures, identities, developer workflows, infrastructure automation, and cloud-native development. Exceptional writing, positioning, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to personally produce technically accurate, evidence-backed materials that resonate with practitioners, buyers, analysts, and executives. Independent judgment and operational discipline, including source-supported competitive analysis, cross-functional leadership, senior stakeholder influence, and the ability to manage ambiguity, incorporate feedback, surface risks early, and deliver multiple priorities without direct authority. Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. title: Yourgi Director of Product
description: Who we are: Yourgi is on a mission to become Earth's most trusted pet care connector, connecting pet parents with a reliable local network of certified professionals, pet resorts, and veterinary centers. Backed by a passionate team, our mission is to make pet care simple, accessible, and joyful for all. Because pets aren't just animals—they're family. Yourgi grows two ways: pet parents completing bookings on our marketplace, and businesses running their operations on our software. This role owns the product strategy behind both and runs Product day to day. You’ll report to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and lead four product managers across five teams: Bookings owns the booking flow and everything a pet parent does after booking. Match owns search, ranking, and the experience before booking. Pro owns the tools pros use to run their business. Connect makes a national network of centers bookable online. Centers runs online booking for Destination Pet locations. Each team owns a customer journey end to end and pairs with an engineering lead and a designer. Availability changes by the hour and sits in many center systems. Supply is local, so each market is built one pro and one center at a time. Every booking is a pet parent trusting someone with a family member. Yourgi is on a mission to become Earth's most trusted pet care connector, connecting pet parents with a reliable local network of certified professionals, pet resorts, and veterinary centers. Backed by a passionate team, our mission is to make pet care simple, accessible, and joyful for all. Because pets aren't just animals—they're family. We connect pet parents to two kinds of supply. On our marketplace, we match them with independent service pros for grooming, boarding, training, and daycare. Those pros run their business on Yourgi Pro. Through Yourgi Connect, we link pet parents directly into brick-and-mortar centers, including Destination Pet, Four Walls, and a growing national network. There they can check live availability, reserve a spot, and book in real time. We run on web and native iOS and Android apps, for pet parents on one side and the pros and centers who serve them on the other. We’re live in five markets and adding more. LOCATION : Remote (US only; must be authorized to work in the US, no visa sponsorship) REPORTS TO : Chief Product & Technology Officer PAY: $195,000-$245,000 base +20% bonus CORE RESPONSIBILITES: Product strategy - Develop and own the product strategy across the five teams. It covers the problems we solve and the bets we place, and it names what we won’t build. - Ground it in customer evidence, the market, competitors, and unit economics, and revisit it as evidence changes. Goals and roadmap - Turn the strategy into quarterly goals for each team: one outcome metric plus the input metrics that drive it, defined and baselined before the quarter starts. - Keep one prioritized roadmap across the five teams, each item tied to the goal it moves. - Run product’s weekly business review and the actions that come out of it. Fast testing with AI - Test bets before scaling them, using the cheapest method that answers the question: prototypes, fake-door tests, concierge pilots, or A/B tests. - Set each bet’s success metric and kill criteria before it starts. Scale, change, or stop it on the results. - Run research synthesis, spec drafts, and experiment analysis with AI by default, and train the team to work this way. The product team - Hire, coach, and grow the product managers, and set the bar for the craft. - Give each product manager a business number to own, with the data and the authority to move it. - Build a team that pulls in support, sales, marketing, or operations to get a result, and handles the work itself when that is faster. Product’s voice - Represent product to the leadership team. Bring the current numbers and the risks, and present the plan to hit the goals. - Treat quality as a product outcome. Own defect and reliability metrics for booking alongside conversion. - Partner with the VP of Engineering on scope and capacity, and hold the business goal when the two conflict. What You Bring Must-haves - Has rebuilt a product team’s discovery, spec, or analysis workflow around AI tools, and uses AI daily in their own work. - 10+ years in product management, including 3+ years managing product managers. - Has directly owned a conversion, revenue, or retention number, and can name the product choices behind it. - Has built a product strategy from customer and market evidence, set metric-based goals from it, and driven execution. - Has validated bets quickly, from prototypes to A/B tests with sample sizing and guardrail metrics, and scaled or stopped them on the results. - Self-serve analytics: writes SQL or builds analyses in a tool such as Mixpanel or Amplitude without waiting on an analyst. - Experience with a two-sided marketplace or software that service businesses run on, such as tools for salons, clinics, fitness studios, or home services. Differentiators - Has worked on a consumer marketplace and the business software its supply runs on - Has co-authored a multi-year product vision with a CEO or product executive - Startup or growth-stage experience - Booking, scheduling, or local-services products, where real-time availability shapes conversion - Consumer mobile apps at scale on iOS and Android - Has built a goal and metric system from scratch - Pet care industry experience What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days, you’ll deliver a written product strategy and set goals with each team. You’ll also co-author the 2-3 year product vision with the CPTO. Within a year, each product manager owns a business number, teams test before they build, and AI is routine in how product works. Logistics Remote , US-based, working during regular US business hours. Meetings run on Microsoft Teams. Some travel for leadership offsites and team gatherings. What We’re Looking For (Top 3) Drives product strategy independently. Shapes strategy from day one and owns it across all five teams. Co-authors the 2-3 year product vision with the CPTO within the first quarter. Builds an AI-first team that tests fast. Prototypes in hours, tests with real users in days, and cuts what the evidence doesn’t support. Brings the product team to the same pace. Makes product managers owners of business outcomes. Each is accountable for a business number. They pull in support, sales, or marketing when they need help. They do the work themselves when that is faster. Join us in shaping the future of Guidewire and unlocking the potential of our incredible Customer Success and Professional Services teams. Let's enable success together – apply today and be part of the Guidewire story! title: Lead Growth Engineer
description: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full. Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare. AI Proficiency at Sword AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work. Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role. As a Lead Growth Engineer at Sword, you’ll build and lead the technical engine responsible for driving member acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization across our D2C. Working closely with leadership across Product, Design, Data, and Marketing, you’ll establish the architecture, tools, and team that turn growth hypotheses into high-impact, measurable product experiences. Your work will span architecting experimentation platforms, optimizing full-funnel consumer journeys, and scaling a high-velocity growth engineering discipline that balances rapid experimentation with rock-solid technical foundations. What you’ll be doing: Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing growth engineering team, setting standards for execution velocity, testing rigor, and code quality; Architect, scale, and maintain our experimentation infrastructure, including feature flagging, cohort targeting, dynamic personalization, and multi-armed bandit systems; Drive full-funnel engineering initiatives across web and mobile platforms to optimize member acquisition, onboarding completion, subscription conversions, and retention loops; Implement trustworthy event instrumentation and data pipelines in partnership with Data Science to ensure accurate attribution, funnel telemetry, and statistically sound experiment results; Partner directly with Product, Design, and Marketing leadership to translate business objectives into prioritized technical roadmaps and rapid experimentation cycles; Champion a culture of data-informed decision-making, rapid iteration, and pragmatic trade-offs between speed-to-market and long-term system architecture; Ensure high system performance, data consistency, and failure recovery across critical growth touchpoints and checkout flows; Lead the integration of AI tools across engineering workflows to accelerate build cycles while ensuring security, correctness, and maintainability. What you need to have: Proven experience building and operating production services at scale, with deep technical expertise in TypeScript and modern web/mobile architectures; Prior leadership experience hiring, managing, or technically guiding growth engineering teams in high-growth product environments; Expertise in experimentation engines, feature flag management, event telemetry, and full-funnel analytics; Strong business acumen and fluency in core growth metrics (CAC, LTV, activation velocity, conversion rates, and cohort retention); Solid foundations in API design, relational databases, data modeling, asynchronous processing, and automated testing; Demonstrated ability to translate commercial goals into pragmatic technical solutions while balancing speed and system durability; Exceptional communication and cross-functional leadership skills across executive, technical, and non-technical stakeholders; Demonstrated Builder (Level 2) or Integrator (Level 3) AI proficiency, with practical experience embedding AI tools into team workflows; Fluent English, written and spoken. Nice To Have: Experience with consumer subscription models, payment integrations, or entitlement architectures at scale; Familiarity with ML-driven personalization, recommendation systems, or automated lifecycle messaging platforms; Experience with Go, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), and event-driven architectures. This role can sit remotely and the compensation range will be adjusted to accurately reflect the country in which the candidate resides *The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role. This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact. Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. title: Product Owner/Associate (foreUP)
description: Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences. We unite popular brands such as Clubessential , foreUP , myFitApp , Vermont Systems , Momence , Exerp , and many more. Product Owner/Associate will work closely with the foreUP product and development teams, as well as with clients and other internal and external stakeholders, to support the direction and strategy for our products. They will be in charge of informing the group of engineers, designer, and QA testers about the product vision, strategy, and direction. They act as the primary line of communication between the business stakeholders and the delivery teams, who will design, build, and test our products. The Product Owner/Associate also will need to be able to communicate to comprehend our business prospects, translate them into a polished and manageable backlog, and manage the team’s deliverables. As AI becomes a bigger part of how we build products, the Product Owner/Associate will also help identify where AI and automation can create real value for our customers, and work closely with engineering and data teams to bring those capabilities to life responsibly. RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES: Serve as Owner of the products; ensure products are meeting and exceeding the needs of external customers and prospects to expand addressable market and reduce/eliminate churn as well as internal stakeholders to allow for ease of implementation and support. Maintain focus on technological trends and competitive landscape to drive innovation. Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation within the product to improve efficiency, personalization, and decision-making for customers and internal users. Own the creation and grooming of the product backlog by writing and refining user stories that support sprint goals and align with product strategy. Serve as the Gatekeeper of the product backlog and primary feedback loop owner regarding product enhancements, issues, bugs and/or tasks related to the products. Escalate and timely communicate issues, related updates, and resolutions to internal stakeholders as appropriate. Share and contribute meaningful ideas to achieve overall product success, while balancing needs of external customers, expansion of addressable market, ease to support and implement, and churn reduction in mind. Coordinate with product leadership, customers, and team to complete research, develop specifications and user stories for the developers that satisfy business requirements and align with the business value. Partner with engineering and data teams to define requirements, success metrics, and guardrails for AI-powered features, and communicate what those capabilities can and can't do to internal stakeholders and customers. Provide timely feedback to internal stakeholders on plan for resolution; as appropriate, identify which bugs or enhancements will be worked and/or will not be prioritized. Play an active role in mitigating impediments impacting successful team completion of Release/Goals; participate in testing and release readiness as required. Assist with configuration and communicate availability of new features in demo environments. Act as the go to person/liaison for answering questions the development team has about business rules and product behaviors, and/or other internal stakeholders regarding the respective products. Assist in Rollout/Management/Feedback gathering where applicable. Assist in reviewing educational and marketing materials pertaining to the product lines. Deliver product releases and assist with release note creation/educational efforts with quick time-to-market and optimal resources. Develop successful launch plans working directly with implementation, project management and support services, marketing, sales, and our customers. Participate (when appropriate) in additional activities to support the education, marketing and/or success of the product such as webinars, shows, monthly/quarterly update meetings, and/or other activities as applicable. Lead/Assist/Participate (as applicable) in all Scrum ceremonies. Perform other responsibilities pertaining to the product, as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED: BS/MS degree in Business, Engineering, or related field preferred 3+ years’ work experience as product owner, business analyst or subject matter expert in SaaS software applications preferred Excellent oral and written communicator up, down, across and outside the organization. Strong critical thinking, analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with a strong sense of urgency and accountability Experience with bug/issue/enhancement tracking, project management software Excels in ability to prioritize, influence decisions/decision makers, and handle objections Excellent active listening, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills Ability to manage numerous diverse projects and multi-task with ease Experience with JIRA, Productboard, Pendo, and/or Figma a plus Experience defining or shipping AI-powered product features, or working closely with data science/ML teams, a plus Comfortable evaluating AI tools and vendors, weighing their capabilities and limitations, and translating them into clear customer value Hands-on experience writing AI skills, skill chains, or agentic workflows to streamline day-to-day work such as research, spec writing, and backlog grooming a plus At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply. Values and Life at Xplor Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day: Find a better way Do the right thing Say it straight Win together Own the outcome If these values sound like you and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor. As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed. Ready to apply? To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Got questions? You can email us at . Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Job Family: Testing Travel Required: None Clearance Required: Ability to Obtain Public Trust The Quality Assurance System Tester will support a large-scale agile software development program for the GrantSolutions contract, including both new software capabilities and ongoing support for legacy system functionality. This role will be embedded with software delivery teams to validate application features, integrations, data flows, legacy touchpoints, and release packages throughout the software development lifecycle. The tester will design and execute manual and automated tests, support developer-led quality practices, analyze defects, verify code changes, and help ensure that new and existing system capabilities meet functional, technical, security, accessibility, and operational requirements before production release. What You Will Do: We are seeking a Quality Assurance System Tester with strong software testing, test automation, and application validation experience to support the GrantSolutions software delivery environment. This role will work directly with developers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, integration engineers, data teams, DevSecOps engineers, vendors, and Federal stakeholders to verify that new software capabilities and supported legacy functionality are reliable, secure, accessible, data-consistent, and ready for incremental release. The Quality Assurance System Tester will participate across the SDLC by reviewing user stories and technical designs, developing test scenarios, validating software behavior, supporting application and data testing, documenting and retesting defects, and contributing to automated regression testing within CI/CD pipelines. This individual will help strengthen engineering quality, improve release confidence, and reduce production risk across new application components, existing legacy functionality, and system integrations. Participate throughout the software development lifecycle by reviewing user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, data mappings, interface specifications, and release plans to define complete and traceable test coverage. Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated test cases for application features, integrations, workflows, reports, database changes, regression scenarios, smoke testing, and user acceptance testing. Develop and maintain automated test scripts, test suites, reusable test data, and regression assets that can be executed consistently across development, test, staging, and release environments. Perform end-to-end software testing across new application components, supported legacy system functionality, data exchanges, background jobs, user workflows, reporting outputs, and role-based access paths. Support integration and database testing by validating data persistence, data transformation logic, error handling, access behavior, and downstream processing outcomes. Document defects clearly with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, test evidence, severity, priority, environment details, and supporting screenshots or logs when appropriate. Collaborate closely with developers during sprint execution to reproduce defects, analyze logs or test results, validate fixes, clarify expected software behavior, and support code promotion and release readiness decisions. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines where appropriate and support automated test execution, results review, failure analysis, test environment coordination, and maintenance of reusable test data. Support accessibility, security, performance, data quality, and operational readiness testing in coordination with specialized teams and approved program standards. Contribute to continuous improvement of software quality practices, test automation frameworks, defect management, traceability, release validation, and engineering quality metrics. What You Will Need: Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse . Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred. Bachelor’s degree required. Minimum of FOUR (4) years of experience in software quality assurance, software testing, application testing, test automation, systems testing, or related software development lifecycle roles. Hands-on experience designing, executing, and documenting test cases for application features, integrations, database changes, workflows, regression testing, smoke testing, and user acceptance testing. Hands-on experience developing, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts using test automation tools, frameworks, scripting languages, or code-based testing approaches. Experience testing web-based applications, data integrations, interfaces, reports, background processes, and end-to-end business workflows across multiple software environments. Experience with defect tracking, test management, requirements traceability, test evidence capture, test data preparation, release validation, and defect retesting. Understanding of the software development lifecycle, agile delivery, DevSecOps practices, version control, branching and merging concepts, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release management. Ability to interpret user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, interface specifications, data mappings, architecture guidance, and technical design documentation. Ability to troubleshoot test failures, isolate defects, analyze logs, query data when needed, validate fixes, and communicate software quality risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong documentation skills, including the ability to maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, traceability matrices, defect records, test evidence, and release readiness summaries. Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a software delivery team that includes Product Owners, developers, integration engineers, data teams, DevSecOps engineers, vendors, security teams, and business stakeholders. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to operate effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments with competing testing priorities and release timelines. What Would Be Nice To Have: Experience supporting software development initiatives that include both new application capabilities and ongoing validation of legacy system functionality within enterprise or government environments. Experience supporting federal or government IT programs involving legacy systems, shared services, interoperability, cloud environments, data governance, system integrations, or phased capability delivery. Experience with test automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Cucumber, Postman/Newman, REST Assured, JUnit, TestNG, or similar tools. Experience with test management, defect tracking, and agile delivery tools such as Jira, Subject 7, Confluence, or similar platforms. Familiarity with AWS cloud environments, SQL/database validation, data integration testing, accessibility testing, security testing, performance testing, logging, monitoring, or observability tools. Exposure to Git-based workflows, pull request validation, build verification, unit test awareness, static analysis results, or other engineering practices that support software quality. Quality, agile, testing, automation, cloud, or security certification preferred, such as ISTQB, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, AWS Cloud Practitioner, Security+, or similar credentials. title: Senior Software Engineer II
description: Position Overview SBS is seeking a skilled AI Engineer to join its Data & AI / Engineering organization in the UK or EU. This role will focus on designing, building, and deploying AI-driven solutions that enhance SBS products and client offerings. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with applied AI/ML expertise, enabling the development of scalable, production-grade AI systems in a regulated financial services environment. Location: UK or EU Hybrid/Remote: Remote (Ocasional travel required) Responsibilities AI Solution Development Design, build, and deploy AI/ML models and intelligent applications across SBS platforms Develop solutions leveraging: Machine Learning (ML) Natural Language Processing (NLP) Generative AI (GenAI / LLMs) Translate business requirements into technical AI solutions that deliver measurable impact Model Deployment & MLOps Implement and manage end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to model deployment and monitoring Collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to ensure scalable, reliable production deployment Maintain and optimize model performance, accuracy, and efficiency over time Product Integration Integrate AI capabilities into core banking, payments, and digital platforms Work closely with Product Managers, Architects, and Developers to embed AI into customer-facing solutions Support API development and microservices architecture for AI-driven features Data Engineering Collaboration Partner with data engineers to ensure data quality, availability, and pipeline integrity Work with structured and unstructured datasets across large-scale, distributed systems Innovation & Continuous Improvement Stay current with advancements in AI, GenAI, and emerging technologies Contribute to experimentation, prototyping, and innovation initiatives Identify opportunities to improve automation, efficiency, and decision-making through AI Qualifications Software Architecture & Design Application architecture: Strong grasp of clean/hexagonal architecture, dependency injection, SOLID principles, and protocol-based interfaces. Can design well-structured Python services with clear separation of concerns, testable components, and maintainable codebases. This is not optional — the existing system follows these patterns and new code must be consistent. API design: Experience designing and maintaining RESTful API contracts. Understands OpenAPI specifications, versioning strategies, schema evolution, and backward compatibility. Can own the API surface that internal consumers depend on. System design: Distributed systems thinking — understands event-driven patterns, asynchronous communication, eventual consistency, and the trade-offs of different integration approaches. Can reason about how components interact across service boundaries. Data modelling: Can design domain models, define data flows between system components, and make pragmatic schema design decisions. Understands how data structures affect downstream consumers and system evolution. AI & LLM Application Skills LLM application development: Hands-on experience building production applications powered by LLMs. Must go beyond API calls — RAG pipelines, chain-of-thought reasoning, structured output parsing, multi-step workflows. Candidates who have only fine-tuned models or only called a single provider’s API do not qualify. Model-agnostic design: This is a sovereign AI system. The candidate must design against standardised API interfaces (OpenAI-compatible, LiteLLM, or equivalent abstraction layers), not couple to any single provider. Must understand model routing, fallback strategies, and how to build systems that can swap underlying models without application-layer rewrites. Experience limited to a single commercial API (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic) without abstraction is insufficient. Agentic system design: Demonstrated experience designing multi-step AI systems where the model makes decisions about what to do next. This could be via LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, custom agent loops, or any framework — the underlying patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, reflection) matter more than the tool. Prompt engineering depth: Can demonstrate iterative prompt development for complex tasks. Understands few-shot, chain-of-thought, XML/structured prompting, and the behavioural differences between model families and sizes. Critically, understands that prompt strategies must adapt when moving between frontier and smaller OSS models. Python Engineering Production Python: Strong async Python with FastAPI or equivalent framework. Comfortable with Pydantic for data validation, SQLAlchemy for data access, and structured logging (structlog). Writes clean, testable, well-documented code with proper type hints. This is a software engineering role that builds AI systems — not a data science role that happens to write Python. Safeguards for hallucinated tools, loops, partial completion, unsafe actions. Understands async trade-offs, batching, streaming, latency accumulation Engineering Qualities Works within existing systems: The candidate joins a substantial existing codebase and architecture. They must be comfortable reading, understanding, and extending code they did not write — not lobbying to rewrite it. Production mindset: Thinks about error handling, retry logic, graceful degradation, observability, and security as first-class concerns. Understands that agentic autonomy creates new failure modes that must be anticipated. Clear communicator: Can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Can write clear design documents. Can articulate why an agentic approach is or is not appropriate for a given problem. Company Overview At SBS , we’re more than just a technology company, we’re a global fintech partner helping banks and financial institutions transform, innovate, and grow. With over 5,000 employees worldwide and clients in more than 80 countries, our solutions power everything from digital banking and lending to payments and core banking systems. As part of 74Software , we’re backed by a group of leading software companies delivering mission-critical solutions worldwide. Our focus is on delivering long-term value, leveraging cutting-edge technology, and fostering strong client partnerships. Join us and be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team shaping the future of finance. Why SBS ? description: Director, Sourcing, Contracts and Negotiations – Software Licensing /SAP Remote EMEA About the role: Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. This Director role is focused on sourcing, contracts and negotiations for enterprise software and SaaS licensing, with deep emphasis on the SAP ecosystem.A Director serves as a leader within Gartner ’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group. Graduate degree preferred 10+ years of relevant field or industry experience 8+ years work experience in SaaS/software contract negotiations, technology procurement, category management, vendor management or software asset management within a buying organization, outsourcer, consulting firm, or reseller. 5+ years hands-on experience negotiating SAPrenewals (including deals within last 12 months) withexposure ideally to RISE, S/4HANA and line of business solutions (e.g., SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, etc.). At Gartner , Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities. Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here. What makes Gartner a great place to work? Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance. We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you. What do we offer? In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring. A talent for communicating directly with clients, managing expectations, and explaining advanced technical concepts and their implications. Excellent communication skills and a strong ability to present and defend technical and architectural choices persuasively. Advanced English proficiency. Exceptional problem-solving skills. Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln können, kannst technische Lebensläufe aber sicher einordnen und mit Kandidat*innen auf Augenhöhe sprechen. Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und transparent und behältst mehrere Suchprozesse gleichzeitig im Blick. Du bist offen dafür, KI-Tools sinnvoll für Recherche, Ansprache und die Organisation deiner Arbeit einzusetzen und prüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig. Benefits Das erwartet dich bei New Monday 100 % remote: Du arbeitest innerhalb Deutschlands von dem Ort aus, der für dich passt. Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenständig, mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen und ohne Micromanagement. title: Lead Full Stack Developer
description: Company Description Saatchi & Saatchi is an advertising agency with the belief that creativity, data, media and technology should all work together, and we use that to influence human behavior and drive success for clients. S&S is one of the world's largest agency networks with 114 offices and more than 6000 employees globally. Here in our Toronto office we work with some of the countries most valued brands including Toyota, Buckley's, and Children's Advil, as well as several under the Mondelez banner (Crispers, Oreo, and Chips Ahoy just to name a few). We’re an award winning agency in both creativity and effectiveness, so it’s really important for us here to convert that innovation and the great ideas into real tangible business results for the organization. Overview Saatchi & Saatchi is seeking a Lead Full Stack Developer for an innovative AI platform initiative.You have 8+ years building production software systems and at least a few years leading or anchoring a team technically. You are a hands-on builder and you hold the architectural picture of a multi-tier platform — React frontend, Spring Boot backend, FastAPI agentic services, agent SDKs on top of LLM providers. You are equally comfortable reviewing a database migration, debugging a prod incident, mentoring a senior engineer, or sitting in a client architecture conversation. You thrive at the intersection of architecture, engineering, and program reality. Responsibilities Responsibilities Own the technical direction across the platform's tiers — frontend, backend, agentic/AI services, data, and integrations — and hold the shared mental model of how the system actually fits together. Pair closely with the Senior Technical PM and Program Director to translate product intent into a credible technical plan, and to surface what is genuinely hard vs. what is just unfamiliar. Lead architecture and design reviews, write the deciding ADR when needed, and keep a small set of vendor-neutral patterns the team can lean on instead of a sprawl of frameworks. Stay hands-on in the code — pick up meaningful slices of work, especially across tier boundaries (e.g. backend ↔ agentic, frontend ↔ auth/RBAC, infra-aware app changes). Be a first-class code reviewer across the stack: you set the bar for clarity, testability, security, and operability, and you raise the team's bar by reviewing thoughtfully. Mentor mid-level and senior engineers; coach them through technical decisions, on-call experiences, and difficult code reviews. Partner with the Platform Engineer on production reliability — capacity, scaling, observability, and incident response — and own application-side reliability concerns. Drive integration architecture with internal and external systems using API-first and event-driven patterns; ensure identity, authorization, data protection, and auditability are built in, not bolted on. Champion the LLM/agent layer — agent orchestration, tool/plugin design, prompt and evaluation loops, provider abstraction (e.g. Vertex AI, Claude on Vertex, OpenAI) — and keep us out of vendor lock-in we cannot pay for. Build redundancy on yourself — pair, document, rotate ownership, and ensure no critical system has exactly one person who understands it. Qualifications 8+ years in software engineering, with meaningful time as a hands-on lead, staff engineer, or solutions architect on production systems. Proven experience designing and delivering complex, multi-service platforms — not just one service or one tier. Strong backend depth in at least one modern stack (Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, Node, Go, .NET); able to ramp on the others. Solid frontend literacy — comfortable reading and reviewing modern React/TypeScript code and reasoning about state management, auth, and performance. Strong cloud architecture background, preferably GCP (we run primarily on GKE); willing to deepen wherever the platform takes us. Deep understanding of API design, integration patterns, distributed systems, and the failure modes that come with them. Experience with containerization, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD; you do not need to be a DevOps specialist, but you must operate well in that world. Real production experience with AI / LLM systems — agents, RAG, evaluation, tool integration — or a strong, demonstrable plan for getting there. Comfortable working within Agile delivery models (Scrum, Kanban, or whatever variant actually ships). Excellent communication: you can explain a complex architecture to a non-technical executive and disagree with a senior engineer respectfully and with evidence. Required Soft Skills Hands-on bias — you reach for the code, the logs, and the diagram before you reach for the meeting invite. Calm, decisive judgment when there is no obviously right answer. Strong written communication — you can write a one-page architecture rationale that future-you will still understand. Generous mentorship instinct — you make the people around you better, on purpose. Comfortable with ambiguity and willing to make reversible decisions quickly while flagging the irreversible ones for broader input. Pragmatic about technology choices — you optimize for the team's ability to operate the system, not for personal stack preferences. Honest about what you do and do not know; willing to say 'I'll find out' and then actually find out. Nice to Have Prior experience working inside Publicis Groupe or another large holding-company agency network. Production experience with Google ADK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable agent frameworks. Experience with event-driven architectures, domain-driven design, and contract-first integration patterns. Background in regulated or privacy-sensitive environments (identity, healthcare, financial, marketing-compliance). Experience supporting multiple products or clients on a shared platform (multi-tenant, multi-brand, white-label). Comfort with Terraform, Kustomize, or other IaC tooling at a 'can read and improve' level. Track record contributing to internal developer experience — patterns, scaffolds, golden paths. Additional Information Location & Eligibility: Candidates must be based in Canada, with valid Canadian work authorization of at least 12 months. Hybrid Work: This role is remote. If you are GTA-based, the team meets once a month at our Toronto office (111 Queen St. E, Suite 200, Toronto, ON M5C 1S2). Time Off: - Up to 3 weeks vacation, with additional paid closure between Christmas and New Year's - Extended long weekends for provincial holidays — we give you both the Monday and Friday so you get a full 4-day break - 10 personal days per year Flexibility & Global Mobility: After completing one year, work remotely for up to 6 weeks per year from any of our 50+ global offices through our Work Your World program. Benefits: Comprehensive group coverage including: - Medical, dental, and vision care - Psychological and paramedical services - Disability insurance - Fertility support and gender-affirming care - Dedicated internal guidance programs for employees navigating cancer, fertility treatments, or gender transition Parental Leave Top up : A 100% salary top up program once approved for Employment Insurance for the first 6 weeks of your parental Leave. title: Data Engineer

Build and maintain robust ingestion processes across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources. Implement data transformation, cleansing, validation, and quality controls aligned with enterprise standards. Educational Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related field. Expert-level SQL skills and solid understanding of enterprise data modeling concepts. Advanced Python experience for pipeline development and automation. Experience processing semi-structured and unstructured data (for example PDFs, JSON payloads, Markdown/text corpora), including preparing data for consumption by LLM- enabled applications and retrieval systems. Experience working with APIs, enterprise systems, and heterogeneous data sources. Strong understanding of data quality patterns (validation rules, anomaly detection, automated checks). Ability to operate with high ownership and accountability for data reliability in production. Strong troubleshooting skills for performance, failures, and operational constraints. Nice to Have (Senior Differentiators) Understanding of retrieval and indexing workflows supporting AI applications, including vector-ready ingestion patterns and retrieval enablement. Experience supporting vectorization pipelines and embeddings-based retrieval workflows. Familiarity with orchestration and workflow tooling (for example Airflow, Dagster, or Data Factory-style patterns). Experience with cloud-native implementations (Azure-first where applicable) and enterprise governance constraints. Familiarity with data governance practices (access policies, audit requirements, lineage approaches). Experience with production monitoring patterns, including service-level objectives (SLOs) for data freshness and pipeline stability. Technology Stack (Indicative): (Final stack and tooling will follow internal standards and may vary by domain.) Languages Python (advanced) SQL (expert) Data Platforms / Storage (examples) Azure SQL and enterprise databases Data lake / lakehouse patterns (Delta Lake-style where applicable) Document storage and indexing patterns supporting unstructured data Orchestration / Processing (examples) Airflow, Dagster, or Azure Data Factory-style orchestration Distributed processing frameworks (Spark-style processing where applicable) Integration & Messaging (examples, where applicable) API-based ingestion Event streaming / messaging patterns (Kafka/Event Hubs-style where applicable) Operations CI/CD pipelines and release management Observability and monitoring for pipelines and services Cross-Cutting Expectations Delivery mindset with focus on measurable outcomes and operational stability. High ownership for reliability, quality, and performance. Ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders. Clear documentation, structured communication, and predictable execution. Success Measures (Examples) Data pipelines deliver reliable, validated data aligned to agreed freshness and quality expectations. Reduced manual effort and operational friction through stable automation and data availability. Production issues are detected early through monitoring and resolved with structured root cause analysis. AI and automation teams are enabled by consistent, reusable datasets and retrieval- ready ingestion flows. Implementation of automated data quality gates (“quality as code”) that prevent broken or incomplete data from reaching downstream AI workflows (including retrieval/vector indexing), reducing manual cleanup and operational rework. title: Sr. Principal Software and AI Engineer
description: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer. In this hands-on senior technical leadership role, you will help shape the R&D AI strategy and set technical direction for the engineering team, while building critical components yourself and setting best practices for AI-native development within a disciplined, validated SDLC. You will architect and ship production-grade agentic applications and platforms, set standards for evaluation, observability, and GxP compliance, and raise the bar for engineers through design reviews and mentorship. title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Platform
description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Software Engineer on the Compute Platform team within the Platform group, you'll own the primary compute orchestration infrastructure that every service at Coinbase runs on. Built largely on CNCF technologies including Kubernetes and Istio, this platform underpins the scalability, reliability, and efficiency of our entire product suite. You'll design and ship tooling, automation, and net-new capabilities that make it easy for hundreds of engineers to deploy and operate critical services, while partnering closely with Security, Reliability, and Observability teams to raise the bar across the stack. What you'll do: Own the design, build, and operation of Kubernetes cluster management tooling and automation that keeps our compute platform reliable and self-healing at scale. Build developer-facing tooling and workflows that improve how engineers across Coinbase interact with Kubernetes, with a heavy emphasis on integrating AI-driven processes and support. Deliver net-new compute capabilities for service owners, such as one-off jobs, cron scheduling, deployment strategies, EFS support, and automated right-sizing. Drive operational excellence by automating toil, reducing on-call burden, and continuously improving platform observability and incident response. Partner with Security, Reliability, and Observability teams to ensure the compute platform meets Coinbase 's standards for security, uptime, and performance. Required Skills and Experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years building and operating Kubernetes or similar compute orchestration systems (e.g., Mesos, Nomad, ECS). Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, Java) with experience building and shipping production-grade infrastructure services Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP infrastructure services (e.g., EC2, EKS, IAM, VPC, networking) in a production environment at scale. Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and operate distributed infrastructure systems, including diagnosing complex failures and driving them to root-cause resolution. Hands-on experience with the CNCF ecosystem (e.g., Helm, Prometheus, ArgoCD, Envoy) and a track record of applying these tools to solve real infrastructure problems. Proven ability to apply AI tooling to infrastructure workflows, improving automation, developer productivity, or operational efficiency. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
