title: Security Engineer
description: We're on the lookout for a Security Engineer to join Nucleus' Information Security team, to help ensure that we are secure by design. About the role The Security Engineer supports the delivery of Nucleus’s technology and business change agendas by translating security requirements into practical, working controls. Security requirements are set within the Information Security function; the Engineer is the person who turns them into designed, implemented and validated controls. This includes reviewing technical designs against those requirements, building and configuring the controls, embedding them into our operations, and evidencing that they work as intended. The Engineer works closely with teams across Nucleus, and with outsource partners involved in delivery, to land the right security outcome in each change. The Information Security team aims make sure that Nucleus is a trusted partner to the firms and people we work with. Being able to demonstrate that our systems are secure, through a structured control environment, is a core component of building that trust. This role is critical to delivering that outcome: being the go-to contact for implementing security controls; being ‘hands on’ with their design and configuration; and validating that controls work as intended through technical assessment, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Where a control cannot be delivered as intended, this role is also about articulating the resulting risk clearly and pragmatically, so the accountable people can decide how to handle it. This is a proactive, build-and-assure role, distinct from a monitoring or alert-response function. You’ll work with SMEs across Nucleus, you’ll ensure that new processes and controls are handed over to the relevant team, and that the Information Security Analysis team have suitable evidence to demonstrate that our risks are effectively managed. Responsibilities Apply security best practice in our change and development programmes, to ensure delivery is within our risk appetites. Review technical designs against agreed security requirements, then design and implement the controls that meet them, following industry best practice and Nucleus standards. Work with technical and delivery teams to produce and deliver remediation plans for identified vulnerabilities and control gaps, in line with Nucleus’ risk appetites. Clearly communicate security risks where requirements cannot be fully met, so the business can make informed decisions on whether to accept, mitigate or remediate, and balance security with delivery. Maintain systems and integrations that enable these controls. Validate that delivered controls work as intended, and capture the evidence needed to demonstrate they are effective. Coordinate on security controls within other members of the Nucleus Group, to ensure Nucleus has an end to end understanding of our exposures and capabilities. Support Audit and Due Diligence activities to help demonstrate Nucleus’s capabilities. Work with Security Operations and Analysis to adopt and maintain standards that ensure Nucleus continues to manage our security risks effectively. Take responsibility in everything you do to deliver good outcomes for our customers Positively demonstrate the Nucleus Smart, Heart and Courage values and behaviours Ensure compliance with Code of Conduct at all times About you Your friends might describe you as ‘the methodical one’. You love to look at how everything fits together to see the bigger picture, identifying where things can go wrong, and putting pragmatic solutions in place to catch them before they happen. You’ll enjoy working within a fast-paced environment that gives you the opportunity to multi-task within set deadlines. Professional with a positive outlook, you’ll take great pride in your ability to act on your own initiative and remain flexible in changing circumstances and priorities. You’ll be confident navigating challenge and competing priorities, holding a technical position where the security outcome depends on it, and doing so constructively. You build influence through the quality of your reasoning rather than relying on authority, and you stay composed and evidence-led when your thinking is tested. At Nucleus, we place real value in cultural contribution and diversity of thought. For this role we’re also looking for genuine technical depth, so while we wouldn’t expect every item below, we’d want you to bring a good number of them: Exposure to recognised control frameworks, in particular the CIS Critical Security Controls, with an understanding of how frameworks like NIST SP 800-53 or the NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework benefit an organisation. You understand what these frameworks are for, not just that they exist. Able to identify effective implementation and test plans, and deliver those through either in house capabilities or by working with external providers, and demonstrate how they help manage Nucleus’ risks. An excellent communicator, able to discuss security effectively with areas of the business. Solid, demonstrable Information Security experience, ideally including time in a regulated environment such as financial services. Strong knowledge of IT, Infrastructure and Networking concepts. Hands-on experience building and maintaining the systems and integrations that enable security controls. Experience working with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and AWS, including operating and maintaining security controls and responding to findings from cloud security posture or workload protection tooling. Able to weigh other people’s views, apply sound technical judgement, and provide constructive challenge where it is needed to manage our Information Security risks effectively. Able to articulate security risk in clear, practical terms, helping stakeholders make informed decisions about accepting, mitigating or remediating, rather than presenting security as a blocker. Ownership of tasks, attention to detail and following through to conclusion. Ability to prioritise and remain agile with competing work demands. Comfortable working independently on technical delivery, seeing work through to a validated, evidenced conclusion. A little about us Our purpose at Nucleus is to transform financial services and create better outcomes for our advisers and their clients. It is this purpose that drives everything we do. Whether you are working in a role that is client facing or not, you’ll need to be service obsessed to work here. It’s a fast paced and exciting environment, and one where we believe you will get the chance to fulfil your potential and do work that really matters, to you and our clients. We believe in you having your own chunk of responsibility and being trusted to make things happen. Nucleus’ culture is something our people believe sets us apart from other places they’ve worked. We think big, know our stuff and move at pace, but always empowering others along the way and breaking new ground to find better ways of doing things. We know that sometimes the right choice is not the easy one, so empowering each other and celebrating others' successes, as well as our own, is part of what makes us Nucleus #WeAreNucleus Inclusion and diversity at Nucleus As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion. For us this is not a box-ticking thing, it’s a commercial imperative. It isn’t about being PC. It’s about being future relevant and durable. Find out more on our inclusion page We’re proud to partner Stonewall and be a diversity champion for Scotland. This partnership demonstrates our ongoing commitment to diversity by providing an environment where everyone feels welcome, able to be their authentic self and do the best work of their life. We offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including pension, bonus, enhanced parental leave, paid time off for emergencies, health and wellbeing initiatives and flexible working options. Lead the development of POS-related applications Optimize system performance and security, particularly around payment processing and EMV protocols. Participate in planning sessions with product and engineering teams to ensure solutions meet market needs and business goals. Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices for mobile and embedded systems development, especially for Android Native development. Define and enforce software engineering best practices across the POS and related teams to improve efficiency and developer productivity. Strong expertise in Android Native development (Java/Kotlin), with a deep understanding of Android-based POS terminal solutions. Strong knowledge of EMV (Europay, Mastercard, and Visa) security protocols, including chip-based transactions, encryption, and key management. Experience with hardware integration for POS devices, such as card readers, pin pads, printers, and other peripherals. Deep understanding of payment systems architecture , including integration with payment processors and gateways. Knowledge of software quality assurance principles and their application in financial systems. Excellent problem-solving skills with an ability to manage complex system interactions and adapt to changing requirements. Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Leadership abilities with a focus on mentoring engineers and driving process improvements within the team. title: Software Quality Operations Specialist
description: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo ’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states. The Software Quality Operations (SWQOPS) team is at the heart of ensuring the safety, reliability, and quality of the Waymo Driver. Leverage AI-powered insights and traditional triage signals to proactively identify emerging on-road issue trends, new risk scenarios, and edge cases. title: Product Designer
description: Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences. We unite popular brands such as foreUP , myFitApp , Vermont Systems , Momence , Exerp , Mariana Tek , Resamania , FieldEdge , CampBrain and many more. Join our Cubessential Brand under the Golf & Club vertical as Product Designer to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every interface we design, and every new feature we ship is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve. As our Product Designer, you will be a designer and design ambassador across our product families, working in an AI-optimized software development lifecycle (AI SDLC) where product, engineering, QA and design build together, with AI part of how everyone works. On an AI-optimized team, designers spend less time on repetitive production work and more on problem framing, customer insight and quality. You will use AI across discovery, design, prototyping and build, and you stay accountable for the quality of what ships. You will combine qualitative and quantitative data with your talent and instincts to turn customer insight into delightful product designs, using AI to explore faster and test sooner. A key focus of the role is maintaining our design system and the AI skills that support prototyping. We expect you to lead with judgment, taste and customer empathy, and to work in a way that reflects our company values. Some of the things you'll do: Understand customers and shape the problem Set design requirements based on input from internal teams and user research. Collect and interpret qualitative and quantitative feedback, and use AI tools to synthesize research, support themes and usage data at speed, while checking the output against the source. Identify new product improvement opportunities, and analyze how a new product meets market needs and customer preferences. Design and validate Produce UX/UI to support the product roadmap across our family of products. Use AI-assisted workflows to explore more options, build prototypes and cover edge cases and states earlier, then bring your own judgment to choose the best direction. Present design ideas to Product Managers and Owners, Engineers, QA, other cross-functional teams, customers and prospects, and use their feedback to validate and refine designs. Modify and revise existing designs as customer preferences change. Build alongside engineering Work closely with Product Management, Engineers and QA to suggest improvements to products and processes. Review AI-assisted builds for design fidelity, accessibility and consistency, and give clear, specific feedback early. Provide support to Product Management and Engineers whenever it helps the team move faster. Maintain the design system and AI skills Maintain and evolve the design system and design library across our family of products, keeping components, tokens and guidelines organized, current and consistent. Build and maintain the AI skills, prompts and templates that support prototyping, so the team can move from idea to working prototype quickly and stay true to the design system. Document design principles, patterns, components and research so people and AI tools can both use them. A well-structured design system and knowledge base is what lets AI-assisted teams build consistently. Share reusable workflows and coach the wider team on using AI well for design tasks. Design for AI-powered experiences Design the experience of AI-powered product features, including how they set expectations, show their reasoning, let people stay in control, handle mistakes and build trust. Follow company policy on responsible AI use, including how customer and company data is handled in AI tools. Stay up to date on industry trends, market conditions and new AI design tools and techniques, and recommend the ones worth adopting. Working arrangements: Fully Remote in United States : You can work remotely in this position, provided you reside in United States ,have full working rights and do not require sponsorship. Qualifications What would make me a good candidate? We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do. You'll need: Proven experience in all phases of the design process: user research, wireframing, prototyping, visual design, interaction design and usability testing. A well-rounded portfolio that shows a strong understanding of customer and business objectives. An intuitive eye for customer needs beyond the obvious. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate and persuade around design concepts and to engage and influence a variety of audiences. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional team members, and to be autonomous and a team player when needed. Ability to manage multiple projects with varying deadlines and scopes of work. Creative, strong problem-solving skills, and a passion for design. You are never satisfied with the status quo and always looking for ways to improve and innovate. Experience with Figma or another collaborative interface design tool. Bachelor’s degree in visual communications, graphic design or a related field, or relevant experience (4+ years). 5+ years of relevant design experience, including UX/UI. AI fluency- Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in your design work, for example research synthesis, ideation, prototyping or content. Ability to write clear prompts, evaluate AI output critically and know when to trust it, edit it or discard it. Understanding of how AI-powered features behave, including variable output and the chance of errors, and how to design for that. Curiosity and a willingness to change how you work as AI tools and team practices evolve. It would be great if you also have: Experience building or maintaining a multi-product design system, including components and design tokens. Experience designing B2B software, vertical SaaS or payments experiences. Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG). Experience prototyping with AI-assisted or code-based tools At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you don't tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply. Values and Life at Xplor Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day: Find a better way Do the right thing Say it straight Win together Own the outcome If these values sound like you and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor. As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed. Ready to apply? To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior AI Engineer
description: Accertify enables commerce by doing one thing extraordinarily well: pinpointing fraud. The company's Predictive Yes Platform helps businesses say yes to more - more good customers, more revenue, and more growth - without getting burned. Skills & Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 5+ years of production software experience. Strong proficiency with AI/ML frameworks (OpenAI SDK, FastMCP, agentic orchestration frameworks). Strong Python AND strong SQL; both are first-class requirements. Comfortable with query optimization, indexing strategy, and data modeling. Demonstrated experience designing and operating medallion architectures (bronze/silver/gold) at scale. Experience handling data at scale, partitioning, batch pipeline design, query performance, schema evolution. Production LLM experience, prompt engineering, retrieval (RAG), agentic orchestration, fine-tuning trade-offs. Experience with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.) and production RAG patterns. Experience with AI observability and evaluation frameworks, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or equivalent, golden-set eval, judge-based eval methodology. Strong understanding of secure system design, authentication, API integrations, and handling PII-sensitive data. Track record of mentoring engineers and shipping cross-team initiatives. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical audiences. Preferred Skills: Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), building tools, OAuth flows, or MCP server integrations. Experience leading data engineering or data platform initiatives end-to-end. Experience with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., the OpenAI Agents SDK) in production. Experience deploying production systems across both cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and on-prem environments. Experience in fraud detection, financial services, or other PII-sensitive domains. Knowledge of MLOps tools and CI/CD for AI. Open-source contributions, conference talks, or technical writing in the AI/ML space. Additional Details: Competitive base salary with performance-based incentives. Potential Salary Range: $140-180k. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all US locations. This role is eligible for remote US-based (work-from-home) locations. Chicago-based candidates would work in a hybrid capacity from the Accertify HQ located in Itasca, IL. title: QA Manager
description: About Knotch Knotch is redefining the future of websites in the age of AI. The way people discover, engage with, and consume content is fundamentally changing. Customers now find information and make decisions through AI, increasingly with an agent acting on their behalf. Most brand digital presences were never built for this journey. Knotch is the AI-native infrastructure that closes that gap, giving brands the ability to meet every customer, and every agent, with the right experience at the right moment, and to adapt as fast as AI and consumer behavior keep changing. Our platform combines content intelligence, measurement, and agentic AI to show enterprises what content works, continuously optimize their sites, and deliver measurable business outcomes. At the center is ACE (Agentic Content Engine), which moves brands beyond static websites toward intelligent, adaptive ones that keep improving. We work with some of the world’s most recognizable companies. Our culture is fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and highly adaptable. We move quickly, test ideas, and evolve with our customers. We’re looking for exceptional people who want to help shape how leading brands show up in an AI world. About the role We are looking for an exceptionally skilled hands-on QA Manager to join our engineering team. This person will be responsible for managing the automation suites across all products in a fast-paced environment. Creating, maintaining, executing scripts during regression, smoke, and sanity in various environments. In your first year, you will have built out our testing frameworks from scratch and have hired a QA team to help us in those efforts! Responsibilities Hands-on automation development that is AI native Managing an offshore QA team and building out a US team as needed Creating automated test and validation processes of APIs on cloud services Building comprehensive test suites that will be utilized by overall engineering and product organizations Recommending and maintaining appropriate frameworks to automate test scenarios Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI-powered features, including regression testing, output quality, reliability, edge cases, and non-deterministic behavior Analyzing and reporting on test automation progress Performing manual, exploratory and performance testing Analyzing test results, performing RCAs and file tickets as necessary in JIRA Establishing test automation code coverage metrics Collaborating closely with our product manager, project manager (agile), and software engineers to define best practices for testing our applications (both internal and external facing) Qualifications 8+ years of QA engineering experience, including 2+ years leading or managing a test automation team Hands-on experience using AI tools and agents for test automation Strong expertise in automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Watir, HeadSpin or similar Proven ability to define tool strategy and build scalable test automation frameworks from the ground up Experience writing scalable, reusable test scripts and running them in an Agile/Scrum environment Solid experience with manual and automated API testing, including Postman Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into them Practical experience with source control systems (e.g., Git) Familiarity with AWS, GCP or similar cloud platforms, and working knowledge of SQL Excellent communication and mentorship skills, with experience leading distributed teams How to be Successful Builder mentality: you’re energized by starting from zero. You can stand up frameworks, processes and a team from scratch without waiting for a playbook. Hands-on and leading at the same time: you’re as comfortable writing and debugging automation scripts as you are mentoring engineers and setting direction for the team. AI-native problem solving: you reach for AI tools and agents first to speed up test creation and maintenance, and you know how to test AI features whose outputs can change from run to run. Quality as a mindset, not a phase: you push testing earlier in the development cycle and help engineering and product teams own quality alongside you. Root-cause curiosity: you don’t stop at “it’s broken.” You dig into the “why,” run thorough RCAs and turn what you learn into lasting process fixes. Data-driven reporting: you track coverage, defect trends and automation progress, and you use those numbers to show impact and guide decisions. Pragmatic prioritization: in a fast-paced environment, you balance coverage, speed and risk. You know what to automate, what to test by hand and what can wait. Precision and attention to detail: you catch the edge cases others miss and won’t sign off on a release until you trust the results. Clear communication across time zones: you keep an offshore team aligned and productive, and you explain quality risks so non-technical stakeholders understand them. Voice your opinions: how can we make our products, releases and engineering practices better based on what testing shows you? Nice to Have Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience) QA or testing certifications (e.g., ISTQB) or cloud certifications (AWS/GCP) Experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Locust) Eastern Time Zone location for easier collaboration with the team and offshore partners Why Join Knotch You will be the founding leader of quality at Knotch , building our testing frameworks, automation suites and QA team from the ground up. Your work will shape how every product is built, tested and released, so our engineering and product teams can ship faster and with confidence. You’ll work with AI-native tools, cloud-based products and a talented team that values ownership, precision and impact. The expected salary range for this opportunity is $136,000-163,000 CAD depending on skills and experience. Our Benefits and Perks Knotch is a fully remote company. Candidates may work from anywhere within Canada, with Eastern time zone preferred, through our employer of record. Some of our other great benefits include: Comprehensive health benefits through our employer of record (EOR) relationship with Globalization Partners Unlimited PTO 10+ company-paid holidays Wellness and work-from-home perks Company and team offsites A daily company-wide break, and more! We pride ourselves on our three values: transparency, relentlessness, and inclusiveness. title: Principal Developer TeamcenterX
description: POSITION SUMMARY: This position is responsible for the design, build, and integration of MSD’s Siemens Teamcenter X Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) platform. The position owns the technical architecture for server-side customization (ITK, SOA, custom handlers), codeful BMIDE extensions, Active Workspace Client (AWC) customization, and integrations connecting Teamcenter with JD Edwards ERP, CAD systems, manufacturing systems, and downstream consumers across MSD’s digital thread. The Principal Developer establishes engineering standards and reusable patterns for the broader PLM team, mentors senior and junior developers, and serves as the principal technical partner to the Sr. Teamcenter Functional Analyst, Teamcenter administrators, infrastructure engineers, and Siemens or systems-integrator partners. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Own the technical architecture for Teamcenter X customizations, integrations, and extensions across server-side, AWC, and integration layers; set engineering standards, reusable patterns, and reference designs for the PLM team. Lead the design, development, and unit-testing of Teamcenter X server-side customizations using ITK (C/C++), including custom handlers, user exits, BMIDE extensions, and SOA service implementations, personally taking on the most complex builds. Lead migration from Aras to Teamcenter X. Set technical standards, lead architectural decisions, and ensure all customizations are well-architected, supportable, and validated within a regulated (21 CFR Part 11 / GxP) and ISO 27001-controlled environment. Architect and review Teamcenter X codeful BMIDE extensions (custom business objects, properties, methods, deep-copy rules, GRM rules); determine where codeful customization is justified versus codeless configuration. Drive Active Workspace Client (AWC) customization strategy: declarative UI (JSON view-model definitions), custom commands, client-side event handlers, and toolbar/context-menu integration; establish front-end engineering standards. Define workflow handler patterns (action, rule, condition) and EPM handlers supporting engineering change, document control, and product release processes. Architect integrations between Teamcenter X and downstream/upstream systems (JD Edwards ERP, MES, CAD, quality systems, middleware) using T4S, T4EA, SOA, REST, and message-based patterns; own end-to-end integration design across the MSD digital thread. Establish standards for technical design specifications, code reviews, unit-test results, deployment runbooks, and validation-supporting documentation (IQ/OQ/PQ artifacts) consistent with MSD’s GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and ISO 27001 standards. Own the configuration management strategy for Teamcenter customization assets under source control (Git), code-review practices, CI/CD pipelines for Teamcenter deliverables, and secure-coding standards. Partner with Teamcenter administrators on environment promotion, BMIDE template deployment, dispatcher configuration, AWC indexer/full-text search, and upgrade or patch impact analysis; lead technical impact analysis for platform upgrades. Serve as the escalation point for technical issues on production Teamcenter incidents, performance, and integration failures; lead root-cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions. Mentor senior and junior developers, lead technical reviews, contribute to architectural decisions on the Teamcenter and broader digital-thread roadmap, and represent Teamcenter engineering in cross-functional architecture forums. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline; Master’s preferred. Equivalent combination of education and experience considered. Minimum 7 years of hands-on Siemens Teamcenter development experience (Teamcenter Unified, Teamcenter 11/12/13/14 or later, or Teamcenter X), including 5+ years on AWC customization. Extensive codeful BMIDE customization experience: extending the data model, building custom properties and methods, and packaging templates for deployment across multi-environment landscapes. Extensive experience leading Active Workspace Client (AWC) customization: declarative UI (view-models in JSON), custom commands, client-side handlers, REST/SOA service consumption, and stylesheet extensions. Experience setting technical standards and mentoring senior engineers on a PLM or comparable enterprise platform team. Experience operating in regulated environments (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, ISO 9001, or comparable) and owning validation-supporting artifacts; familiarity with computer-system validation (CSV) lifecycle. Experience in medical device, life sciences, aerospace, defense, or other regulated manufacturing industries strongly preferred. Siemens Teamcenter X certifications (ITK, BMIDE, AWC) preferred. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Expertise with Teamcenter ITK (C/C++): custom handlers, user exits, server extensions, and SOA service development on enterprise-scale deployments. Proven track record architecting Teamcenter integration patterns: T4S (SAP), T4EA (Enterprise Application), Dispatcher services, SOA, REST, SOAP, and message-driven patterns; experience integrating Teamcenter with JD Edwards or comparable ERP required. Strong working knowledge of relational databases (Oracle or SQL Server) for diagnostics, schema design, and integration; able to read execution plans and tune queries. Proficiency with Git, code-review tooling, and CI/CD pipelines; experience with secure-coding practices and remediation of static-analysis and software-composition-analysis findings. Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, design patterns, modular architecture, debugging, performance analysis, and disciplined testing. Expert proficiency in C/C++ for ITK development; strong working proficiency in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, and JSON for AWC and integration development. Proven ability to translate functional specifications and solution designs into clean, well-documented, supportable, and validated code, and to set patterns others can follow. Disciplined approach to configuration management, versioning, branching, and release engineering for Teamcenter customizations across multi-environment landscapes. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and to author audit-ready design and validation documentation. Demonstrated security mindset: applies secure-coding practices, considers data-protection and access-control implications, and partners effectively with cybersecurity on findings remediation. Demonstrated propensity to be creative, collaborative, proactive, and self-motivated in the execution and completion of assigned accountabilities. Ability to provide day to day guidance/mentoring to others in a consistently supportive and collaborative approach. Continuous-learning mindset; tracks Siemens Teamcenter X release content, AWC evolution, emerging integration patterns (event-driven, API-led), and AI-assisted development tooling relevant to MSD’s roadmap. Strong critical thinking and analytical skills; sound judgment in handling complex, ambiguous technical situations. Ability to influence at all levels of the organization and drive consensus on technical direction. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: This position requires the ability to communicate and exchange information, utilize equipment necessary to perform the job, and move about the office and facilities. WORK ENVIRONMENT: This position is performed in a traditional office environment, or a hybrid model. COMPENSATION SUMMARY The annual base salary for this position ranges from $116,600.00 to $177,800.00. This salary range represents a general guideline as MSD considers other factors when presenting an offer of employment, such as scope and responsibilities of the position, external market factors, and the candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, education and experience. Employees may qualify for a discretionary or non-discretionary bonus in addition to their base salary. These annual bonuses are intended to recognize individual performance and enable employees to benefit from the Company's overall success. BENEFITS SUMMARY At MSD, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees' well-being and financial security. In addition to competitive salaries, our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with prescription benefits. We provide a 401(k) plan with company matching, flexible spending accounts, and company-paid short- and long-term disability insurance as well as group life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance. Our offerings also encompass paid vacation, paid sick leave, paid holidays, and paid parental leave, along with an employee assistance program. Additional voluntary perks include a fitness club membership contribution, pet insurance, identity theft protection, home and auto insurance discounts, and optional supplemental life insurance. title: Senior Accountant
description: Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation and Certified B Corp on a mission to create open-source software for data science, scientific research, and technical communication — and we’re building a company designed to thrive for 100 years. Our Accounting team keeps the company’s books accurate, timely, and audit-ready, and partners with Finance, Payroll, and the business to turn financial data into decisions. We’re looking for a Senior Accountant to join the team, reporting to an Accounting Manager and working closely with FP&A, Tax, Payroll, AP/AR, Engineering/IT, and our external auditors. YOUR IMPACT Why this role exists: to keep Posit’s books accurate, timely, and audit-ready — and to raise the standard for how the Accounting team works. You are singularly responsible for: Prepare accurate, timely financial statements, reconciliation schedules, and supporting analysis (flux, variance, and trend) for your assigned areas. Serve as the subject matter expert for those areas, including researching and documenting the technical accounting positions behind complex or non-routine transactions. Lead accounting projects and system changes from plan through delivery. Identify and implement improvements to accounting practices, including automation that delivers data faster and reduces risk across teams. Own internal controls for your areas; identify process or control deficiencies, design and implement solutions, and raise the standard for how the team works. Collaborate well with others, stay positive under pressure, welcome feedback, and contribute to the department’s shared goals. HOW YOU’LL COLLABORATE You’ll be the senior voice for the areas you own, working across Posit to keep the close on schedule and the controls strong: Partner with FP&A, Payroll, Tax, AP/AR, and Engineering/IT on data flows, system changes, internal controls, and month-end close dependencies. Support internal and external audits and the testing of people, process, and system controls. Mentor less experienced teammates with their questions by reviewing their work and explaining your thinking, and present regularly to the team and stakeholders. WHAT YOU’LL BRING Has independently run month-end close and prepared financial statements for multiple areas, including complex or non-routine transactions, with limited review. Hands-on NetSuite experience (or a related ERP): journal entries, reconciliations, saved searches, and running the close in the system. Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas (lookups, nested logic, pivots, and array formulas) for reconciliations and analysis. Day-to-day experience using an AI tool for analysis, automation, or documentation, with sound judgment in validating its output. Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and the ability to explain accounting decisions clearly, with the reasoning behind them. Understanding of people, process, and system controls, and a track record of leading a project or process improvement. NICE TO HAVE Extending NetSuite and our AI tooling (e.g., saved searches, workflows, scripting) to provide data faster and mitigate risk. Experience with new functional areas and technologies adjacent to accounting (e.g., revenue, billing, or subledger systems). Familiarity with our entity structure, close calendar, policies, and the systems that connect Accounting to the rest of the business — or the curiosity to learn them quickly. Large-project planning: creating major project plans, estimating well, and explaining your confidence in delivery. YOUR FIRST YEAR Within 1 month, you’ll… Complete onboarding to our close calendar, chart of accounts, policies, and our NetSuite and Numeric (month-end close software) setup, and shadow one full month-end close. Take over the reconciliations and journal entries for your assigned accounts and complete them on the close calendar with reviewer sign-off. Document the people, process, and system controls for your assigned areas and share a list of risks and questions with your manager. Meet 1:1 with key partners (FP&A, Tax, AP/AR, and audit contacts) to learn their needs and agree on how you will work together. Within 3 months, you’ll… Prepare your assigned financial statements and flux analysis independently for two consecutive closes, with minimal review comments. Present a variance analysis to the team that is clearly structured and explains the drivers behind the numbers. Contribute your assigned inputs to the budget schedule on time, with supporting detail and clearly stated assumptions. Identify at least two process improvements, rank them by impact and effort, and implement one end to end. Research and document the technical accounting position for one non-routine transaction or policy area, and walk the Accounting Managers through it. Within 6 months, you’ll… Enhance or redesign reconciliations to show substantial backup and clear explanation of work. Lead one project or system change end to end: write the project plan, estimate the work, state your confidence in the timeline, and deliver on it. Design and ship an automation (using NetSuite, Excel, and/or AI tools) that reduces manual effort in the close or reporting process and gets data to stakeholders faster. Present to the team on a regular cadence (e.g., monthly) and take on additional accounting responsibilities. Within 12 months, you’ll… Be the recognized subject matter expert for your areas, the person others consult on complex accounting questions, while owning an expanded set of areas and meeting close deadlines. Drive process improvements that change how the team operates, with measurable results (e.g., close days saved, hours of manual work removed). Design and implement append-only, tamper-evident audit logging solutions to ensure data integrity, traceability, and accountability across systems. Develop and enforce security guardrail policies, leveraging policy engines such as Open Policy Agent (OPA) or Cedar to support governance and compliance requirements. Implement and maintain identity and access management (IAM) controls, including role-based permissions and secure access policies to protect sensitive systems and data. title: Mobile Architect (POS Terminal)
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About the role As a Principal Mobile Engineer (POS-Terminal) at Moniepoint , you will be responsible for designing and leading the architecture of our POS terminal solutions across multiple platforms. You will ensure the scalability, security, performance, and reliability of our POS systems and related applications, including mobile apps for repair scheduling and maintenance. While the majority of our terminals are currently based on Android Native, your expertise in cross-platform solutions (e.g., Flutter, C, JavaScript) will be crucial as we expand and diversify our portfolio.You’ll play a critical role in shaping the direction of our POS-related products, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring the technical vision aligns with the company’s broader strategic goals. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. What you will do: Lead the design and architecture of POS terminal solutions, ensuring security, scalability, performance, and integration with various hardware and payment systems. Develop and maintain architectural documents and diagrams for POS terminal systems, ensuring all platforms are well documented and up to date. Make architectural decisions on POS terminal software, integrating various payment technologies, EMV standards, and ensuring hardware compatibility. Lead the development of POS-related applications Optimize system performance and security, particularly around payment processing and EMV protocols. Participate in planning sessions with product and engineering teams to ensure solutions meet market needs and business goals. Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices for mobile and embedded systems development, especially for Android Native development. Define and enforce software engineering best practices across the POS and related teams to improve efficiency and developer productivity. Ensure the stability and reliability of POS terminal products and applications, monitoring system performance and troubleshooting as necessary. Provide technical mentorship to engineering teams, helping them grow their skills and contribute to the broader technical vision. Participate in the hiring process, screening engineers with expertise in POS systems, mobile, and embedded development. To succeed in this role, we think you should have: At least 8 years of experience in system design, architecture, and development, specifically in the POS terminal domain. Strong expertise in Android Native development (Java/Kotlin), with a deep understanding of Android-based POS terminal solutions. Experience in cross-platform mobile development, such as Flutter , and familiarity with other POS application platforms (e.g., C, JavaScript) is a plus. Strong knowledge of EMV (Europay, Mastercard, and Visa) security protocols, including chip-based transactions, encryption, and key management. Experience with hardware integration for POS devices, such as card readers, pin pads, printers, and other peripherals. Deep understanding of payment systems architecture , including integration with payment processors and gateways. Knowledge of software quality assurance principles and their application in financial systems. Excellent problem-solving skills with an ability to manage complex system interactions and adapt to changing requirements. Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Leadership abilities with a focus on mentoring engineers and driving process improvements within the team. What we can offer you Culture -We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance,annual bonus, plus other benefits. What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters A Takehome Hackerrank test. A Technical interview session with our Engineering Team A Technical and Behavioural Interview with our Head of Mobile Engineering A Behavioral and Technical interview with a member of the Executive team. Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Amazon Brand Development & Launch Manager
description: Are you an Amazon expert with a passion for creating and scaling winning products? Our client, an international company selling beauty products in the USA, is looking for a highly strategic and execution-driven Amazon Manager to take full ownership of its Amazon brand management and new product development and launch processes. In this role, youll lead everything from market validation to top-ranking execution, ensuring each launch is set up for explosive success in the US marketplace. Youll also drive growth for existing products through continual optimization and data-backed decisions. If you have a proven track record of successful Amazon launches, deep knowledge of the platform, and a hands-on approach to scaling products, we want to connect with you. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end Amazon product development process : from market research and validation to launch and post-launch optimization. Develop and execute standardized, scalable launch SOPs. Own Amazon launch strategy , including listing creation, PPC, pricing, inventory, and reviews. Collaborate closely with product development, creatives, and operations teams to bring products to market effectively. Oversee the creation of SEO-optimized, conversion-focused product listings using keyword research and competitor analysis. Launch products with a clear focus on early momentum: sales velocity, review generation, and keyword ranking. Utilize tools like Helium 10, Keepa, Data Dive, and others to support data-driven decision-making throughout the lifecycle. Monitor products performance daily, making agile adjustments to improve KPIs. Strategize and implement initial PPC campaigns , budget allocation, and ASIN targeting to gain visibility fast. Plan inventory based on launch timelines, velocity estimates, and restock strategies. Conduct detailed post-launch analysis to extract insights and apply them to future launches. Identify and mitigate launch-related risks (e.g., hijackers, suppression, stockouts). Support and mentor internal team members on launch best practices and innovation. What Were Looking For 4+ years of Amazon experience , ideally in the US marketplace with a focus on Product launches and Brand development, ideally in the Health and Personal care or Beauty niche. Strong Brand Management skills. Proven success in bringing new products from concept to profitability. Deep understanding of Amazon visuals, SEO , keyword ranking, and listing optimization. Expertise in tools like Helium 10, Keepa, Data Dive, Jungle Scout , etc. Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into action. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable in a fast-paced, results-driven environment. Strategic thinker with an entrepreneurial mindset and high ownership. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Speed from concept to launch (goal: 1-3 months per product). Sales velocity and keyword ranking achieved in first 30-60 days post-launch. Number of successful launches. Initial review generation and conversion rate performance. Ongoing sales growth and performance improvements of existing products. Inventory accuracy and stock availability during launches. What We Offer Flexible Working Hours We care about results, not your 9 to 5. Remote-First Culture Work from wherever you feel most productive. Startup Energy Fast-paced, collaborative, and full of opportunities to grow. Paid Time Off Because rest fuels innovation. Mentorship From a Visionary Leader Learn directly from a founder whos built and scaled businesses across Europe with a track record of turning bold ideas into reality. Real Impact Your work wont sit in a backlog; it goes live, gets noticed, and makes a difference. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Fullstack Developer
description: About this Role We're looking for a Founding Full Stack Engineer to help build and scale Valerie's multi-tenant platform for e-commerce brands. You'll work across the entire product stack — from React interfaces and TypeScript contracts to NestJS APIs, PostgreSQL, AWS, testing, and deployment. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll own features from architecture and implementation through to production. You'll work closely with the Product and Engineering teams to turn evolving ideas into reliable, production-ready systems. You'll have significant ownership in how we build, test, deploy, and scale the platform, while also contributing to the development of Valerie's AI Agents and Brands & Investment Growth Platform. You could be a great fit if... You enjoy working across the full stack rather than being limited to frontend or backend. You like taking a feature from an idea or requirement all the way through to production. You are comfortable making architecture and technical decisions independently in a fast-moving environment. You care about building production-ready systems, not just getting code to work. You have strong TypeScript fundamentals and enjoy working with both React and Node.js. You naturally think about scalability, security, performance, and maintainability when building features. You enjoy solving complex problems across the browser, API, database, and infrastructure layers. You take ownership when something breaks and are comfortable digging into logs, metrics, and production evidence to find the root cause. You enjoy improving engineering workflows, code quality, testing, CI/CD, and development practices. You're excited by the opportunity to help build a product and technical foundation from an early stage. Requirements 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial ownership of production systems. 3+ years of advanced TypeScript development across both frontend and backend. Strong understanding of TypeScript, including generics, discriminated unions, type narrowing, utility types, and strict compiler configuration. Advanced React experience, including component architecture, hooks, server state management, form performance, and reusable UI patterns. Experience building complex forms using React Hook Form or an equivalent library, with schema validation using Zod, Yup, or JSON Schema. Strong Node.js and NestJS experience, including dependency injection, modular architecture, validation, guards, interceptors, and exception handling. Strong understanding of REST API design, including resource modelling, pagination, filtering, versioning, idempotency, and consistent error handling. Strong PostgreSQL knowledge, including relational modelling, constraints, transactions, indexes, and query optimisation. Experience with Prisma ORM, including migrations and avoiding inefficient database query patterns. Experience securing web applications using JWT or OAuth 2.0, RBAC, secure cookies, token rotation, and OWASP practices. Experience writing automated tests using Jest and browser-level tests using Playwright. Production experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Practical AWS experience across areas such as container deployment, managed databases, object storage, load balancing, IAM, configuration management, and observability. Strong Git skills and experience working through pull requests and technical code reviews. Ability to independently investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, database, and cloud infrastructure. Bonus Points Experience with Nx or another JavaScript monorepo build system. Experience building multi-tenant SaaS products and implementing tenant-level data isolation. Experience with performance optimisation and observability for distributed applications. Experience working in a startup or 0→1 product environment. Experience building products involving AI agents, AI workflows, or LLM-powered applications. Experience working closely with Product teams to turn ambiguous requirements into technical solutions. What Success Looks Like Features are strongly typed from database and API contracts through to the React interface. Authentication, authorisation, and tenant boundaries are enforced securely at the server level. Database changes are supported by safe migrations, appropriate constraints, and thoughtful indexing. Critical business workflows have meaningful automated test coverage. Pull requests are clean, maintainable, and supported by clear technical reasoning. Production issues can be traced through structured logs, metrics, and reproducible evidence. Services can be deployed through automated, repeatable pipelines without manual configuration. You take ownership of what you build and continuously improve the reliability and quality of the platform. You probably shouldn't apply if... You prefer working exclusively on either frontend or backend. You need detailed instructions before making technical decisions. You see engineering as simply writing code against predefined tickets. You're uncomfortable working in an environment where requirements and priorities evolve quickly. You don't enjoy debugging problems that span multiple layers of the technology stack. You prefer highly structured environments with established systems and processes. You aren't comfortable taking ownership of a feature after it has been deployed. The best time to join Valerie was yesterday. The next best time is now 🤓 👋 Our Hiring Process We want interviews to be valuable for both sides. Throughout the process, you'll meet the people you'll work with, learn more about the role, and get a chance to understand how we think and operate. Our process typically includes: Introductory conversation with our Talent team <> 30 mins Hiring Manager interview <> 30-45 mins Role-specific assessment or practical exercise (where applicable) Cross-functional or stakeholder interviews <> 30-45 mins Final conversation with leadership <> 30-45 mins We'll always let you know what to expect before each stage. 💪🏾 What You Can Expect Meaningful work with visible impact High ownership from day one Collaboration with experienced founders, operators, and specialists A team that values curiosity, initiative, and continuous improvement Competitive compensation and the tools you need to do your best work Opportunities to grow as Valerie grows Valerie is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We hire based on skills, potential, and the ability to contribute to our team. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: SPOC Manager
description: Overview Looking for a career with purpose and reward? At LoanCare we help customers every day with what is for many their largest and most personal financial transaction: the purchase of their home. With the mission to simplify the complex with empathy and insight, we are constantly innovating and are a top provider in the mortgage services industry as a result. We are actively seeking to fill the role of SPOC Manager. This role leads the daily operations of the SPOC department, ensuring compliant, efficient, and customer-focused delivery of loss mitigation and borrower assistance services. Provides strategic leadership to supervisors and staff while driving performance, workforce planning, process improvement, risk management, and cross-functional partnership to achieve business objectives. Responsibilities Direct and manage the daily operations of the SPOC department through subordinate supervisors and staff. Ensure all SPOC processes comply with investor, insurer, agency, client, and company requirements, including applicable loss mitigation regulations and borrower communication standards. Develop and implement departmental strategies and objectives that support corporate goals, borrower retention initiatives, and operational efficiency. Manage, coach, counsel, and develop SPOC Supervisors and other assigned leaders. Establish performance goals, monitor results, and implement action plans to improve productivity, quality, compliance, and customer experience. Ensure borrowers are provided accurate and timely information regarding available loss mitigation solutions and foreclosure prevention options. Review departmental performance metrics, identify trends, and implement process improvements to increase effectiveness and reduce operational risk. Oversee staffing, workforce planning, scheduling strategies, and training initiatives to meet operational demands and service level expectations. Monitor dialer performance, call campaigns, queue management, and workload distribution to maximize borrower outreach and engagement. Evaluate escalated borrower concerns, executive complaints, regulatory inquiries, and other complex servicing matters, providing guidance and resolution as appropriate. Prepare and distribute management reporting, performance scorecards, trend analyses, and key operational updates to senior leadership. Ensure quality assurance standards are maintained through regular monitoring, coaching, call reviews, and performance feedback. Partner with Compliance, Legal, Quality Control, Training, Workforce Management, and Operations teams to implement regulatory and operational changes. Ensure departmental policies and procedures are maintained, updated, tested, approved, and implemented in accordance with business and regulatory requirements. Identify and mitigate operational, compliance, and reputational risks within the SPOC function. Support internal and external audits, client reviews, regulatory examinations, and remediation efforts. Drive a culture of accountability, customer focus, continuous improvement, and employee engagement. All other duties as assigned. Qualifications High School Diploma or equivalent required. 6-8 years of mortgage servicing, default servicing, loss mitigation, collections, or related experience. 5+ years of leadership experience managing subordinate supervisors or large operational teams. Strong knowledge of mortgage servicing, default operations, loss mitigation programs, foreclosure prevention strategies, and borrower assistance options. Thorough understanding of investor, insurer, government, client, and company requirements related to default servicing and loss mitigation. Demonstrated ability to lead multiple teams in a fast-paced operational environment. Strong analytical, organizational, and strategic planning abilities. Proven ability to evaluate operational metrics and implement solutions that improve performance and efficiency. Advanced problem-solving and decision-making skills. Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution capabilities. Ability to effectively manage competing priorities and meet deadlines. Experience developing policies, procedures, training materials, and operational controls. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Ability to assess operational risk and implement appropriate controls and corrective actions. Desired Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience preferred. Advanced knowledge of loss mitigation servicing platforms and mortgage servicing systems preferred. Experience managing remote and multi-site operations preferred. Experience supporting client-facing reporting and operational reviews preferred. LPS-MSP (Mortgage Servicing Platform) experience preferred. Prior experience leading large-scale process improvement initiatives preferred. Total Rewards LoanCare ’s Total Rewards Package offers a comprehensive blend of health and welfare, financial, lifestyle and learning benefits to support employee well-being and engagement. Highlights include: Health & Welfare Coverage: Optional medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance Time Off: Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave Retirement & Investment: Matching 401(k) plan and employee stock purchase plan Wellness Programs: Access to mental health resources, including free Calm memberships, and initiatives that promote physical and emotional well-being Employee Recognition: Programs that celebrate achievements and milestones Lifestyle & Learning Perks: Enjoy discounts on gym memberships, pet insurance, and employee purchasing programs, plus access to a tuition reimbursement program that supports your continued education and professional growth. Compensation Range: $74,600-$139,800 annually. Actual compensation may vary within the range provided, depending on a number of factors, including qualifications, skills and experience. Build Your Future with LoanCare ® At LoanCare , we don’t just service mortgage loans—we serve people. As a leading full-service mortgage loan subservicer, we deliver excellence to banks, credit unions, independent mortgage companies, investors, and the homeowners they support. Backed by the strength and stability of Fidelity National Financial (NYSE: FNF), a Fortune 500 company, we offer a career foundation built on integrity, innovation, and collaboration. Here, you’ll find: A culture that helps you thrive, with resources and support to fuel your growth Flexibility to work remotely, while staying connected through virtual engagement Opportunities to make a real impact in an industry that touches millions of lives If you're ready to grow your career in a place that values your contributions and empowers your success, we invite you to join our team. About Remote Employment We provide the necessary equipment; all you need is a quiet, private place in your home and a high-speed internet connection with a minimum network download speed of 25 megabits per second (MBPS) and a minimum network upload speed of 10 MBPS. Work Conditions Able to attend work and be productive during normal business hours and to work early, late or weekend hours as needed for successful job performance. Overtime required as necessary. Physical Demands Sitting up to 90% of the time Walking and standing up to 10% of the time Occasional lifting, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and reaching Equal Employment Opportunity LoanCare , its affiliates and subsidiaries, is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. title: Amazon Brand Growth Manager
description: Our client, GNO partners, a well established fully remote Amazon brand consulting agency helping 7-figure Amazon FBA Sellers increase their profits and revenues while streamlining their operations, is looking to fill an immediate opening for an Amazon Brand Growth Manager for a full-time remote job . As the Amazon Brand Growth Manager, you will be responsible for researching and developing new products and variations to expand the brands product line, launching products in the Amazon ecosystem and expanding brands into new Amazon marketplaces, predominantly in Canada, the UK, and the EU, with a possible extension to Japan. If you have minimum three years of such experience in the Amazon FBA field, proficient with Amazon PPC and you like strategizing with clients and seeing their business grow, are hard working, love and know how to overcome complex challenges, got strong attention to detail, and is technologically savvy, we would love to hear from you! About the Company: We assist clients in reaching their goals - whether it's exiting their business or scaling and making it more automated with a solid team and systems. Our service delivery model is that of a consultant (Done With You), not a service provider (Done For You). We value hard work, speed, over-delivery, trust, and honesty. We are growing rapidly, currently with a team of 6 people, with 25+ clients (all 7 figures). Our Values: ‍ - Go the extra mile: Strive for excellence and give your best effort in everything you do. Aim to exceed expectations and deliver exceptional results in internal tasks and with clients. - Focus on Speed: Work quickly and efficiently to achieve timely and accurate outcomes. Respond quickly and prioritize timely action. - Embrace feedback and new ideas: Openly share your thoughts, suggestions, and ideas. We value your feedback and encourage you to contribute innovative ideas that can help us improve and grow. - Clients come first: Prioritize our clients success and satisfaction. Make their needs a top priority in your daily work, ensuring we consistently deliver value and excellent service. Responsibilities: Research, develop and launch new products and variations to expand the brands product lines on Amazon. Owning the partnership number: You will report partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, joint bookings contribution, integration and certification milestones, and field activation to vCluster leadership - with MEDDPICC on every joint opportunity and weekly pipeline inspection. Data over opinions. Process over heroics. This role could be a fit for you if you bring: Alliance leadership at scale: 10+ years in strategic alliances, partner sales, business development, or ecosystem leadership in enterprise software or AI infrastructure, with a proven track record building a strategic technology alliance that produced significant, measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue. Deep NVIDIA ecosystem experience: You have managed an NVIDIA alliance, co-sold with NVIDIA field teams, or operated deeply within the NVIDIA Partner Network and GPU ecosystem - and you know how to navigate a massive, matrixed organization from senior technical decision-makers to GTM leadership. AI infrastructure fluency: Working understanding of NVIDIA's technologies and programs (GPUs, DGX, SuperPOD, networking/DPUs, AI Enterprise, NCP, ISV certification) and of Kubernetes, cloud-native platforms, and AI/ML infrastructure - enough to earn credibility with architects and translate it into business value, ROI, and outcomes for executives. Influence without authority: Demonstrated ability to mobilize cross-functional teams - Product, Engineering, Marketing, regional sales - on both sides of an alliance, without direct organizational control. Operating rigor: Consultative, outcomes-based style with disciplined qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent), forecasting hygiene, and reporting discipline. Builder's instinct: Comfort operating in an ambiguous, high-velocity environment. You compress timelines rather than manage them - a builder, not a caretaker. Bonus points for: Existing NVIDIA relationships: A live network across NVIDIA partner programs, solutions architecture, or field sales that shortens your ramp. Open-source ecosystem familiarity: Experience positioning open-source-born platforms inside large vendor ecosystems. Multi-party deal construction: History of building OEM, storage, or GSI plays around an anchor silicon partner. MBA or equivalent commercial depth: Useful for program structuring and executive business reviews. About vCluster Labs We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture. We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software. We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems. Premium Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country). To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day. Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way. Culture & Values At vCluster Labs , we value and stand for: Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business. description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations. What you’ll do Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability. Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers. Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them. Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers. Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up. Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user. Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC). NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0. JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors. A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching. Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us. A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role. Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region. Nice to have: Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite). Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP). Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD. Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor. Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope. Integration Engineer Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards. Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces. Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team. Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions. Senior Integration Engineer Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards. Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments. Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow. Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases. Why BLP Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live. Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards. Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares. Team: regular team events. Practical information Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.
