title: Principal Software Engineer - Rack Scale Systems Infrastructure
description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIA N, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. At NVIDIA , as a Principal Rack Scale Systems Infrastructure Engineer, you will build and guide the development of software systems. These systems support our upcoming rack-scale infrastructure products and services. This exceptional role sits where software meets hardware. You will work on control planes, state machines, orchestration systems, firmware, OS lifecycle, and networking fabrics. Your task is to compose infrastructure-as-a-service control plane software that converts complex rack-scale hardware into dependable, manageable, and programmable infrastructure for NVIDIA , partners, and leading cloud and enterprise clients globally. What You Will Be Doing: Define the complete software architecture for rack-scale infrastructure products and services, covering control plane services, infrastructure management, firmware, operating systems, kernel drivers, networking fabrics, accelerator software, and user-mode manageability software. Use Kubernetes and cloud-native primitives as an infrastructure fabric when appropriate. This includes controllers, operators, reconciliation loops, and open source components. These components can operate safely at rack and fleet scale. Build open source infrastructure software that can be embraced in different forms, including libraries, services, controllers, operators, and integration APIs for internal deployments and CSP environments. Bridge hardware and software teams across firmware, BMC, BIOS, boot flows, OS images, drivers, networking, NVLink domains, InfiniBand, GPUs, DPUs, CPUs, and system management interfaces. Translate forward-looking infrastructure roadmaps into formal software requirements, architecture specifications, and execution plans that align teams across the organization. Partner directly with hyperscalers, CSPs, enterprise customers, internal component leads, vendors, and business partners to align infrastructure capabilities with real-world deployment and integration needs. Establish reliability, security, validation, and left-shift strategies that reduce risk before hardware reaches production environments. Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, raising the engineering bar for large-scale networked systems, foundational software, and rack-scale control plane development. Make high-quality technical decisions in ambiguous environments, balancing customer needs, schedule, hardware realities, software maintainability, open source adoption, and long-term infrastructure evolution. What We Need To See: BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Proven experience (15+ years) in systems architecture, system software, distributed systems, infrastructure control planes, or infrastructure engineering. Solid architectural knowledge of coordination frameworks, state machines, declarative APIs, reconciliation loops, lifecycle orchestration, failure handling, upgrade and rollback workflows, and distributed systems tradeoffs. Practical coding skills in Go, C++, or Rust, encompassing the capability to write, review, and direct production-quality infrastructure software. Experience with Rust is highly valued. Experience with Kubernetes or similar orchestration systems, especially as a fabric for managing infrastructure, hardware resources, or large-scale infrastructure services. Experience with Linux-based infrastructure software, OS rollout and image management, kernel or driver interactions, firmware lifecycle, and hardware bring-up workflows. Strong understanding of data center networking technologies and protocols, such as Ethernet, InfiniBand, RDMA, and fabric-level manageability. Experience with complex accelerator-based systems, including GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs, custom silicon, or other high-performance computing systems. Expertise in in-band and out-of-band management architectures, including BMCs, Redfish, IPMI, and related system management protocols. Ability to work with security experts to define practical tradeoffs across secure boot, attestation, access control, update safety, serviceability, and ease of operation. Experience crafting software intended for open source release, including API stability, modularity, documentation, community usability, and clean separation between shared software and deployment-specific integrations. Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly as an engineering multiplier for coding, test generation, debugging, build iteration, and documentation. Established skill in specifying requirements, guiding architecture, and managing delivery across various engineering teams and organizations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, enabling clear explanation of complex hardware/software tradeoffs to engineering leaders, customers, partners, and executives. Ways To Stand Out from the crowd: Built software supporting multiple adoption models — internal services, CSP-integrated offerings, reusable libraries, and customer-extensible APIs. Strong Rust skills in systems, infrastructure, or hardware-adjacent software. Multiplied team impact through reference implementations, design reviews, shared libraries, architecture docs, dev workflows, and AI-assisted engineering. Hands-on with fleet-scale provisioning, updates, rollback, observability, health, and remediation. Led across the full data center product lifecycle: inception, pre- and post-silicon, manufacturing, deployment, and operations. Familiar with open source ecosystems, contribution models, and balancing community collaboration with product needs. Deep experience with rack- or cluster-scale systems spanning compute, networking, storage, accelerators, firmware, and infra management as one operational domain. Skilled at finding simple, durable abstractions in complex systems to align teams, customers, and long-term direction. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. title: Principal Architect, System Software - Orbital Data Center
description: Space-1 is NVIDIA 's first Orbital Data Center (ODC) module — a Vera Rubin–class compute platform engineered for low-Earth orbit mission. It is the first step in a multi-generation orbital roadmap to speed up AI adoption. We are looking for a strong technical architect to own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor orbital platforms. You will architect the full stack — application to libraries, from data center stack to BMC and BIOS firmware, manageability, and telemetry through the host OS, GPU and CPU drivers, and CUDA — to deliver a production-ready inference platform that operates reliably in the radiation, thermal-cycling, and remote-operations environment of LEO. You will partner closely with the orbital hardware system architecture team, drive customer use cases with constellation operators, align architecture with mission requirements, and bring the best orbital AI products to market. Join us at the forefront of technological advancement. What you'll be doing: Own system architecture for inference stack and other applications running on this class of products and make it resilient to any fault happening in space. Co-architect with the orbital hardware system architecture team to define interfaces, partitioning, and trade-offs across silicon, board, firmware, OS, and AI workload layers for 5-year LEO missions. Own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor Orbital Data Center modules — covering data center stack, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, GPU/CPU drivers, CUDA, DCGM, and manageability telemetry as a single integrated stack. Define the manageability architecture for an unreachable, autonomous data center: remote bring-up, in-orbit firmware update, dual-module redundancy, fault containment, recovery from SEU/SEFI events, and telemetry for fleets ranging from tens to millions of nodes. Architect rad-tolerant system software behaviors — ECC handling, memory scrubbing, latch-up mitigation, deterministic recovery, and graceful degradation through 5 years and up to ~8,000 thermal cycles in dawn–dusk sun-synchronous orbit. Drive Redfish, MCTP, PLDM, and constellation-level management protocols across BMC, BIOS, and host software so customers can operate orbital fleets with the same tools they use on the ground. Define minimum BMC feature set, pin budget, boot architecture (rugged M.2 / VPX-class options), and dual-module redundancy strategy in partnership with platform and mechanical engineering. Partner with cloud and constellation customers (SpaceX, Blue Origin, Starcloud, Planet, Cowboy Space, and others) to translate mission requirements — orbit, duty cycle, NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking (CX9), inference SLAs — into actionable platform software architecture. Drive reliability and optimization in the system software architecture from an orbital data center viewpoint, including correct operation through eclipse periods and idle-power retention strategies. Work closely with the bring-up team and resolve issues at Speed of Light from first silicon through first launch.Own quality, reliability, and telemetry performance of the system software delivered with each ODC module shipped to customers. What we need to see: 15+ years of relevant experience in server/platform system software — spanning compute libraries, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, drivers, and manageability BS, MS, or PhD in EE/CS or related field of education (or equivalent experience). Working experience in building AI infrastructure and systems in space. Proven record of architecting and delivering platform software for large-scale data centers or mission-critical embedded systems. Strong knowledge of server architecture, data center manageability, and full-stack integration of firmware with OS and accelerator software. Hands-on experience with data center health management workflows, telemetry, and fault management at scale. Solid understanding of hardware management interfaces (USB, SMBus/I2C, PCIe) and proficiency with modern management protocols including Redfish, MCTP, and PLDM. Strong and demonstrable skill in C/C++ and Python. Experience programming and debugging server platforms, including pre-silicon and platform bring-up environments. Experience in SCM (e.g. Git, Perforce) and project management tools like Jira. Excellent written and oral communication skills, good work ethics, high sense of team-work, love to produce quality work, and commitment to finish your tasks every single day. You are a self-starter who loves to find creative solutions to complicated problems and hands on with coding. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience architecting platform software for space, aerospace, defense, or other radiation, thermal, and vibration-constrained environments — including SEU/SEFI mitigation, ECC strategy, TID/SEE qualification, and rad-hard design partitioning. Being a part of a start up or initiative directly related to space data centers. Hands-on experience with autonomous, remote, or unreachable data center operations — in-orbit or in-field firmware update, dual-module redundancy, and recovery without physical access. Hands-on with x86 or ARM (Grace/Vera) system architecture and the NVIDIA AI software stack (CUDA, DCGM, DOCA/OFED, GPU drivers, DGX OS). Familiarity with NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking, and aerospace standards (VPX, MIL-STD shock/vibe, NASA EEE-INST-002). Proven technical leadership driving large complex programs with 50+ engineers across firmware, OS, driver, and AI stack teams. Skilled in reviewing hardware schematics and PCB layouts for debugging, design verification, and collaboration with hardware engineers. NVIDIA 's invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our invention serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is seeking exceptional individuals like you to help us drive the next wave of artificial intelligence. title: Sales Closer
description: This is a remote position. Executive Sales Summary I am looking for a few highly skilled and sophisticated sales leaders to manage “Make A Deal Meetings” where we propose partnership terms, negotiate terms and close deals with high-producing and established real estate businesses and small service-based businesses, over Zoom Meetings. Our successful candidates will represent Fusion in these negotiations with individuals who have already been through an “Explanation of Investment” who have self-identified as someone who would like to have our investment IF we can arrange the financial terms in such as way that it will fit into their business. The goal is to help the person make a decision in that meeting at terms that are agreeable to our firm and execute the agreement. The meetings last between 1 and 3 hours and we will arrange 2 to 4 meetings per day. Our current closing ratio is just under 50% when the prospect shows for the meeting. The income range is $180,000 to $300,0000 annually. If you have an interest, PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE AD BEFORE APPLYING. WE PROVIDE EXTENSIVE INFORMATION ABOUT THE COMPANY AND THE POSITION. Job Description Our Sales Leader is a closer and a negotiate. We generate business from cold calls and set up meetings for our Partnership Development Executives to walk them through a VERY DETAIL explanation of our business model and how we invest into these small business operations. At the end of the Investment presentation our Executives pose two primary questions, 1. Does the Prospect “love” the business model concept? And 2. Does the Prospect believe that over time that if we provide all the services we covered consistently over months, would their business significantly improve? Only if a prospects answers affirmatively to both questions will the meeting continue. IF the answers are yes, we then explain our “Make A Deal” meeting process. The “Make A Deal Meeting” is basically a meeting where both parties come together in one meeting to try and figure out agreeable terms to both parties and close the deal and execute the meeting ideally in one meeting. We start by proposing reasonable terms and a financial model for our investment of resources and then we are willing to improve pricing IF they are ready to move forward. To help lubricate the sales process, we offer a two-week rescission period and a guarantee of income growth of hundreds of thousands of dollars if they follow our program. About the Company Fusion Growth Partners is a business incubator and micro venture capital company. We invest resources in businesses that are experiencing success at certain levels but have a high desire to grow a lot more. We invest in a unique way where most investors would never consider these types of businesses. When we partner with small service-based businesses of individual real estate agents, we invest heavily into their businesses to them significantly grow their clientele and scale business profits. We consider ourselves as a “Partnership as a Service” business similar to, but different than, a SaaS business. Fusion was recently ranked as the 813th fastest-growing business by Inc. 5000. Therefore, we consider this role to be one of the best opportunities for sales professional business advisors available today. Our partners benefit from Fusion providing their business with sophisticated growth planning, a full suite of back-office services and SaaS resources, plus the support of our experienced staff. Fusion is the only company in the country that currently offers these services and is compensated in a way that conveniently accommodates the cash flow challenges of a real estate agent. We have over 300 team members and are growing very quickly. We need more talent to enter untouched markets. Fusion invests in companies through strategic revenue-sharing growth partnerships. Our investment resources include, but are not limited to, thousands of dollars of business building systems and processes and the staff to operate those business systems which are all provided as an investment into our partners' businesses. Fusion’s income is primarily generated from a small share of the revenue generated by our partner’s businesses. Our company is looking to hire additional Partnership Development Executives to support our rapidly growing volume of new partnership investments. Requirements Desired Candidate Attributes We are looking for individuals who are of the highest negotiation and closing skill level possible. We have a great position for those who love to close sales enjoy the satisfaction of accomplishing the desired goal. However, we are selling a relationship, not a product and therefore our candidate(s) must not embellish in anyway, or mislead in anyway, create expectations that will not be realized, because this will create service and investment scenarios that will hurt our company’s reputation and brand. Our sales process has already been engineered and the closing ration is high, BUT it takes finesse and requires awareness of the nuances of prospects emotional decision-making processes. We want professionals who have the highest level of closing skill for true sales professionals, but we do not want “know it all’s” who are not coachable or not willing to learn our playbook. Our individuals must be willing to be team players. We want individuals who have business savvy and acumen, extensive experience in closing sales with a short sales cycle. We are looking for individuals who we can rely on. They do what they say they will do every time. We want hungry people. We want salespeople who have finesse, confidence and yet carry themselves with an air of humbleness. For the benefit of those who are reading this ad, you can view an example of the presentation we provide for Real Estate Agents at: (PASSWORD- FusionRocks123! ) and you can view the rest of our website at: Please provide a resume if you are interested in learning more about this opportunity. The NOC Infrastructure Administrator is responsible for monitoring, administration, and operational support of Linux, Windows, and cloud-based infrastructure in a 24/7 production environment. This role focuses on maintaining system availability, resolving technical issues, supporting operational processes, and ensuring the stability and performance of critical business systems. As part of a round-the-clock operations team, the successful candidate will participate in a rotating shift schedule and play a key role in supporting mission-critical infrastructure and services. The ideal candidate has strong system administration experience, solid troubleshooting skills, and hands-on knowledge of cloud platforms, virtualization technologies, networking fundamentals, and infrastructure monitoring tools. Responsibilities Provide operational support for a 24/7 NOC environment supporting Linux and Windows-based systems. Operate, maintain, and manage Linux and Windows systems supporting production operations. Perform data backup and recovery activities. Monitor, manage, and maintain Linux and Windows servers and applications. Create and maintain environment-specific operating procedures and documentation. Create, manage, and maintain user accounts and group memberships in Active Directory. Perform daily system monitoring, ensuring system integrity, availability, and successful completion of scheduled jobs and backups. Define, prioritize, troubleshoot, and resolve support requests in an organized and efficient manner. Administer and monitor cloud-based infrastructure and managed services. Develop, maintain, and utilize automation scripts using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies. Assist with patch management in Linux and Windows environments. Create and maintain operational, configuration, and knowledge base documentation. Lead shift operations when required. 4+ years of experience in Linux and Windows system administration. Experience supporting production infrastructure in a 24/7 operational environment. Strong knowledge of Linux and Windows server administration. Experience with system and application monitoring in production environments Hands-on knowledge of networking concepts, including DNS, TCP/IP, DHCP, IP networking , and network troubleshootin g. Experience administering Microsoft infrastructure technologies , including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and Windows Security. Experience with cloud platforms and virtualization technologies such as AWS, Azure, VMware, and Hyper-V . Experience developing automation scripts using Bash, PowerShell, Python , or similar scripting languages. Working knowledge of SQL queries and database troubleshooting. Experience with web server administration and configuration. Experience working with enterprise monitoring tools such as Nagios, Datadog, Jira, Salesforce , or similar platforms. Experience managing incidents, documenting resolutions, and following operational procedures. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Positive and collaborative attitude. Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Ability to identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements to systems and processes. Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. Strong organizational, prioritization, and decision-making skills. Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team environment. Flexibility to work day, evening, night, weekend, and holiday shifts as part of a rotating schedule. We offer: Culture of relentless performance : join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth. Competitive pay and benefits : enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program. ForeverRemote work culture : make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work. Growth mindset : reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities. Global impact : collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries. Welcoming multicultural environment : be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events. Social sustainability values : join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality. * Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law. Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech 's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%. title: Accountant
description: Company Description: Our client is a retailer of home textiles and accessories, with six vibrant stores across the Kingdom, located in Jeddah, Riyadh, and Madina. Their aim is to be a distinguished lifestyle brand, offering products with designs that make a statement. We are committed to providing our customers with high-quality materials at reasonable prices. Our client believes in enhancing their customers' living spaces with beautiful and comfortable home essentials that reflect their personal style. Job Summary: The Accountant is responsible for supporting the day-to-day accounting operations of the company by maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring transactions are properly recorded, and assisting with reconciliations and financial reporting. The role covers a broad range of accounting activities, including transaction recording, inventory accounting, sales reconciliation, payroll review, VAT compliance, and financial documentation, while ensuring adherence to company policies, accounting standards, and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Requirements Key Responsibilities: Accounting Records Record daily financial transactions in the accounting system. Prepare and post journal entries with proper supporting documentation. Maintain accurate and organized financial records. Accounts Processing Record supplier invoices and assist with supplier payment processing in coordination with the Finance Manager. Record customer payments and monitor receivable balances. Ensure expenses are recorded accurately and allocated to the appropriate accounts. Store & POS Reconciliation Reconcile store sales with POS reports and system records. Review store cash deposits and investigate discrepancies. Ensure accurate recording of sales from all channels, including retail stores and online platforms. Inventory Accounting Record inventory transactions and adjustments in the accounting system. Assist in reconciling physical inventory with system records. Support stock count procedures and investigate inventory variances. Calculate and allocate landed costs (freight, customs duties, and related import expenses) to inventory to ensure accurate product costing. Bank & Account Reconciliation Perform regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies. Reconcile supplier, customer, and other balance sheet accounts. Review account balances to ensure accuracy and completeness. Financial Closing Assist with monthly financial closing activities. Ensure transactions are recorded in the correct accounting period. Support preparation of financial schedules and reports in accordance with IFRS principles and company accounting policies. Payroll & Employee Earnings Review Review employee payroll records, including salaries, allowances, overtime, and other earnings before processing. Ensure payroll calculations are accurate and supported by approved documentation. Verify that payroll entries are correctly recorded in the accounting system and allocated to the appropriate accounts. VAT Compliance Ensure transactions are properly recorded for VAT purposes. Maintain VAT documentation and supporting records. Assist in preparing VAT reports in compliance with ZATCA regulations. Expense Review & Control Review expense claims and supporting documents for completeness and compliance with company policies. Ensure expenses are properly authorized before recording them. Operational Coordination Coordinate with operations, warehouse, and store teams regarding financial matters. Support improvements in accounting procedures and internal controls. Perform other accounting-related duties assigned by the Finance Manager. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance. Minimum 5 years of accounting experience. Experience using Odoo ERP or similar accounting systems. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Good command of English (spoken and written). Good understanding of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and accounting principles. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) — Insurance & Investments
description: Job Summary The Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) is the executive leader responsible for using enterprise data, advanced analytics, AI, and business intelligence to improve strategic and operational decision-making. Within Insurance & Investments, the CAO typically oversees analytics across underwriting, claims, pricing, customer intelligence, fraud, risk, actuarial insights, investment performance, portfolio analytics, financial planning, regulatory reporting, and enterprise performance. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the organization's enterprise analytics strategy. Establish an enterprise-wide analytics operating model, roadmap, standards, and priorities. Lead advanced analytics, predictive analytics, AI/ML, data science, and business intelligence. Translate complex data into actionable insights for CEO, Board, executives, and business leaders. Develop analytics capabilities for: Underwriting and risk selection Claims and loss analysis Pricing and profitability Customer segmentation and retention Fraud detection Risk and capital analytics Portfolio and investment performance Asset allocation Market and investment research Financial forecasting Regulatory and management reporting Establish enterprise analytics KPIs and measurement frameworks. Drive predictive modelling and scenario analysis to support strategic decisions. Partner with the CIO/CDO/CTO on data architecture, data platforms, governance, integration, and technology modernization. Ensure analytical models use reliable, governed, secure, and appropriately controlled data. Develop self-service BI and executive dashboards. Identify opportunities for AI and automation across business functions. Establish model governance, validation, monitoring, and responsible AI practices. Support actuarial, risk, finance, investment, compliance, and executive decision-making. Lead enterprise analytics transformation and data-driven culture. Build, manage, and develop high-performing teams across analytics, data science, BI, and AI. Manage analytics budgets, vendors, strategic technology partners, and external data providers. Communicate analytical findings and business implications to senior executives and the Board. Ensure analytics activities align with regulatory, privacy, risk, and financial-services requirements. Ideal Candidate Profile 15+ years of experience across analytics, data science, BI, statistics, quantitative analysis, or related fields. 7+ years in senior analytics/data leadership. Previous experience as: Chief Analytics Officer Chief Data & Analytics Officer Chief Data Officer Head of Data & Analytics Head of Analytics Group Head of Analytics Director of Data & Analytics Analytics Director VP Data & Analytics Strong experience in Insurance, Banking, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services. Strong understanding of: Advanced analytics Predictive modelling AI/ML Data science Business intelligence Data strategy Data governance Data architecture Statistical modelling Data visualization Scenario/stress testing Experience converting analytics into measurable business outcomes. Strong executive stakeholder management and Board-level communication. Experience leading large, multidisciplinary analytics/data teams. Strong commercial and strategic understanding of financial-services businesses. Bachelor's degree required; Master's/PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, or a related field is advantageous. title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
description: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects. Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software. AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve. We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company. Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them. You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently. Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important. This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend. Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations. Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review. Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria. Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations. Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures. Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting. Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks. Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies. Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners. Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification. Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes. Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies. Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback. Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead. Required Qualifications Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications. Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling. Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs. Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified. Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery. Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies. Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents. Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills. Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery. Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams. The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget. Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility. Especially Valuable Experience Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup. Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time. Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation. Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments. Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation. Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring. Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team. Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years. For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. What We Offer A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives. The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team. Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery. Close collaboration with startup leadership. The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops. Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process. Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning. Please submit your CV and a short overview covering: A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions. An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results. Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities. A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes. Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables. Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Research Associate, Core Lab (Echocardiography)
description: NAMSA pioneered the industry and was the first independent company in the world to focus solely on medical device materials for safety. NAMSA started testing medical devices before the U.S. Food and Drug Administration started regulating such products in 1976. We are shaping the industry. NAMSA has been a key contributor to the development of the test methods that govern our industry. We have become the industry’s premier provider. We provide support for clients during every step of the product development lifecycle and beyond. Come and work for an organization with the: Vision to inspire innovative MedTech solutions that advance global healthcare, improve patient lives and accelerate Client success and the Mission to deliver best-in-class global MedTech development solutions through our people, expertise and technology by adhering to our core Values: Act with integrity in everything we do. Provide best-in-class customer experiences. Develop superior talent and deliver expertise. Respond with agility and provide timely results. Embrace collaboration, diverse perspectives and ideas. Compensation Target: $80,000.00 Job Description: Under the direction of the Manager, Core Laboratory, the Research Associate, Core Laboratory has responsibility for the quantification and measurement of core laboratory studies. Qualifications & Technical Competencies: Principal Duties and Responsibilities Review echocardiograms, and possibly other imaging modalities (e.g., vascular ultrasound) as needed. Participate in the development of quantification instructions/manuals. Assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT) when necessary. Assist with monitoring and reporting on the progress of core laboratory operations to client. Work with a multidisciplinary team (e.g. Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Project Management, Clinical Monitoring, Medical Writing) as needed to ensure integration with other study related activities. Ensure that adherence to industry standards and regulatory requirements, including but not exclusive to Good Clinical Practices (GCP), is maintained via the documentation of all activities. Ensure that core laboratory Standard Operating Procedures are followed, and that all aspects of the core laboratory's activities are conducted in accordance with the ethical and professional standards and established policies of the Company. Perform related duties as required and assigned. Qualifications and Skills Work requires graduation from an accredited bachelor's degree program or work as a Registered Nurse (RN), Physician's Assistant (PA), or Pharmacist. Relevant formal echocardiography accreditation is required. Minimum 2 years relevant experience in echocardiography acquisition and image analysis post-accreditation is recommended. Familiarity with transthoracic echocardiography analysis is required. Familiarity with TOW imaging, congenital pathology, and/or strain imaging preferred. Skilled use of computer technology, including databases, applications and the ability to learn new applications. Experience with Philips Ultrasound Workspace or TomTec software is preferred. Must be able to work independently following a period of specific technical training. Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong organizational skills with attention to detail, with the ability to work independently and in a team environment. Demonstrate a high degree of personal and professional integrity. Working Conditions The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. title: Senior Cloud FinOps Engineer
description: Responsibilities Peraton is seeking a skilled and motivated FinOps Cloud Engineer to support DOI USGS Permitting Modernization and Cloud Infrastructure program. You will serve as the primary financial operations authority for a multi-environment AWS cloud platform supporting 50+ software developers, 20 business analysts, and Government staff engaged in permitting modernization. You will own end-to-end cloud cost management from consumption forecasting to rightsizing recommendations and budget enforcement, following the FinOps Foundation's Inform → Optimize → Operate framework. This is a high-visibility, mission-critical role operating within a FedRAMP-compliant federal environment, directly supporting one of DOI's flagship technology modernization efforts. Peraton supports the U.S. Department of the Interior (DOI) and U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) in modernizing the federal permitting process through the Permitting Modernization and Cloud Infrastructure program. At the heart of this initiative is the WARP platform (Workflows, Authorizations, Registrations, and Permits), a cloud-native AWS environment purpose-built to streamline and accelerate how the federal government processes permits, authorizations, and registrations. The program leverages cutting-edge cloud infrastructure, AI-assisted decision support, and advanced data engineering to serve a large, distributed team of developers, business analysts, and Government stakeholders. Peraton 's role spans the full lifecycle of cloud operations from provisioning and managing secure multi-environment AWS infrastructure and AI/ML services to delivering workforce training and certification, all within a rigorous federal compliance framework including FedRAMP, FISMA, and NIST security standards. Work Location: Remote What You Will Do: Produce monthly FinOps reports including cloud and AI consumption forecasts vs. actuals, unit economics, and Government-facing chargeback views aligned to contract deliverables. Configure and manage AWS Budgets, Cost Explorer, Cost Anomaly Detection, and Trusted Advisor to monitor spending, identify anomalies, and enforce financial guardrails. Develop and maintain quarterly rightsizing recommendation packages, identifying underutilized or over-provisioned resources and presenting actionable optimization strategies to Government stakeholders. Implement and enforce auto-suspend policies for non-production environments to reduce idle consumption costs, as directed by the customer. Manage AI/ML cost tracking for Amazon Bedrock LLM inference and token consumption, applying FinOps for AI disciplines. Issue Limitation of Funds notifications to the Contracting Officer at the 75% consumption threshold and provide 60-day advance warning before funding exhaustion. Maintain compliance with FedRAMP Moderate, FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and all applicable DOI security and financial policies. Complete mandatory annual DOI IT Security Awareness Training and execute required DOI Rules of Behavior and non-disclosure agreements. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States. Must perform all work within the United States; no international work permitted under this contract. Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree and 6 years of professional experience, or a PhD and 3 years of professional experience, or an Associate’s degree and 10 years of professional experience, or a high school diploma/equivalent and 12 years of professional experience. 5 plus years of hands-on cloud engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on cloud financial management (FinOps). Demonstrated knowledge and experience with FinOps Foundation Best Practices for cloud and AI including Tokenomics, FOCUS and tagging strategies. Demonstrated experience managing AWS cost attribution, budgets, and financial reporting in a multi-account, multi-environment AWS Organization. Proven ability to build and deliver recurring cloud consumption reports and cost optimization deliverables for Government or enterprise clients. Advanced proficiency with AWS Cost Management tools: Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, Cost Anomaly Detection, Trusted Advisor. Understanding of Amazon Bedrock or other LLM/AI token-based cost models. Experience with Databricks or similar data platform cost management. Proficiency in reporting tools and ability to present financial data clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience supporting U.S. federal government programs with FedRAMP, FISMA, or NIST SP 800-53 compliance requirements. One or more of the following certifications (or able to obtain with 90 days): AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional. AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional. FinOps Certified Engineer FinOps Certified AI Value Preferred qualifications: Experience with FinOps for AI/ML cost management (token metering, inference optimization). Familiarity with Databricks cluster cost governance and workspace administration. Familiarity with AWS Organizations, tag policies, and Service Control Policies (SCPs). Familiarity with AWS compute services: EC2, Lambda, Fargate, ECS/EKS, and associated cost drivers. Familiarity with ETL pipelines and medallion-architecture cost considerations. Experience with 3rd party cloud financial management tools such as IBM Cloudability, Flexera. Prior experience on a DOI, USGS, or other Department of Interior program. Experience working in an Agile/Scrum delivery environment using GitLab or Atlassian (Jira/Confluence). Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-37 (RMF), or NIST SP 800-64 (SDLC security). Experience with cloud governance frameworks in multi-AZ/multi-region AWS deployments. Background in data engineering or analytics platforms (Databricks, AWS Glue, or similar). Familiarity with federal acquisition regulations, particularly reporting and notification requirements under T&M contract vehicles. Peraton Overview Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. title: Senior Campaign Manager
description: WHO WE ARE Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay. This means daily performance monitoring to make sure every campaign scales efficiently and hits its KPIs. It's a team that moves fast and has a direct, measurable impact on client results. title: UX Designer
description: What We Need Corpay is looking for a UX Designer to join our Corporate Payments division. In this role, the UX Designer will shape the next generation of digital experiences for our Payables business. You’ll work across a diverse product ecosystem that includes complex web applications, operational and administrative tools, and intuitive end-user experiences. One day, you may be simplifying a high-volume workflow for finance teams; the next, you may be designing tools for administrators or creating a seamless experience for an individual user completing a payment-related task. This is a hands-on role for a designer who enjoys turning complexity into clarity—and who thrives when ideas move quickly from sketch to prototype to shipped experience. You’ll work in tight feedback loops with Product, Research, Engineering, and fellow designers to frame problems, explore possibilities, test assumptions, and continuously improve what we put in front of customers. We care deeply about craft, but we don’t confuse perfection with progress. The strongest candidate will know how to choose the right level of fidelity, move decisively with incomplete information, and maintain a high bar for quality while keeping momentum. We’re also looking for a designer who sees AI as an advantage. Not as a replacement for judgment, empathy, or creativity—and not as a shortcut—but as a powerful way to expand exploration, automate repetitive work, accelerate prototyping, challenge assumptions, and produce better work faster. You will collaborate closely with Product, Research, Design, and Engineering partners and report directly into the VP of Product. How We Work As a UX Designer you will be expected to work in a virtual environment. Corpay will set you up for success by providing: Company-issued equipment Formal, hands-on training Role Responsibilities The responsibilities of this role will include: Designing end-to-end interfaces, interactions, and workflows across Corpay ’s Payables product ecosystem. Creating experiences for sophisticated web applications, internal and customer-facing administrative tools, and end-user consumer applications. Simplifying complex financial and operational workflows without losing the depth, control, or flexibility users need. Translating user needs, business goals, and technical constraints into experiences that are clear, useful, and ready to move forward. Producing low-fidelity concepts early and often to help Product teams explore opportunities, clarify scope, and make faster decisions. Creating prototypes at the appropriate level of fidelity for stakeholder alignment, usability research, and development handoff. Partnering with UX Researchers to understand user behaviors, identify unmet needs, test concepts, and turn findings into meaningful product improvements. Working directly with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the development process—not simply at the beginning and end. Using AI-enabled tools thoughtfully and responsibly to accelerate activities such as ideation, workflow exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, content development, and documentation. Protecting customer and company information by using AI tools in accordance with Corpay ’s privacy, security, and data-handling standards. Maintaining a prioritized backlog of incremental design improvements and helping the team continuously raise the quality of the Payables experience. Contributing to and evolving Corpay ’s UX Design System, including patterns, components, documentation, and standards. Collaborating with developers to keep coded component libraries aligned with the Design System. Designing responsive experiences that work effectively across devices and adapting to the needs of different user types. Balancing speed with usability, accessibility, consistency, and attention to detail. Communicating design rationale clearly, inviting critique, and adapting quickly when new evidence points toward a better solution. Taking on additional high-impact design challenges as the product and business evolve. Qualifications & Skills At least 4+ years of professional experience in UX, product, or interaction design. A portfolio that demonstrates strong interaction design, clear problem-solving, thoughtful iteration, and collaboration with cross-functional teams. Experience designing complex web applications, administrative platforms, workflow tools, or consumer-facing digital products. Experience working with agile product and development teams. The ability to move comfortably between rough concepts, detailed interface design, interactive prototypes, and implementation support. Strong proficiency with Figma or comparable modern design and prototyping tools. Curiosity about AI and hands-on experience using AI-enabled tools to improve the quality or speed of your design process. Strong product judgment and the ability to determine when a design needs deeper exploration—and when it is ready to move forward. Comfort working through ambiguity, creating clarity, and making progress without waiting for perfect requirements. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in a remote environment. Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail. The ability to work independently while actively seeking input, sharing work early, and contributing to a highly collaborative team. A genuine commitment to understanding users and advocating for their needs. Helpful, but Not Required A degree or certification in Human-Computer Interaction, interaction design, UX design, or a related field. Experience designing financial products, payment platforms, accounts payable software, enterprise tools, or other transaction-based products. Experience designing for multiple audiences, such as finance professionals, administrators, operations teams, and individual end users. Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design practices. Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system. Experience working successfully on a distributed or remote team. You’ll Thrive Here If You You like to make ideas tangible. You share work before it feels perfect, learn from feedback, and improve it quickly. You can untangle a complicated workflow, understand the needs of multiple user types, and create an experience that feels focused and intuitive. You can defend a design decision without becoming attached to it. You know that speed and quality are not opposites when a team has strong judgment, clear priorities, and short feedback loops. Most importantly, you are excited about how the designer’s role is evolving. You bring the empathy, taste, curiosity, and critical thinking that technology cannot replace—and you actively use new technology to increase what you are capable of producing. Benefits & Perks Medical, Dental & Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire Automatic enrollment into our 401(k) retirement savings plan Virtual fitness classes offered company-wide Robust PTO offerings including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, and volunteer time Employee discounts with major providers (wireless, gym, car rental, and more) Philanthropic support with local and national organizations Fun culture with company-wide contests and prizes Pay Transparency The expected salary range for this position is $100,000 – $120,000, based on the candidate’s work location. The final offer will be determined based on job-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable market conditions. Compensation may vary based on geographic location and will be confirmed during the hiring process. Additional compensation and benefits, including incentive programs, health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and other benefits (where applicable), may also be provided. #CORPAY About Corpay Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments. At Corpay , we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally. Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows. Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs. Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms. Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling. Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell. Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement. Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub. Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions. Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration. Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication. Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors. The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result. Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget. Especially Valuable Experience Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment. Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access. Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps. Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control. Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search. Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions. Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain. title: Accountant - UK Clients - Remote
description: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs. We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space. We operate across 3 business segments: Corporate Secretary : Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and Sleek Sign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations Accounting & Bookkeeping : Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary Sleek Books ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service FinTech payments : Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific. Requirements Mission of the role Prepare bookkeeping, VAT returns and draft year end accounts for UK small business clients. You work in a pod of five led by a UK-based Senior Accounts Manager: two senior accountants, two accountants and a bookkeeper, serving around 300 UK small business clients from January and growing to around 500 through 2027. Until the manager starts in January, you work in one of our existing UK teams. A Senior Accountant reviews your work. Your work is on time and right the first time, and as you grow you take on year end accounts and corporation tax returns. What you’ll do Keep clients’ books up to date in Xero: bank reconciliations, sales and purchase ledgers, and month and year end adjustments. Prepare VAT returns under Making Tax Digital for review. Prepare draft year end accounts and, as you grow, corporation tax returns. Check your own work before sending it for review, and act on corrections. Chase clients early for missing records, and tell your Senior Accountant in good time when a deadline is at risk. Keep client records and workflow data accurate. Use the AI tools we are building into our products and workflow Key outcomes in the first 6–12 months Your bookkeeping and VAT returns are ready for review before their deadlines, with client delays chased early and recorded. Your work needs fewer review rounds, measured from when you start. By month 12, you prepare draft year end accounts and CT600s for review, not just bookkeeping and VAT. Workflow data for your clients is accurate and up to date. Must-have experience A degree in commerce, accounting or finance (for example B.Com or BS Accountancy). At least 2 years in accounting, including at least 1 on UK clients: bookkeeping, bank reconciliations and VAT returns. Confident with Xero, QuickBooks or a similar cloud accounting package. Written English good enough to email UK clients directly. Based in India or the Philippines, with the right to work there. Able to work a shift that overlaps UK business hours. Nice to have Has prepared draft UK year end accounts or CT600s Must-have attributes Ownership: you finish what you start and fix problems rather than pass them on. Accuracy: you check your own numbers before anyone else has to. Takes feedback well: you act on corrections and don’t make the same mistake twice. Great communicator: clear in writing, with UK clients and with your reviewer. Process, data and compliance: you follow the process and keep records clean. One team: you help the rest of the pod, not just your own clients. Open to AI: comfortable with our tools taking on more of the routine work. The interview process TA Screening Call: A 30 minute call with our Talent Acquisition team Live Technical Assessment: A ~60–90 minute live skills test to assess your hands-on bookkeeping capability. Technical Interview : A 45 - 60 minute interview with the Accounting manager who will assess your technical skills. Soft Skills Interview: A ~15-30 minute interview with the hiring team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values. Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages. Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify: Your education Any criminal history Any political exposure Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek , an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek .com. Benefits Some other great things about working at Sleek … Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment. Flexibility: You'll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year. Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region. Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek , you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional. Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy. title: Foreclosure Paralegal
description: Purpose The Foreclosure Paralegal I, positioned within the Shared Services Department, holds the responsibility of the pre-foreclosure process across the various states in which the firm operates. This role entails a comprehensive review of pre-foreclosure documents, onboarding documents, as well as the utilization of MSP, AIQ, and other internal systems. Effectively resolving these impediments may necessitate direct communication with attorneys, clients, or internal staff, ensuring that any legal or procedural barriers are addressed promptly and proficiently. The Paralegal I will ensure all deadlines are met, maintain workloads and process flow within the team, and distribute workloads as necessary. Communication and Collaboration: Responding to various emails, providing accurate and timely information, and maintaining client systems with current information regarding the onboarding process. Compliance Monitoring: Ensuring all activities adhere to internal policies, state laws, and federal regulations. Issue Escalation and Support: Escalating any issues as needed and assisting with the training of new paralegal staff. General Competency Factors Must be proficient in software tools, including but not limited to Word, Excel, Outlook, and the Internet. Must possess strong written and verbal communications skills. Must provide excellent customer service to internal and external customers Identifies and solves issues in a timely manner. Must be a team player and willing to help others in their department whenever necessary. Must be extremely organized and be able to multi-task. Conscientious with respect to work completion, deadlines, time management and attendance. Takes initiative in face of obstacles and identifies what needs to be done and takes action. Demonstrates commitment to Firm’s vision, mission, and core values. Analytical and detail oriented, while working at a fast pace and capable of multi-tasking. title: SAT-English - Remote Job
description: Category: Education Location: The SAT English Instructor is responsible for teaching and guiding students to excel in the English sections of the SAT, which include Reading, Writing, and Language.
