title: Enterprise Services - Enterprise Technical Team Lead
description: About F12: F12 was built by uniting IT consulting firms across Canada with a shared vision: to reduce risk and complexity by crafting technology platforms that empower leaders to focus and thrive. We elevate IT conversations from ingredients to outcomes, delivering fully designed solutions with no bad options. If you’re looking for the fast lane into an IT career or want to supercharge your professional development, you’ve come to the right place. At F12, you’ll collaborate with a diverse team and gain exposure to technology services across countless businesses—building a resume rich with experience and accomplishments. Our mission is to elevate our employees by building and retaining an elite team of IT professionals equipped to deliver unmatched service to Canadian business leaders. We value humble service, continuous improvement, and hard work—and we’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us. The Position: Reporting to the Service Delivery Manager (SDM), the Enterprise Technical Team Lead is a senior, hands-on technical lead within managed services, responsible for the day-to-day secure operation, support, and continuous improvement of client cloud and security environments. They will be expected to have technical expertise along with some team management or leadership experience. Working closely with the Enterprise Account Manager and SDM, this individual will be an Internal SME for managed security and Azure services, overseeing delivery quality and escalation handling. This role involves a deep understanding of Azure services, including compute, networking, storage, and, crucially, security. The focus is on the "future" — designing a secure and functional environment from the ground up. Having a background in security operations allows them to design solutions that are not only secure but also easily monitored and managed by the SecOps team. They can build in the necessary logging, alerting, and security controls from the beginning, rather than having them added as an afterthought. You will also take on the role of coaching and mentoring technicians while providing technical support and guidance to the team in resolving complex technical issues. You will be an escalation point for our service team members and a point of contact for our clients and vendors. The position collaborates closely with Security/GRC, Modern Workplace, and Infrastructure teams to ensure solutions are not only well-designed but are reliable in production. This role remains directly involved in day-to-day service delivery, including incident response, escalation handling, troubleshooting, and change execution, ensuring solutions perform reliably in production environments. Responsibilities: Cloud Security Operations & Azure Services Operate and maintain client Azure environments on an ongoing basis, including monitoring, investigating, and resolving security alerts using Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender tools. Implement and support secure Azure solutions, including identity hardening (Azure AD), networking configurations, and security policies, ensuring configurations remain effective and compliant over time—not only at initial deployment. Take ownership of escalated security incidents through remediation and post-incident review and identify the configuration or architectural changes needed to prevent recurrence. Maintain and update runbooks, alert response procedures, and configuration documentation based on real-world incidents, audits, and operational findings. Review security posture metrics (e.g., Azure Secure Score, vulnerability findings) and apply corrective changes directly or coordinate execution with other technical teams. Communicate outcomes clearly to internal and client stakeholders. Review Microsoft recommendations surfacing in client tenants, prioritize them, deploy or coordinate remediation, and drive them to closure — including regulatory compliance findings and attack path analysis in Defender for Cloud, etc. Meet with clients on a recurring basis to review Azure and security posture, walking through Secure Score and Identity Secure Score breakdowns by control area and the improvement plan against them. Own proactive maintenance and monthly governance reporting for assigned accounts, ensuring recurring checks are completed, and findings are actioned rather than logged. Participate in MXDR and managed detection incident reviews, identifying architectural or configuration changes that reduce recurrence. Scope and estimate effort for new client requests, and identify when work exceeds day-to-day operational delivery and should be handed to the project delivery team. Modern Workplace (M365) Support Provide secondary support for Microsoft 365 service areas that intersect with cloud and security, including tenant-level reporting and configuration reviews. Assist with transactional CSP-related requests and licensing or subscription questions as they arise within assigned accounts. Managed Service Delivery & Incident Response Actively participate in incident, request, and escalation queues, ensuring complex cloud or security issues are prioritized, worked, and resolved within defined service expectations. Balance proactive improvement work with reactive support responsibilities, maintaining a strong focus on direct hands-on client work within managed service agreements. Support major incident response by coordinating technical efforts, communicating status and resolution steps, and assisting service delivery leadership in restoring service quickly and effectively. Identify recurring issues, operational gaps, or process breakdowns and propose practical improvements that reduce ticket volume, escalation frequency, or client impact. Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Process Improvement Serve as an internal escalation resource and real-time technical coach, guiding technicians during live troubleshooting, incident calls, and complex implementations. Review and provide feedback on technicians’ work (tickets, configurations, remediation steps), improving quality, consistency, and adherence to best practices. Contribute to the development and refinement of standard operating procedures, knowledge base articles, and deployment standards to improve repeatability and service quality. Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency, including scripting, policy standardization, or integration between systems to reduce manual effort and error. Client Engagement & Trusted Advisor Responsibilities Work directly with client stakeholders to explain incidents, remediation actions, and recommend improvements in clear, non-technical language, reinforcing trust and transparency. Participate in client discussions related to cloud health and security posture, grounding recommendations in observed operational realities rather than theory alone. Proactively identify areas of unmet needs or risk within client environments and suggest actionable improvements that align with managed service capabilities. Requirements: 5+ years in cloud engineering, architecture, or administration 3+ years in Azure security operations, including hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Microsoft 365 Defender. • Deep expertise in: ◦ Azure infrastructure: networking, storage, identity, and governance ◦ Security architecture design: Zero Trust, CNAPP/CSPM integrations, GRC strategies ◦ Security tools: Microsoft Defender suite, Sentinel (KQL, analytics, automation) Exposure and skill in Infrastructure-as-Code: PowerShell, ARM templates, Terraform desired Familiarity with compliance frameworks: ISO, NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS Experience as a Technical Architect, designing the technical aspects of implementations/configurations. Excellent communication and client engagement capabilities. Background in Microsoft technology solution development and delivery Dynamic personality able to effectively engage and influence internal and external stakeholders. Independent self-starter with a collaborative working style, strong work ethic, and flexibility to take on a wide range of roles and responsibilities Ability to influence and negotiate effectively with new partners and existing internal resources Strong problem-solving and creative thinking abilities. Willingness to travel as required and work outside of normal business hours Careful attention to detail with strong organizational and analytical capabilities Effective verbal and written communication skills Team player who can influence others within the business and functional teams Ability to work under tight timelines within a very dynamic, fast-paced environment Ability to operate at the strategic level yet be close enough to the details to add value to clients and be a technical support to their team. Competencies: Empathy-driven communication & user-centric mindset Problem solving & critical thinking Detail orientation with disciplined execution Change leadership & stakeholder engagement Effective facilitation & consultative communication Organization and ability to manage multiple priorities Team collaboration and willingness to share knowledge What You Can Expect from Us: We are proud of our forward-thinking, dynamic culture that champions diversity, inclusivity, and a respectful working environment. We also want to make sure that however you get IT done in all parts of your life, we’ve got your back. Our comprehensive total rewards program includes: Work-Life & Growth: Three weeks vacation plus extra Flex Days, leadership development opportunities, growth coaching, and reimbursements for educational advancement and certifications. Health & Financial Well-Being: Health Spending Account or RRSP matching, extended health care, dental and vision coverage, disability and life insurance, and an employee assistance program. Additional Perks: Tuition reimbursement, paid time off, on-site parking, high-class office amenities, and company events. Our Equal Opportunity Commitment: F12.net practices as an equal opportunity employer in all services locations. We are committed to building and maintaining a workforce diverse in experience, skills, and knowledge. The company maintains a strict policy to ensure equal employment opportunities and do not discriminate based on any grounds and elements protected by law. For those requiring assistance with disabilities, information relating to accommodation and accommodation measures addressed confidentially. Please notify us in advance if any accommodations required. Please note that this position represents a true vacancy and we do not currently use artificial intelligence (AI) to at any stage of the hiring process to screen, assess or select candidates. title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description: Responsibilities Peraton is seeking a motivated Quality Assurance Automation Engineer to join the BASIS program team. This role is integral to maintaining the program's automation-first QA mandate — all quality assurance activities must be automated. The QA Automation Engineer will develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts and test cases across the full deployment pipeline, supporting Agile sprint delivery cycles and the Government-managed DevSecOps pipeline. The selected candidate will work under the guidance of senior engineers and QA leads to contribute to the development of automated test coverage, Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs), and UAT support activities, while adhering to rigorous DoD quality standards including zero defects to production, and compliance with DoDI 5000-87. This position is remote The position will be responsible for the following but not limited too: Test Automation Development & Execution Develop, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for unit, integration, and end-to-end functional testing in accordance with Agile sprint schedules and program quality standards. Ensure all automated test cases are executable by the end of each Agile sprint and delivered for incorporation into the Government-managed DevSecOps pipeline. Support the program's Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodology by writing test cases prior to code development in collaboration with software developers. Analyze the current state of test automation coverage and contribute to the Test Automation State Assessment Report and corresponding automation completion project plan. Automate adjacent legacy test cases per Government-approved schedule to expand overall regression test coverage across the DEERS application portfolio. Test Planning & Documentation Develop and maintain Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) at the end of each development cycle/sprint, demonstrating complete testing coverage of all requirements. Assist in the preparation of UAT plans, test scenarios, and test scripts for Government and external partner acceptance testing activities. Document all test activities, test case results, and defect findings within the Government-provided Test Case Management System. Contribute to the preparation of Testing Reports, Release Notes, and Software Version Descriptions (SVDs) per release cadence requirements. Quality Assurance & Defect Management Participate in mandatory code reviews at three checkpoints: 50%, 75%, and 90% of development completion, ensuring conformance to quality standards. Monitor and enforce hard quality thresholds. Triage and track defects in JIRA; conduct analysis, determine if issues were previously identified, and attempt error replication prior to escalation to product teams. Submit JIRA tickets prior to product team escalation; support weekly defect escalation reporting and report escalations to customers and the Government Product Owner at minimum weekly. Security & Compliance Testing Support application security scanning activities using Fortify, Sonatype, and BURP as part of the pre-production release QA process. Assist in ensuring code scan results are reviewed and documented prior to each production release, when rule packs/STIGs change, and on an as-needed basis. Section 508 / Accessibility Testing Conduct accessibility testing against WCAG 2.0 Level AA standards at planned intervals throughout the development lifecycle. Assist in the preparation of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) including test results, remediation reports, and documentation of conformance levels for applicable deliverables. Conduct Section 508 compliance testing and support reporting status to the Monthly Status Report (MSR). Performance & Environment Testing Support stress and load testing activities conducted in the ProdSim (Production Simulation) environment. Assist in coordinating and supporting Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities in collaboration with the technical and operations teams. Support Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) of all application changes in the UAT environment prior to production deployment. Agile / DevSecOps Participation Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Maintain and update sprint-level defect tracking, test case completion status, and burn-down metrics in JIRA. Adhere to the full deployment pipeline standards and quality gates at each stage. Contribute QA metrics and status to the Monthly Quality Status Report (QSR) Qualifications Required Qualifications 2 years with BS/BA; 0 years with MS/MA; 6 years with HS diploma Obtain and maintain public trust clearance IAM/IAT Level II certification (CompTIA Security+, System Security certified Practitioner (SSCP), CompTIA CySA+ or GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC) Experience in software quality assurance, test automation, or software testing roles. Foundational understanding of test automation principles and experience writing automated test scripts in at least one automation framework or scripting language (e.g., Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Python, Java, or equivalent). Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies and DevSecOps principles. Basic experience with defect tracking tools, preferably JIRA. Understanding of software testing lifecycle including unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and ability to document test results clearly and accurately. Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment and communicate effectively with developers, leads, and Government stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) Foundation Level certification or equivalent. Familiarity with Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices. Exposure to static code analysis or dynamic application security testing (DAST) tools such as Fortify, Sonatype, or BURP. Experience with Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing. Familiarity with ServiceNow for incident tracking and management. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated test integration within a DevSecOps environment. Exposure to Oracle or PL/SQL database environments. Prior experience supporting DoD or Federal government IT programs Peraton Overview Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure. title: Product Specialist – Functional QA & Pre-Sales
description: This is a remote position. The role You will become the functional expert on our NetSuite products: testing them thoroughly before every release, understanding the business processes they serve, and demonstrating them to prospects and customers. The role starts weighted towards quality assurance and shifts towards pre-sales as the products reach the market. What you will do Design and run test cases and regression suites across NetSuite, web and mobile (iOS and Android); test business scenarios end to end, from source transaction to GL impact. Log clear, reproducible defects, work them to closure with the developers, and sign off releases. Learn the products in depth and act as the voice of the user, flagging usability gaps and process mismatches and contributing to requirements. Build demo environments and data, and deliver scenario-based product demonstrations to prospects and partners alongside the sales team. Answer functional questions in sales cycles and RFPs; write user guides, release notes and training material, and support customer onboarding and UAT. What you bring 4–7 years in ERP functional consulting, functional or business QA, or a product specialist role. Hands-on Oracle NetSuite experience: core records and transactions, workflows, saved searches, roles and permissions, OneWorld and multi-currency, sandbox use. Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes: supply chain (procure-to-pay, inventory, warehouse and fulfilment), logistics (shipping, transport and delivery), accounting (order-to-cash, record-to-report, tax, month-end close), and people operations (time, expenses, HR and payroll), along with project accounting. A structured QA approach: test planning, test case design, regression discipline and well-written defects, in a tool such as Jira, Azure DevOps or TestRail. Excellent spoken and written English, and the confidence to present a product to senior business users and handle questions live. Good to have NetSuite certifications (SuiteFoundation, ERP Consultant); SuiteApp, ISV or SaaS product experience. Pre-sales, solution consulting, conference room pilot or demo experience. API testing (Postman), basic SQL or SuiteQL, and test automation (Playwright, Selenium or Appium). Why join us Shape new products from close to the start, working directly with the founders, in a role that combines product, quality and customer work, with a clear path into product management, solution consulting or pre-sales leadership. Hiring process Introductory call, then a functional interview on NetSuite and business processes, a practical testing exercise, a short demo exercise and a final conversation with the founders. To apply, send your CV and a short note on a business process you have tested or demonstrated end to end. ERP League is an equal opportunity employer () Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Accountant - UK Clients - Remote
description: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs. We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space. We operate across 3 business segments: Corporate Secretary : Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and Sleek Sign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations Accounting & Bookkeeping : Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary Sleek Books ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service FinTech payments : Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific. Requirements Mission of the role Prepare and review UK year end accounts, corporation tax returns and VAT returns for UK small business clients. You work in a pod of five led by a UK-based Senior Accounts Manager: two senior accountants, two accountants and a bookkeeper, serving around 300 UK small business clients from January and growing to around 500 through 2027. Until the manager starts in January, you work in one of our existing UK teams. You review the accountants’ and bookkeeper’s work so it reaches the manager right the first time, and you are the person they come to with questions. What you’ll do Prepare year end accounts (FRS 102 and 105), corporation tax computations and CT600s, and VAT returns under Making Tax Digital. Review the work of the accountants and bookkeeper in your pod, explain your corrections, and help them get it right the first time. Chase clients early for missing records, and tell your manager in good time when a deadline is at risk. Email UK clients directly to ask for information or explain what you need. Keep client records and workflow data accurate, so anyone can see where each client stands. Use the AI tools we are building into our products and workflows, and help shape them. Key outcomes in the first 6–12 months: No statutory deadline missed because of us on the clients you work on. Work you send to the Senior Accounts Manager needs fewer review rounds, measured from when you start. Work from the accountants and bookkeeper you review needs fewer review rounds over time. Workflow data for your clients is accurate and up to date. Must-have experience At least part-qualified: CA or CA Intermediate (India), CPA (Philippines), or ACCA (member, or all Applied Skills papers passed). At least 4 years in accounting, including at least 2 preparing UK year end accounts, CT600s and VAT returns for small businesses, in a UK practice or an outsourcing firm. At least 1 year reviewing other accountants’ or bookkeepers’ work. Confident with Xero, QuickBooks or a similar cloud accounting package. Written English good enough to email UK clients directly. Based in India or the Philippines, with the right to work there. Able to work a shift that overlaps UK business hours. Must-have attributes Ownership: the clients you work on are yours, and you fix problems rather than pass them on. Knowledgeable: you give the accountants and bookkeeper a definite answer. Coaching: when you correct someone’s work, you explain why, so the mistake doesn’t come back. Great communicator: clear in writing, with UK clients and with a manager in another country. Process, data and compliance: you follow the process, keep records clean and never cut corners. One team: you help the rest of the pod succeed, not just your own clients. Open to AI: the pod can grow to 500 clients only because our tools take on more of the routine work. The interview process TA Screening Call: A 30 minute call with our Talent Acquisition team Live Technical Assessment: A ~60–90 minute live skills test to assess your hands-on bookkeeping capability. Technical Interview : A 45 - 60 minute interview with the Accounting manager who will assess your technical skills. Soft Skills Interview: A ~15-30 minute interview with the hiring team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values. Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages. Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify: Your education Any criminal history Any political exposure Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek , an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek .com. Benefits Some other great things about working at Sleek … Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment. Flexibility: You'll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year. Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region. Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek , you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional. Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy. description: About the role We are seeking an experienced IT Compliance Specialist to lead and manage our compliance programs across ISO 27001 and SOC 2, ensuring our gaming platform and related services meet the highest standards of security, privacy, and regulatory compliance. The role will serve as the primary liaison for both external and internal auditors for ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 attestation, with a focus on addressing scope changes, corporate structure changes, and responding to client security questionnaires. What you will do Compliance Management Lead and maintain the company’s ISO 27001 Information Security Management System (ISMS) and SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria certification programs. Serve as the primary point of contact for engaging with external and internal auditors, facilitating ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 attestation processes. Manage risk assessments, control testing, and remediation activities to ensure ongoing compliance. Ensure compliance across environments supporting software development, hosting platforms, and APIs. Monitor the effectiveness of security controls and recommend improvements to mitigate emerging risks. Audit & Assurance Act as the central liaison for external auditors, regulators, and certification bodies, ensuring clear communication and issue resolution. Conduct internal compliance audits, gap assessments, and readiness reviews to maintain certification readiness. Track and close compliance findings and audit issues, ensuring timely resolution and documentation. Provide expert guidance on compliance implications of ISO 27001 scope changes and corporate structure changes. Training & Awareness Build awareness of compliance requirements across development, operations, and support teams. Deliver targeted training on compliance obligations, including secure software development, data handling, and gaming industry standards. Vendor & Third-Party Risk Management Assess compliance of key vendors, including cloud hosting providers, content partners (e.g., Pragmatic Play), and integration providers. Ensure contractual and SLA alignment with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 requirements. Reporting Provide regular compliance updates, risk posture reports, and responses to client inquiries to senior management and stakeholders. Support management with compliance performance metrics and KPIs. What you bring Bachelor's degree in information security, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field. 5+ years’ experience in IT compliance, GRC, risk management, or information security, ideally in gaming, fintech, or other regulated industries. Strong understanding of: ISO 27001:2022 Information Security Management System (ISMS) SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy) Proven track record of leading certification and audit processes, including direct engagement with auditors. Experience responding to client security questionnaires and communicating compliance status effectively. Experience with SaaS/PaaS environments, APIs, and cloud-based hosting services. Knowledge of secure SDLC, DevOps, and CI/CD compliance integration. Professional certifications preferred (e.g., CISA, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CCSK, CRISC). Excellent knowledge of IT compliance, audit, and risk frameworks, with expertise in ISO 27001 and SOC 2. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to represent the company to auditors and clients. Ability to influence cross-functional teams (dev, ops, support) to adopt compliance practices. Analytical thinker with a problem-solving approach to compliance challenges, including scope and structural changes. Detail-oriented with strong documentation, evidence management, and client questionnaire response skills. What we offer Competitive compensation A competitive salary that reflects your skills and experience. Annual leave In accordance with the applicable legislation (20 or 26 days annual leave). Private medical cover Private medical insurance to help you look after your health and wellbeing, available after successfully passing the probation period. Learning Hub Access to our online learning platform, with courses and resources to help you build your skills and grow your career. Gym & fitness membership Multisport membership, after successfully passing probation. From concept through to delivery, we combine technical expertise, creativity and industry knowledge to develop products, platforms and services that shape player experiences and support some of the industry's leading brands. We are best known for the work we deliver for Pragmatic Play, creating and supporting technology, products and specialists services enjoyed by millions of players worldwide. Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration. Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication. Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors. The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result. Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget. Especially Valuable Experience Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment. Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control. Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search. Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions. Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain. The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team. Close collaboration with startup leadership. Varied projects with practical business impact. A project you managed or a team you led or mentored. Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors. Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. description: Who We Are IPID empowers financial institutions, payment service providers, and enterprises with a single global API for Know Your Payee (KYP) verification—reducing fraud, reducing costs, staying compliant, and streamlining cross-border payments, globally. We are a fast-growing fintech startup, founded by a global team of industry veterans from iconic organizations like SWIFT and Thomson Reuters. Our team combines global expertise with local insights; we are present across key cities—including Singapore, Hanoi, Kuala Lumpur, Mumbai, Amsterdam, Brussels, Paris, London, New York, and Dubai. The Opportunity As a Technical Operations Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the day-to-day operation of IPID's platform, ensuring reliable service delivery and excellent customer support. You will monitor system health, investigate incidents, manage customer issues, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain operational stability and improve customer experience. You will play an important role in driving operational excellence through proactive monitoring, process improvements, documentation, and release readiness activities, helping ensure our platform remains secure, reliable, and scalable as the business grows. This is a long-term role currently engaged on a B2B contract basis in Romania, with the potential to transition to local employment in the future as iPiD 's presence in the region continues to grow. Safeguard production of reliability and system stability through effective observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident management practices. Configure log monitoring and alerting dashboard; triage and investigate alerts when triggered. SLA and response-time ownership. Track adherence to response-time commitments Support internal stakeholders with recurring operational tasks and ad-hoc requests. Continuously improve technical support operations in collaboration with Presales, Operations, and Customer Success. Document technical solutions, runbooks, and knowledge base articles for reuse across the support and engineering teams. Act as a release gatekeeper: participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure a smooth handover from Development to Operations for every feature release. title: Retail Dealer Services Production - Dealer Production Specialist - Dealer Servic
description: TITLE: DEALER PRODUCTION SPECIALIST – DEALER SERVICES STATUS: NON-EXEMPT REPORT TO: VP – DEALER SERVICES RELATIONSHIP AND PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT: RETAIL DEALER SERVICES PRODUCTION JOB CODE: 11971 PAY RANGE: $38.45 - $41.00/HR Eligible for Quarterly Incentives* GENERAL DESCRIPTION: The Dealer Production Specialist (DPS) plays a critical role in supporting Golden 1 Credit Union’s indirect auto lending program by enhancing responsiveness, increasing funded-loan conversion rates, and improving communication between Lending Operations and Dealer Relationship Managers (DRMs). This position serves as an inside production resource focused on real-time pipeline management, approved/countered deal follow-up, and inactive dealer reactivation. The DPS bridges the gap between the field and internal operations—driving efficiency, speed, and improved dealer satisfaction. The DPS is responsible for ensuring timely dealer engagement following loan approvals, identifying funding obstacles, and coordinating resolution efforts. The role will contribute directly to funded-volume growth, dealer retention, and market share expansion within Golden 1’s indirect lending channel. TASKS, DUTIES, FUNCTIONS: Pipeline and Conversion Management ◦ Monitor daily application activity, including approved, countered, and pending loans, to identify deals requiring follow-up or clarification ◦ Proactively contact dealers to confirm intent to fund, clarify loan terms, and address conditions or documentation needs. ◦ Identify at-risk applications and escalate to DRMs or Lending Operations as needed to prevent fallout. ◦ Track and report conversion outcomes, turnaround times, and lost-deal reasons Dealer Engagement and Reactivation ◦ Serve as the internal contact for assigned or regional dealerships, ensuring consistent communication and timely responses. ◦ Partner with DRMs to maintain a high level of service for top-performing dealers while increasing engagement with lower-volume accounts. ◦ Conduct structured outreach campaigns to re-engage inactive or dormant dealerships and schedule follow-up opportunities for the field team. ◦ Collaborate with Lending Operations and DRMs to ensure smooth and efficient funding processes. Collaboration and Communication ◦ Act as a central liaison between DRMs and Lending Operations, to streamline communication and identify recurring dealer pain points. ◦ Communicate dealer feedback, process challenges, and success stories to the Regional Production Manager for strategic consideration ◦ Participate in weekly pipeline meetings to share updates, trends, and improvement recommendations. ◦ Support rollout of new programs, pricing updates, and incentives by assisting with dealer communications and feedback collection. Data Analysis and Reporting ◦ Review and analyze dealer performance metrics, approval trends, and conversion ratios. ◦ Identify opportunities for improvement and present findings to leadership during regular performance reviews. ◦ Maintain dashboards and reports that measure responsiveness, dealer funding volume, and success of reactivation campaigns. ◦ Support the Regional Production Manager in preparing performance summaries or reporting for leadership meetings Dealer Reactivation and Opportunity Targeting ◦ Contact inactive or low-volume dealers to confirm current points of contact, review available programs, and gauge interest in re-establishing business. ◦ Coordinate with the assigned DRM to determine next steps for re-engagement or site visits. ◦ Maintain a regional reactivation tracker to measure progress and success rates. Operational and Compliance Excellence ◦ Ensure compliance with all applicable lending laws, regulations, and Golden 1 policies, including BSA/AML and fair-lending standards. ◦ Maintain accurate, confidential dealer and member data in accordance with corporate information security standards. ◦ Demonstrate professionalism and consistency in all communications with dealer partners and internal teams. PHYSICAL SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND EXERTION UTILIZED IN THE PERFORMANCE OF THESE TASKS: Effective oral and written communication skills required to perform the duties outlined above. Must possess sufficient manual dexterity to skillfully operate an on-line computer terminal and other standard office equipment, such as financial calculators, personal computer, facsimile machine and telephone. ORGANIZATIONAL CONTACTS & RELATIONSHIPS: INTERNAL: All levels of staff and management. EXTERNAL: Dealership contacts, other lender representatives, and vendor representatives. QUALIFICATIONS: EDUCATION: At a minimum, Associates Degree in Business Management or Finance. Equivalent work experience may be substituted for the associate’s degree requirement. EXPERIENCE: 5 or more years of experience performing similar jobs in a financial institution 3. KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS: Strong understanding of indirect auto lending processes and dealership operations. Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities. Proven capacity to interpret data, identify trends, and execute proactive outreach. Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency with CRM platforms, Microsoft Excel, and reporting tools. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: Prolonged sitting throughout the workday with occasional mobility required. Corrected vision within the normal range. Hearing within normal range. A device to enhance hearing will be provided if needed. Occasional movements throughout the department daily to interact with staff, accomplish tasks, etc. Overnight stays could be required for regions that require extended travel away from home base. Travel by plane or other public conveyance is required to attend meetings at headquarters, provide support at dealerships outside of assigned region, and attend conferences/training as deemed necessary by management. LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS: None Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. THIS JOB DESCRIPTION PROVIDES AN OVERVIEW OF THE GENERAL SCOPE AND LEVEL OF WORK EXPECTED TO BE PERFORMED, BUT IT IS NOT AN EXHAUSTIVE LIST OF ALL DUTIES OR RESPONSIBILITIES ASSOCIATED WITH THE POSITION. THE CREDIT UNION RESERVES THE RIGHT TO MODIFY, ADD, OR REMOVE DUTIES AS NEEDED WITHOUT ADVANCE NOTICE. NOTHING IN THIS JOB DESCRIPTION ALTERS THE AT-WILL EMPLOYMENT RELATIONSHIP OR LIMITS THE CREDIT UNION’S RIGHT TO ASSIGN OR REASSIGN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES TO THIS POSITION AT ANY TIME. title: Analista de Operações Cloud Júnior | Sexta a Terça – 23h às 08h (Noturno)
description: Conectamos empresas, pessoas e tecnologias contribuindo para que explorem seu máximo potencial, este é o nosso propósito, e ao longo de 37 anos somamos aprendizados e muitas conquistas. A Cultura vivenciada na empresa traduz a essência de quem somos e onde queremos chegar. Se você é apaixonado pelo que faz e tem muito “gás” para trabalhar, essa vaga é a sua cara!!! title: Alliance Partner Manager (SaaS) | Luma
description: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics , a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. What do we need We are seeking an Alliance Partner Manager to lead the technical dimension of our alliances and partnering function for Luma, our AI-Native Multimodal Research Platform for Scientific Intelligence. Sitting at the intersection of business and engineering, you'll own how our platform connects with, integrates into, and creates value alongside the products of our strategic technology partners, such as Databricks and AWS. This position is based in EMEA, working globally across time zones, with potential future expansion of channel partnerships into NAM. It is a senior role with broad scope, where you'll act as the bridge between partner engineering teams and our own product, engineering and commercial organizations, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales, as well as colleagues at Siemens, with room to design and build the technical alliance capability around you. While the focus is strategic, this remains a hands-on role: you'll need enough technical depth to scope integrations credibly, validate them in sandboxes, and hold your own in a conversation with a partner's engineering team. We're looking for someone with an engineering-minded, "application scientist" type approach — comfortable understanding the technical requirements involved in onboarding a partner, and operating confidently within a large company mindset and environment. In this role you will get to: Define, build, and execute the technical partner strategy, prioritising which integrations and joint solutions to build, developing and implementing joint go-to-market plans (co-sell, co-build, co-deliver), aligning teams and facilitating sales enablement and training of partners. Own engineering level relationships across partner organisations through effective communication, structured governance and business reviews, and joint business planning. Scope integration feasibility early in partner conversations, translating vague partner asks into clear, buildable technical specifications and setting realistic expectations. Oversee solution architecture, use-case mapping, partner product certification and sandbox / proof-of-concept development to design and validate joint solutions. Engage partners to develop differentiated solutions through joint collaboration, market and competitive analysis, and the creation of joint marketing collateral. Evangelise partnerships internally, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales stakeholders, and with colleagues at Siemens, feeding partner needs into the roadmap and organising collaborative events. Define, track and analyse key partnership metrics, collaborating with partners to optimise performance, and represent Dotmatics /Siemens at alliance and partner conferences and events. Focus specifically on systems integration partners, bringing on partners that will meaningfully increase the bottom line. We are looking for candidate's who have 7+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, solution architecture or pre-sales engineering, including several years leading strategic technical partner or ISV relationships at enterprise scale. You've built integrations, not just managed them, and you can move fluently between a business review and a whiteboard session with a partner's engineers. You're comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy on complex, ambiguous pursuits, and you set realistic expectations that engineering can actually deliver on. Just as importantly, you lead through influence. You can align engineering, marketing and sales teams, internally and across partner organisations, behind a shared plan without direct authority, and you're motivated by building a partnering function and team, not just running one. While not a traditional "sales" person, you're comfortable navigating sales-style conversations, combining technical knowledge with strong relationship management and communication skills. Key Skills: Technical partnership leadership - a proven track record defining and executing partner or alliance strategy with ISVs, technology platforms or system integrators, with measurable partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue impact. Hands-on integration fluency, including practical depth with APIs, authentication and data-exchange patterns, and the ability to scope, spec and validate integrations through sandboxes and proof-of-concept builds. Joint go-to-market execution - experience developing co-sell, co-build and co-deliver plans, aligning internal and partner teams, facilitating sales enablement and creating the collateral that makes joint solutions land. Executive-level relationship management - comfort owning senior stakeholder relationships across partner organisations, running structured business reviews (QBRs), and resolving conflict constructively when internal and partner priorities clash. Data-driven partner management, with the habit of defining, tracking and analysing partnership KPIs and leading indicators of partner health and acting on them before issues escalate. You may also have: Experience with cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) or OEM / embedded partnership motions. Experience structuring and negotiating complex commercial and technical agreements alongside legal teams. Familiarity with tiered partner certification programmes. A background or interest in scientific, life-sciences or research software, or another domain-deep industry such as Oil & Gas or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG). Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: REMOTE Vendor Management Supervisor, CMS
description: Come join our amazing team and work remote from home! The Vendor Management Supervisor will be responsible for directing the activities of the Vendor Management Specialists in the implementation and management of a formalized process of selecting, monitoring and assessing the compliance of third-party vendors providing services related to mortgage operations, which include a national default servicing network of law firms, lending origination and marketing vendors. Assist with establishing and maintaining department procedures and processes and train the Specialists accordingly. Monitor vendor performance to ensure continues oversight and compliance with contractual obligations, including Service Level Agreement (SLA), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), industry regulations and company’s established policies and procedures. Perform all duties in accordance with the company’s policies and procedures, investor guidelines, all US state and federal laws and regulations, wherein the company operates. The approved Target Pay Range for this position is $71,000 - $85,000. What you'll do: Supervise the daily activities of the Vendor Management staff, set performance expectations, provide guidance and foster collaborative team culture to ensure meeting individual and department expectations. Regularly monitor and assess continuous compliance of all third-party vendors to regulatory and company internal policies. Conduct ongoing evaluation of vendors’ adherence to all contractual obligations, including Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and overall compliance with industry regulations. Address any issues promptly and effectively. Lead and motivate the vendor management staff, manage work distribution, and provide staff coaching and development opportunities. Maintain and evaluate department policies and procedures, forms, reports, training material, job aids and checklists, and collaborate enhancements as needed with internal stakeholders. Ongoing evaluation of department reports and vendor management system in order to maximize department effectiveness and quality. Conduct and socialize results of performance assessments with staff to identify strengths and areas of opportunity on a frequent basis.Recommend additional training as needed. Oversee accurate and effective vendor management assessment of vendors’ risk levels, including the review of high volume of vendors’ due diligence documentation and conducting final assessment of vendor profile to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with all requirements. Manage the review and processing of the monthly vendor scorecard, including Consumer Complaints or security incidents, along with supporting evidence, while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to address any performance issues promptly. Oversee all third-party annual re-certification packages review and process. Develop necessary document/forms to address any common issues with vendors, while addressing escalated matters for non-responsive vendors. Oversees vendor onboarding and termination processes and collaborates with internal stakeholders as needed to ensure adherence to established policies, procedures and regulatory requirements... Review department exception reports and distribute to other stakeholders on regular basis while performing ongoing analysis to enhance reporting processes. Review and respond to internal and external audit requests received by the department as needed. Oversee the process of reviewing vendors’ on-site audit reports provided by Risk Management to ensure proper notification to internal stakeholders and tracking of any vendor remediation plans. Manage escalated matters presented by the vendor management staff and internal stakeholders. Exercise sound judgment and present escalated concerns to upper management as appropriate. Perform other duties and special projects as assigned. What you'll need: High school diploma/GED or equivalent work experience. Bachelor’s degree preferred. Five (5) or more years of mortgage servicing, auditing, finance, compliance or vendor management work experience. A minimum of three (3) years in a lead or supervisory role with a team of two or more people. Demonstrated experience in establishing, negotiating, and enforcing vendor contracts and service level agreements. Management reporting experience. Ability to work independently and effectively in complex remote environment managing team members and vendors nationwide. Proficient in MS Office with advanced skills in Outlook, SharePoint, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams and Visio Strong analytical, problem solving, collaboration and technical skills. Strong time management skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Ability to understand complex problems and to collaborate and explore alternative solutions. Ability to exercise sound judgment and escalate issues appropriately. Ability to communicate with individuals utilizing a telephone; requires ability to hear and speak effectively on the telephone. Professional demeanor, including ability to use tact and sound judgment in contact with individuals within and outside the organization. Maintain confidentiality in all aspects of client, staff, and vendor information. Our Company: Carrington Mortgage Services is part of The Carrington Companies, which provide integrated, full-lifecycle mortgage loan servicing assistance to borrowers and investors, delivering exceptional customer care and programs that support borrowers and their homeownership experience. We hope you’ll consider joining our growing team of uniquely talented professionals as we transform residential real estate. To read more visit: . What We Offer: Comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family. Plus, a discretionary 401(k) match of 50% of the first 4% of pay contributed. Access to several fitness, restaurant, retail (and more!) discounts through our employee portal. Customized training programs to help you advance your career. Employee referral bonuses so you’ll get paid to help Carrington and Vylla grow. Educational Reimbursement. Carrington Charitable Foundation contributes to the community through causes that reflect the interests of Carrington Associates. For more information about Carrington Charitable Foundation, and the organizations and programs, it supports through specific fundraising efforts, please visit: carringtoncf.org. description: Position Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled Web Scraping Architect to join our team. Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, XPath, and other web technologies relevant to web scraping and Coding. Knowledge and experience in best of class data storage and retrieval of large volume of scraped data. Attention to detail and the ability to handle and process large volumes of data accurately. Familiarity with data cleansing techniques and data validation processes. Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Knowledge of web scraping ethics, legal considerations, and compliance with website terms of service. description: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics , a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. What do we need Scientists are solving some of the hardest problems in the world. Your job is to make sure they find the tools that help them do it. As a Solution Marketing Manager at Dotmatics , you'll work at the center of science and communication, deeply understanding how researchers in your application area think, what they're trying to accomplish, and what gets in their way. You'll translate that understanding into stories, campaigns, and content that connect scientists with the right solutions at the right moment. From a product perspective, Luma and ELN are your primary vehicles. Both require messaging that works at the enterprise level and resonates with specific scientific audiences. Dotmatics also has a broad portfolio of specialized products, each with their own dedicated marketers. Your job is not to own those products, but to connect them into compelling solution narratives when they're relevant to your audience and use case. We're looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how scientists work, who loves the challenge of making complex ideas land, and who finds real satisfaction in building something from the ground up. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk. In this role you will get to : Own the positioning, messaging, and content development for your scientific application area: personas, use cases, value propositions, differentiation, and collateral. Develop strategic campaign briefs that translate positioning into actionable guidance for demand generation and integrated marketing. Build and maintain sales enablement materials that help the Dotmatics commercial team have better conversations, including pitch frameworks, solution narratives, objection handling, and competitive context. Partner with the wider marketing team to deliver the message to the market. Engage directly with internal subject matter experts and customers to gather insights and shape strategy. Act as the voice of your scientific audience across marketing and sales, influencing decisions and building alignment across senior stakeholders. We are looking for people who have 5+ years in a role where science and communication intersect: marketing, field applications, science communications, or similar, ideally in life sciences or research software. Scientific grounding to have credible conversations with researchers. A degree in a relevant discipline can be a real advantage here, and relevant hands-on experience is equally welcome. A track record of taking something complicated and making it click for an audience who didn't have time to become an expert. You've had the chance to build something from scratch before, and you want to do it again. You're comfortable working across functions and influencing without direct authority. Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows. Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions. Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure. Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria. Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication. Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows. Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs. Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling. Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub. Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions. Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration. Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication. Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors. The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result. Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget. Especially Valuable Experience Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment. Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access. Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps. Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control. Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search. Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security. Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions. Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain. Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership. Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity. Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team. Close collaboration with startup leadership. Varied projects with practical business impact. Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops. A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures. A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed. A project you managed or a team you led or mentored. Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors. Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. Vyhledávání a rozvoj partnerství Vytvoříš partnerskou strategii v souladu s prioritami Storyous. Budeš aktivně vyhledávat nové příležitosti mezi relevantními firmami, odborníky, distribučními kanály a dalšími subjekty s vazbou na cílový segment. Zmapuješ, kde má partner obchodní motivaci Storyous doporučovat, prodávat, integrovat nebo společně nabízet zákazníkům. Povedeš celý proces od identifikace a kvalifikace partnera přes návrh spolupráce a vyjednávání až po onboarding, launch a další rozvoj. Navrhneš vhodný model spolupráce podle konkrétní příležitosti — například referral, reseller, co-selling, společná nabídka nebo strategická spolupráce. Budeš hledat způsoby, jak partnerské vztahy převést do konkrétního obchodního dopadu, nikoliv pouze do počtu podepsaných smluv. 3. Posoudíš potenciální obchodní přínos, náklady, kapacitu interních týmů, provozní náročnost a hlavní rizika. Budeš rozumět principům integrací a produktového vývoje natolik, abys dokázal/a vést kvalifikovanou diskusi s interními i externími technickými stakeholdery. Pokud bude pro realizaci potřeba kapacita Product nebo Engineering, převezmeš odpovědnost za prosazení priority a sladění stakeholderů. Budeš hlídat, aby nové iniciativy měly odpovídající míru standardizace, opakovatelnosti a dlouhodobé udržitelnosti. Zajistíš připravenost onboardingu, dokumentace, podpory, měření výsledků a provozní odpovědnosti před uvedením do provozu. 5. Go-to-market a adoption Ve spolupráci se Sales, Marketingem, Customer Care a Product vytvoříš plán uvedení relevantních integrací a partnerství. Připravíš value proposition, obchodní argumentaci, kvalifikační kritéria a podklady pro interní týmy i partnery. Zajistíš, aby partner rozuměl nabídce Storyous, cílovým zákazníkům a způsobu předávání příležitostí. Budeš sledovat nejen počet aktivovaných partnerů, ale především skutečné využívání a obchodní dopad. Identifikuješ překážky v onboardingovém procesu a budeš je odstraňovat ve spolupráci s interními týmy i partnery. 6. Reporting, governance a kontinuální zlepšování Nastavíš pravidelný reporting portfolia integrací a partnerství pro management. Budeš sledovat vývoj pipeline, obchodní výsledky, aktivaci, využívání, náklady, přínosy a kvalitu provozu. Zavedeš pravidelné business reviews s klíčovými partnery. Budeš udržovat přehlednou evidenci smluv, vlastníků, obchodních podmínek, provozního stavu a dalších klíčových informací. Budeš průběžně vyhodnocovat, které integrace a partnerství rozvíjet, standardizovat, renegociovat nebo ukončit. Budeš mít odpovědnost za to, aby: každá prioritní iniciativa měla jasný cíl, business case, rozsah a měřítko úspěchu; partnerství byla ekonomicky smysluplná a měla jasně definované odpovědnosti; technické a produktové požadavky byly srozumitelné a měly odpovídající prioritu; interní stakeholderové byli včas informováni a rozhodnutí se dotahovala; problémy byly řešeny přímo a včas, včetně eskalace na správnou úroveň; výsledek byl po uvedení do provozu měřen a případně korigován. Budeš fungovat jako seniorní individual contributor: bez nutnosti velkého týmu pod sebou, ale s dostatečným vlivem a autoritou pro řízení komplexních iniciativ napříč Commercial, Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Care, Finance a Legal. Jak poznáme úspěch: Po 6–12 měsících budeš mít: transparentní přehled integračního portfolia a jasný plán jeho rozvoje; prioritizovaný pipeline nových integrací a partnerství s kvalitními business casy; nové partnerské příležitosti, které generují relevantní obchodní výsledky; zavedený proces od prvotního posouzení po uvedení do provozu a následné měření výsledků; funkční reporting výkonu partnerství a integrací; méně ad-hoc eskalací díky jasným vlastníkům, dokumentaci a provozním procesům; prokazatelný dopad na akvizici zákazníků, revenue, retenci nebo produktovou hodnotu. Konkrétní cíle a KPI nastavíme podle priorit Storyous v daném období. Mohou zahrnovat zejména: kvalitu a vývoj partnerské pipeline; počet a kvalitu leadů z partnerského kanálu; obchodní výsledky a návratnost vybraných iniciativ; aktivaci a využívání integrací; rychlost uvedení prioritních iniciativ do provozu; kvalitu provozu, podporu a spokojenost zákazníků i partnerů. Co potřebuješ Zkušenosti a odborné znalosti Několik let zkušeností v business developmentu, partnerships, B2B sales, product partnerships, platform businessu nebo podobné komplexní roli. Prokazatelnou zkušenost s vedením partnerství od prvního kontaktu až po dlouhodobý provoz. Zkušenost s vyjednáváním obchodních podmínek a schopnost připravit i obhájit business case. Praktickou zkušenost s projektovým řízením a koordinací více týmů bez přímé řídicí pravomoci. Schopnost pracovat s daty, tabulkami a finančními modely. Základní technické porozumění integracím a produktovému vývoji. Nemusíš být developer/ka, ale musíš umět technické téma pochopit, rozebrat a dotáhnout. Zkušenost z fintechu, SaaS, payments, hospitality, retailu nebo podobného prostředí je výhodou. Osobnost a způsob práce Jsi samostatný/á, iniciativní a umíš si vytvořit vlastní plán práce. Přemýšlíš obchodně, ale rozhoduješ se na základě dat a návratnosti. Umíš být důsledný/á a dostatečně „pushy“, když projekt potřebuje posunout. Dokážeš vést jednání s externím partnerem i interně prosadit potřebné rozhodnutí. Umíš pracovat s nejasností, rozdělit komplexní problém na konkrétní kroky a dotahovat věci do konce. Komunikuješ jasně, věcně a přizpůsobíš styl různým stakeholderům. Nečekáš, až ti někdo předá hotový proces — umíš ho navrhnout, zavést a průběžně zlepšovat. Jazyky Plynulá čeština nebo slovenština. Dobrá pracovní angličtina pro jednání s partnery a spolupráci v rámci Teya Co nabízíme Seniorní roli s reálným vlivem na produkt, obchodní výsledky a další směr Storyous. Možnost vlastnit agendu od strategie a business case až po realizaci a měřitelný výsledek. Spolupráci s Commercial, Product, Engineering a Operations týmy v Česku i v rámci Teya . Hybridní režim práce a flexibilitu. Férovou fixní mzdu a motivující bonusovou složku. 26 dní dovolené a 3 sick days. Interní integrovaný Glean AI k vyhledávání informací v rámci celé společnosti s využitím nejmodernějších LLM Přístup k Elredo audioknihovně BenefitPlus kartu Pravidelné týmové setkání v Praze a prostředí, kde se očekává iniciativa, otevřenost a odpovědnost. Proč právě Storyous a Teya ? Storyous je součástí Teya — technologického partnera lokálních podniků v Evropě. Naším cílem je zjednodušovat každodenní provoz našich zákazníků prostřednictvím integrovaného softwaru, plateb a služeb, které jim pomáhají růst. V této roli budeš mít příležitost ovlivnit, s kým Storyous spolupracuje, jaké služby zákazníkům nabídne a jak se tyto služby obchodně i produktově promítnou do našeho řešení. Je to role pro člověka, který nechce pouze spravovat existující vztahy, ale chce vytvořit fungující systém propojující partnerství, integrace a růst merchant base. Náborový proces Proces chceme držet rychlý a férový. V jednotlivých kolech se potkáš s lidmi, kteří budou hodnotit zejména: schopnost rozpoznat a vyhodnotit obchodní příležitost; kvalitu uvažování o partnerském a integračním modelu; schopnost vést komplexní iniciativu napříč týmy; způsob vyjednávání a práce s externími stakeholdery; schopnost převzít ownership a dotahovat výsledek.
