As part of our expert team, you’ll have the opportunity to ensure operational excellence that makes a real difference in organizational performance. As Associate Director CTM, you will manage a team of clinical staff and managers across several countries or a geographic area who are responsible for achieving the final clinical deliverable (usually clean data from evaluable patients as specified in the study protocol) within the time, quality, and cost expectations. You may represent the department in cross-functional initiatives that enhance business objectives. What You’ll Do: •Manages staff, which may include interviewing and selection, job description preparation, professional development, goal setting, performance management, coaching and mentoring, employee counseling, and separations. Approves courses of action on salary administration, hiring, corrective action, and terminations. Reviews and approves time records, expense reports, requests for leave, and overtime (if applicable). •Ensures the timely execution of clinical deliverables with a focus on quality deliverables. Supports staff to develop and drive specific and overall project/program strategies to ensure optimum performance by achievement of annual plans and targets. Holds regular project review meetings with staff to identify potential clinical and financial project risks, ensuring contingency plans and solutions are in place, and appropriate, timely escalations are conducted. •Liaises with cross functional leaders to drive clinical deliverables. •Oversees the effective project management of clinical budget, forecasting and resourcing. Ensures maintenance of profitability by ensuring clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management and guidance to staff. Interprets and analyses data on complex issues and independently make good business decisions. •Supports the allocation of staff to projects through global resourcing process and manages escalations for resourcing needs. Evaluates out of scope work and assists with contract modifications as needed. Focuses workload assignments to ensure effective project allocation, optimize collaboration with stakeholders, cultivate talent, and promote staff retention by implementing actions and communications aimed to motivate and engage. •Manages and conducts induction/orientation programs for all new employees, ensuring their smooth assimilation into the company. Provides ongoing training as needed to ensure staff mastery of systems and procedures. •Ensures all direct report CVs, training records and experience profiles are complete and up to date. •Reviews and ensures compliance with SOPs/WPDs/company procedure training and any other subjects that impact on clinical development. May contribute in the development of SOPs and WPDs as needed. •May participate in cross functional / departmental projects or initiatives as needed. •Drives a culture of immediate action and proactive escalation including early escalation to present solutions to risk, effective interaction with stakeholders, and effective management of general quality risk. Effectively escalates quality issues, requests QA audits as appropriate, and facilitates client and internal quality assurance audits as required. •May provide input into bids and contribute to the procurement of new business where required Education and Experience Requirements: •Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification •Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 10+ years). •5+ years of management responsibility •Proven leadership skills In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: •Excellent & effective mentoring/leadership/supervisory skills •Effective organizational and negotiation skills; effective at multi-tasking •Superior interpersonal skills and proven ability to be creative in problem solving and conflict resolution •Capable of utilizing problem-solving techniques applicable to constantly changing environment •Experienced in motivating, integrating individuals/teams, inducting, coaching and teaching direct reports •Capable of effectively and proactively managing and coaching employees with performance issues •Proven record to proactively direct and promote teamwork in a multi-disciplinary and/or multi-cultural team setting •Expert knowledge of clinical trials in releveance to regulations and guidelines e.g. ICH/GCP, FDA guidelines, etc •Excellent ability to evaluate medical research data, demonstrate proficient knowledge of medical terminology and therapeutic areas •Proficient knowledge with company practice and processes to provide guidance and direction •Proficient in using company tools to ensure oversight of financial management of projects for direct reports as well other tools needed to manage the timelines and quality of the data •Strong attention to detail •Competent use of computer and company systems to manage performance •Strong attention to detail, ability to synthesisze and communicate complex information •Strong knowledge of English language & grammar with effective written and oral communication skills Working Conditions and Environment: •Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment. •Occasional drives to site locations, frequent travels both domestic and international. Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Data Infrastructure (Nice to have): Experience with distributed storage or large-scale databases. Low-level Debugging (Nice to have): Instincts for troubleshooting at kernel, network and hardware level. Communication: Strong communication with product teams and stakeholders. Languages: Fluent in English (written and spoken); French is a plus. [Location: à confirmer avec Anthony. Does hearing phrases like “Yes, but we’ve been doing it this way for years...” make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists. 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically. 🏃‍♂️ You’re looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. title: Territory Account Executive - Life Sciences | Luma
description: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics , a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. What do we need We are seeking a high-impact Territory Account Executive to drive new logo growth across the Life Sciences industry. Territory is primarily Northern California and includes geography west of the Mississippi. This is a pure hunter role with enterprise scale opportunity. You will own your territory end-to-end — identifying whitespace, generating pipeline, and closing strategic SaaS platform deals. You will also leverage the global footprint, executive relationships, and industry penetration of Siemens to open doors and expand opportunity scope. This is not transactional selling. This is consultative, transformational enterprise selling — engaging R&D, IT, Digital, Engineering, and C-suite leaders around digital transformation and industrial digital thread strategy. If you thrive on building markets, creating demand where budgets may not yet exist, navigating complex, multi-threaded buying committees and leveraging ecosystem relationships to unlock enterprise access, this role is for you. You’ll have the opportunity to close strategic opportunities of 500k - 1M+ ACV selling the world’s most comprehensive scientific R&D platform. This is a rare chance to combine the agility of a high-growth SaaS platform with the global power of a €70B industrial technology leader. In this role you will Own and Build Your Territory: Develop and execute a strategic territory plan across Life Sciences accounts, drive disciplined new logo acquisition and build pipeline through outbound prospecting, ABM, executive alignment, industry events, and Siemens co-selling opportunities Lead Complex Enterprise Sales Cycles: Engage stakeholders across R&D, IT, Engineering, Digital Transformation, and the C-suite, Build ROI-driven business cases for enterprise data platforms and AI-enabled workflows. Navigate multi-stakeholder negotiations and procurement environments. Close high-value, platform-level SaaS deals Leverage the Siemens + Dotmatics Digital Thread Position Dotmatics ’ scientific R&D platform within the broader Siemens digital enterprise strategy Align conversations across R&D, engineering, manufacturing, and product lifecycle teams Collaborate with Siemens Digital Industries Software sales teams to expand account penetration Unlock opportunities across multi-division industrial enterprises Sell Strategic Transformation: Translate complex scientific and industrial data challenges into clear business value, position AI-enabled R&D, automation, data harmonization, and digital thread strategies and move discussions from lab workflows to enterprise transformation Be the Voice of the Market: Partner with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to drive long-term growth. Provide insight into industry trends and competitive dynamics and identify expansion opportunities across Siemens’ broader portfolio footprint We are looking for people who have demonstrated 6+ years experience in growth/new logos across large territories, typically liaising/engaging with CxOs, R&D teams, and IT leaders—influencing multi-dimensional decision-making. You can demonstratea strong track record in new business growth of territories, enterprise SaaS sales, in the Life Sciences industry, selling data management, automation, or AI that sells to R&D, IT, and business stakeholders. The key skills we are looking for Proven Hunter: Demonstrated success landing new logos in large, complex territories Track record of enterprise SaaS sales into $1B+ organizations Experience closing 500K–1M+ ACV deals Scientific Domain Experience: Experience selling in biopharma, biotech and related life sciences environments Understanding of digital transformation initiatives across R&D and engineering Executive-Level Influence: Ability to engage cross-functional buying committees, comfortable leading conversations with R&D scientists, IT leaders, Digital Transformation heads, Engineering executives, and CxOs Platform & Transformation Mindset: Experience selling complex, unbudgeted solutions Comfort positioning enterprise data platforms, automation, AI, or digital thread strategies Ability to collaborate within a large enterprise sales ecosystem (Siemens + Dotmatics ) Strategic & Process-Oriented: Strong territory planning discipline, consistent pipeline generation, structured use of sales methodology and metric-driven. Bonus: Scientific or engineering background in life sciences, materials, chemistry, or related field. Total Rewards Dotmatics utilises a national market-based approach to base pay benchmarking and pay band development. The candidate's final starting pay is based on job-related skills, experience, job specific qualifications & location. In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details. Other Total Rewards Offered Medical, Dental, Vision, Insurance Health Spending Accounts Wellness Benefits (Mental Health Apps and Fitness Perks) Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance 401k Retirement Plan (with 4% company match; immediate vesting) Flexible Time off Plan (for US exempt employees) This is the range that we, in good faith, believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. Base Pay Range $119,000—$140,000 USD Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. title: IT GRC Analyst
description: Business Unit: Information Technology Industry: No Industry Overview Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com. About the Team We believe that as we grow individually, we also grow as an Information Technology team allowing us to contribute to the overall growth of Houlihan Lokey. We embrace challenges and try new things, always looking for ways to improve. We deliver technology products and services enabled everywhere, so business can happen anywhere. We like where we work, who we work with, and what we do. We cultivate a culture where we all thrive. Description: IT governance, risk, and compliance sit at the center of how Houlihan Lokey protects client trust and operates as a global financial institution. As a GRC Analyst, you help ensure that the technology powering the firm's business runs on a foundation of strong controls, sound risk management, and continuous regulatory readiness — work that matters more with every new regulation, threat, and client expectation the industry takes on. Working alongside a Lead GRC Analyst and reporting to the IT GRC Manager, you will support governance, risk, and compliance efforts spanning frameworks such as GDPR, DORA, and Sarbanes-Oxley, partnering with internal and external auditors and control owners across the enterprise. It's an ideal opportunity for someone with 2–3 years of GRC or IT audit experience who wants to build a career at the intersection of technology, risk, and financial services, inside a team that will invest in your growth from day one. Key Responsibilities: Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of IT governance frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements. Assist in identifying, evaluating, and tracking IT risks — including cybersecurity, data privacy, and operational risk — and contribute to risk mitigation plans that address identified vulnerabilities. Partner with HL Compliance to ensure IT systems align with regulations such as GDPR, DORA, and SOX, and other standards relevant to the financial services industry. Conduct assurance activities, including security assessments and issue management, and collaborate with IT teams to strengthen security compliance and the overall control environment. Plan and execute IT audits that evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, risk management, and governance processes, supporting remediation tracking under the guidance of the Lead GRC Analyst and IT GRC Manager. Prepare clear, well-organized reports and documentation on IT governance, risk, and compliance activities for review by team leadership. Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders — including auditors, regulators, and clients — on GRC-related matters, including timely, accurate responses to client security questionnaires. Support the development of IT governance and compliance training materials in partnership with IT, Compliance, and Audit teams. Contribute to vendor risk management, including assessing SOC reports and ISO certifications and applying a clear understanding of vendor risk tiering. Qualifications & Experience: Required Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, or a related field. 2–3 years of experience in IT governance, risk management, compliance, or IT audit, ideally within the financial services industry. Working knowledge of IT regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, DORA, and SOX, or comparable international standards. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and help mitigate risk effectively. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams. Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Progress toward, or interest in, professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, Security+, or equivalent. Familiarity with GRC or audit management platforms and tools. Awareness of NIST and COBIT frameworks. Strong Excel skills, including data management and functions such as VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, and XMATCH. Experience preparing materials for internal and external audit requests. Understanding of vendor risk management, including SOC report and ISO certification review. Soft Skills: Communicate with clarity and professionalism, balancing accuracy with approachability across a range of audiences. Bring a solutions-focused mindset, willing to go above and beyond to create positive outcomes. Demonstrate high emotional intelligence, staying calm, positive, and thoughtful in challenging situations. Approach work with curiosity and a growth-oriented mindset, continuously building GRC and technical expertise. Operate with a high degree of professionalism and dependability, with a commitment to the firm's mission and values. Stay comfortable working with AI-enabled GRC, audit, and analytics tools, using them to streamline risk assessments, control testing, and reporting. Bring curiosity to new technologies, proactively identifying opportunities to automate or streamline governance, risk, and compliance workflows. We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Senior Responsible AI Researcher
description: Description We are seeking a visionary, highly accomplished Senior Responsible AI Researcher to lead state-of-the-art research initiatives at the intersection of frontier models, Trust & Safety (T&S), model evaluation, and adversarial robustness. In this role, you will bridge deep academic rigor with practical, real-world AI safety challenges. You will drive self-initiated research, design evaluation methodologies for emerging risks (e.g., persuasion, manipulation, sycophancy, agentic safety), and build safety benchmarks across Generative AI modalities (Text, Image, Multimodal, and Autonomous Agents). You will also serve as a key technical authority collaborating directly with top-tier AI labs, academic institutions, and enterprise partners. Key Responsibilities 1. Frontier AI Safety & Evaluation Research Design, build, and deploy new evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and "Agentic Safety Gyms" to measure model capabilities, vulnerabilities, and alignment across diverse risk domains (e.g., Hate Speech, Misinformation, Elections Preparedness, IP/Copyright, Child Safety). Develop advanced adversarial prompting methodologies, red-teaming strategies, and behavioral suites to stress-test Large Language Models (LLMs), Multimodal systems, and AI Agents. Investigate emerging safety risks, including model persuasion, manipulation, sycophancy, bias, and jailbreaking tactics across multimodal and autonomous architectures. 2. Research Leadership & Outbound Impact Lead high-impact collaborative research projects with external academic institutions (e.g., Oxford, Harvard, MATS, GovAI) and industry partners (e.g., OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Anthropic, Microsoft, Nvidia). Represent the organization as a thought leader and speaker at top-tier international conferences, technical AI safety summits, and industry events. Publish groundbreaking research findings in top AI and safety venues. 3. Strategic Client & Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market (GTM), Policy and Delivery teams to translate research discoveries into scalable safety products, client-facing offerings, and delivery methodologies. Engage directly with technical stakeholders and enterprise clients to translate complex safety and governance requirements into actionable research questions, experiments, and evaluation suites. 4. Mentorship & Team Augmentation Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior researchers, data scientists, and engineers. Bridge interdisciplinary gaps by integrating social science, policy, and technical perspectives into robust safety tooling and methodologies. Requirements Must Haves: ﻿Education & Track Record PhD in Science, Technology and Society Studies (STS), Machine Learning, AI Ethics, Social Data Science or a closely related research domain. Proven Research Record: Demonstrated academic excellence with a strong portfolio of peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations at top-tier venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, IEEE, CVPR, or dedicated AI Safety conferences). Technical & Domain Expertise Deep Domain Expertise: Substantial experience in AI Safety, Responsible AI (RAI), Trust & Safety, or Model Evaluation. Technical Mastery: Strong hands-on capabilities in Python and modern ML/DL frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Transformers). Generative AI & Agentic Systems: Deep working knowledge of foundation models (LLMs, Text-to-Image, Multimodal), agents, reasoning systems, and current safety mitigation techniques. Benchmarking & Methodology: Proven experience in designing datasets, benchmark suites, red-teaming protocols, or synthetic simulation platforms. Mindset & Soft Skills Ownership & Self-Starter Attitude: Proven track record of self-initiating research projects, bringing in external partnerships, and shaping technical vision. Communication & Engagement: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, executives, and research peers. Cross-Disciplinary Versatility: Ability to operate comfortably across technical data science, social science paradigms, and product execution. ﻿Preferred / Desirable Qualifications Prior employment, consulting, advisory, or formal research collaboration with frontier AI labs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta AI) or leading safety research collectives (e.g., MATS, GovAI). Experience in domain-specific safety applications, such as election integrity, psychological manipulation, or agentic behavioral safety suites. About Alice Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines. In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection. Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms. If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you! Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Data Scientist
description: Hello. We’re Teya . Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better. They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business. Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work. We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand. If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you Data Scientist Your Mission We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Credit & Analytics team at Teya and help build the models that underpin our lending products. You will support the development of the credit risk and pricing models that help us make better decisions for the small businesses we serve across multiple geographies. You will work across the model lifecycle, from data exploration and feature development through to deployment and performance monitoring. Working alongside senior data scientists, you will learn how to develop models in a statistically sound way and see first-hand how they shape credit decisions, pricing and portfolio performance. You will collaborate with Credit Strategy, Analytics, Product, Engineering and Data Engineering, building your understanding of how data science creates real business value. From day one, your work will contribute to live products used by our Members. This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their data science career, with a quantitative background and a genuine interest in credit and lending, who wants to learn fast in a high-growth fintech. Responsibilities Model development: Build and test components of credit risk and pricing models, under guidance from senior team members. Data exploration: Explore internal and external data sources, clean and prepare real-world datasets, and engineer features that could improve our models. Analysis: Carry out analysis of merchant behaviour, repayment performance and product performance to answer well-defined business questions. Model monitoring: Help track model performance, flag changes or drift, and support investigations into what is driving them. Model deployment: Support Data Engineering with deploying models onto the ML Platform and integrating them into the credit decisioning system. Documentation: Document your work clearly so models and analysis are easy to understand, review and build on. Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering and Credit Strategy, and actively seek feedback from senior data scientists to develop your technical and commercial skills. Requirements Early in your data science career, with some experience in data science, quantitative analysis or a related field (including internships, research or substantial academic projects). Degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline. A grounding in statistics and an understanding of core machine learning techniques. Working knowledge of Python and SQL, with experience handling and analysing real-world datasets. Ability to explain analytical work clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Curious, pragmatic and commercially minded, with a desire to understand how models drive business outcomes. Eagerness to learn, take on feedback and grow within a collaborative team. Exposure to credit risk modelling or financial services is a plus. The Perks Hybrid working: 4 days in our Central London office and 1 day from home. You choose which day you work from home, and you can change it whenever you need to. We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long as it suits both you and your team. Physical and mental health support through our partnership with WellHub, giving free access to over 1,500 gyms in the UK, 1-1 therapy, meditation sessions, and digital fitness and nutrition apps. Our company offers extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices, giving employees more flexibility and support. Cycle-to-Work Scheme. Health and Life Insurance. Pension Scheme. 25 days of Annual Leave (plus Bank Holidays). Office snacks every day. Friendly, comfortable, and informal office environment in Central London. Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Alliance Partner Manager (SaaS) | Luma
description: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics , a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. What do we need We are seeking an Alliance Partner Manager to lead the technical dimension of our alliances and partnering function for Luma, our AI-Native Multimodal Research Platform for Scientific Intelligence. Sitting at the intersection of business and engineering, you'll own how our platform connects with, integrates into, and creates value alongside the products of our strategic technology partners, such as Databricks and AWS. This position is based in EMEA, working globally across time zones, with potential future expansion of channel partnerships into NAM. It is a senior role with broad scope, where you'll act as the bridge between partner engineering teams and our own product, engineering and commercial organizations, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales, as well as colleagues at Siemens, with room to design and build the technical alliance capability around you. While the focus is strategic, this remains a hands-on role: you'll need enough technical depth to scope integrations credibly, validate them in sandboxes, and hold your own in a conversation with a partner's engineering team. We're looking for someone with an engineering-minded, "application scientist" type approach — comfortable understanding the technical requirements involved in onboarding a partner, and operating confidently within a large company mindset and environment. In this role you will get to: Define, build, and execute the technical partner strategy, prioritising which integrations and joint solutions to build, developing and implementing joint go-to-market plans (co-sell, co-build, co-deliver), aligning teams and facilitating sales enablement and training of partners. Own engineering level relationships across partner organisations through effective communication, structured governance and business reviews, and joint business planning. Scope integration feasibility early in partner conversations, translating vague partner asks into clear, buildable technical specifications and setting realistic expectations. Oversee solution architecture, use-case mapping, partner product certification and sandbox / proof-of-concept development to design and validate joint solutions. Engage partners to develop differentiated solutions through joint collaboration, market and competitive analysis, and the creation of joint marketing collateral. Evangelise partnerships internally, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales stakeholders, and with colleagues at Siemens, feeding partner needs into the roadmap and organising collaborative events. Define, track and analyse key partnership metrics, collaborating with partners to optimise performance, and represent Dotmatics /Siemens at alliance and partner conferences and events. Focus specifically on systems integration partners, bringing on partners that will meaningfully increase the bottom line. We are looking for candidate's who have 7+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, solution architecture or pre-sales engineering, including several years leading strategic technical partner or ISV relationships at enterprise scale. You've built integrations, not just managed them, and you can move fluently between a business review and a whiteboard session with a partner's engineers. You're comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy on complex, ambiguous pursuits, and you set realistic expectations that engineering can actually deliver on. Just as importantly, you lead through influence. You can align engineering, marketing and sales teams, internally and across partner organisations, behind a shared plan without direct authority, and you're motivated by building a partnering function and team, not just running one. While not a traditional "sales" person, you're comfortable navigating sales-style conversations, combining technical knowledge with strong relationship management and communication skills. Key Skills: Technical partnership leadership - a proven track record defining and executing partner or alliance strategy with ISVs, technology platforms or system integrators, with measurable partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue impact. Hands-on integration fluency, including practical depth with APIs, authentication and data-exchange patterns, and the ability to scope, spec and validate integrations through sandboxes and proof-of-concept builds. Joint go-to-market execution - experience developing co-sell, co-build and co-deliver plans, aligning internal and partner teams, facilitating sales enablement and creating the collateral that makes joint solutions land. Executive-level relationship management - comfort owning senior stakeholder relationships across partner organisations, running structured business reviews (QBRs), and resolving conflict constructively when internal and partner priorities clash. Data-driven partner management, with the habit of defining, tracking and analysing partnership KPIs and leading indicators of partner health and acting on them before issues escalate. You may also have: Experience with cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) or OEM / embedded partnership motions. Experience structuring and negotiating complex commercial and technical agreements alongside legal teams. Familiarity with tiered partner certification programmes. A background or interest in scientific, life-sciences or research software, or another domain-deep industry such as Oil & Gas or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG). Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Scientist - Translational Safety & Risk Sciences (TSRS)
description: Job Title: Senior Scientist - Translational Safety & Risk Sciences (TSRS) Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States|South San Francisco, California, United States|Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States|Thousand Oaks, California, United States Job Location Type: Remote Job Contract Type: Full time Job Seniority Level: Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. Senior Scientist – Translational Safety & Risk Sciences (TSRS) What you will do Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead efforts to develop and integrate modern data infrastructure, analytics platforms, and visualization capabilities to support New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) and broader translational safety initiatives across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of discovery biology, nonclinical safety, NAMs, and translational medicine, requiring strong technical expertise combined with scientific curiosity and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally. You will partner closely with scientists across Amgen and data engineering groups to develop a scalable, connected, and insight-driven data ecosystems for NAMs, upon which AI/ML can be applied, that will accelerate decision-making across Amgen Research. Although this position sits within TSRS, the position will have a Research-wide reach. title: UI/UX Designer
description: What we're building We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams. Why join Shadow? Product Ownership You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions. Shape the Engineering Culture You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring. Work with Challenger Consumer Brands Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue. The agency behind the product Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo. This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST). The role You’ll own features end-to-end at Shadow, from the first conversation with a user to the polished screen in production. You’ll design in Figma and in code, and ship it yourself. You’ll work forward-deployed. You’ll sit with the subject-matter experts who use Shadow every day, like media buyers, strategists and creatives, to learn how they actually work and where they get stuck. Then you’ll turn what you learn into features that fix it. You’ll also keep Shadow feeling like one product. As new features land, you’ll make sure every screen, from dashboards to agent conversations, follows the same system and meets the same bar. Core Tech & Tools Languages & Frameworks: Python, Node.js, React (TypeScript) Datastore: PostgreSQL Cloud & Infra: Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes ML/AI: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering What you'll do Own features end-to-end: find the problem, shape the solution, then design, build and ship it. Embed with subject-matter experts to learn their workflows and challenges firsthand. Turn what you learn into product: agent conversations, performance and creative dashboards, the marketing calendar, and whatever comes next. Own UI/UX consistency across the whole app. Keep the design system current in Figma and React, and hold every new screen to it. Sweat the details, including type, spacing, motion, loading and empty states. Prototype fast, in code, in Figma or with AI tools, and put ideas in front of experts within days. Invent interaction patterns for agentic work. That means streaming answers, showing the agent’s reasoning, approving changes before they touch a live ad account, and admitting when data is missing. Turn dense, multi-channel data into screens a marketer can read in seconds. Bring the new Shadow brand into the product, working with our brand partners. Must haves Shipped product UI you’re proud of, plus a portfolio or live work that shows both the design and the code. Strong React, TypeScript and CSS (Tailwind a plus). You can own a frontend codebase, not just individual components. Real visual and interaction design skill: typography, layout, color, motion and micro-interactions. Curiosity about how other people work. You can spend a day with a media buyer and come back with the real problem, not just a feature request. A systems mindset. You notice when two screens solve the same problem differently, and you fix it. Equal comfort in Figma and in your editor, and the judgment to know when to skip Figma. Taste for data-dense interfaces. Your dashboards, tables and charts stay calm under a lot of information. Daily use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, with opinions on how AI products should feel. Comfort with ambiguity. You’d rather ship and learn than polish in private. Clear writing. You can explain the why behind a design to engineers, experts and non-designers. Most people who fit this have 5+ years across design and some experience with frontend engineering. Nice to haves Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing work, or research with expert users. You’ve built a design system that other engineers rely on. Data visualization work in D3, Visx, Recharts or hand-rolled SVG. Motion work, such as spring animation or Framer Motion. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming interfaces or agent products. Time spent around marketing, ecommerce or analytics tools, or running ads yourself. What we offer Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp. Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain. Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition. Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every employee exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry. Equal Opportunity Statement We are an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: National Bankruptcy Processor
description: Purpose The National Bankruptcy Processor is responsible for protecting the client’s interest by reviewing loans for possible legal action and taking all necessary actions to protect client’s interest without individual requests from the client. Specific Duties, Activities and Responsibilities Motions for Relief: Specialist will prepare referrals for Motions for Relief and assist firm with any figures and documents required to proceed with the necessary legal action. Specialist will be required to review delinquent accounts and case disposition to determine appropriate action to take. Accounts must be audited and a ledger must be prepared to ensure all funds were received and applied correctly. Loan must be reviewed until the Motion is resolved. If a Stipulation is negotiated, specialist will be required to monitor compliance with the Stipulation and refer additional legal action as necessary. Impediments: Specialist must review loans immediately upon receipt for any items needed to proceed with account adjustments or legal action. Specialist will refer to jurisdictional requirements to confirm what items are required to proceed with required legal action. Frequent follow up and escalation for impediments is required until resolution. Specialist will have to be comfortable reviewing prior servicer histories and escrow analyses. Title Review: Specialist must be able to review mortgages, assignments, notes and allonges and determine any missing gaps in the chain of title. ECF Mail/AACER: Specialist will be required to review electronic mail from the court. All mail must be thoroughly reviewed and notated in firm’s system and client’s system. Specialist must be able to determine and proceed with any action needed in response to court mail received. Ensure local counsel has all necessary information to complete various notices and filings. Move all non-active files quickly through to closing. Review and interpret client systems and update data per client’s expectations. This role entails a comprehensive review of pre-foreclosure documents, onboarding documents, as well as the utilization of MSP, AIQ, and other internal systems. It is imperative to ensure the legal validity and compliance of foreclosure actions, while also identifying and addressing any potential impediments that may arise during the pre-foreclosure process. The primary function of this position is to guarantee that all impediments are resolved in a timely manner pre-foreclosure. Effectively resolving these impediments may necessitate direct communication with attorneys, clients, or internal staff, ensuring that any legal or procedural barriers are addressed promptly and proficiently. This role is critical in maintaining the integrity of the foreclosure process and ensuring that all necessary steps are taken to facilitate a smooth transition through the pre-foreclosure phase. Specific Duties, Activities and Responsibilities Document Review: Thoroughly review and confirm the loan origination documents to ensure accuracy and compliance. MSP (Mortgage Servicing System): Thoroughly review and confirm the data within the MSP system to ensure its accuracy and reliability. AIQ (Document Repository): Review, download, and confirm the loan documents. Quality Control Review: Review and complete a QC sheet per loan. Case Management: Maintaining and organizing case files, tracking deadlines, and ensuring all necessary documentation is submitted in a timely manner. The Paralegal I will ensure all deadlines are met, maintain workloads and process flow within the team, and distribute workloads as necessary. Communication and Collaboration: Responding to various emails, providing accurate and timely information, and maintaining client systems with current information regarding the onboarding process. Compliance Monitoring: Ensuring all activities adhere to internal policies, state laws, and federal regulations. Review of Financial Documents: Reviewing payoff statements, payoff histories, and previous monthly statements to ensure accuracy and completeness, addressing any discrepancies as needed. Issue Escalation and Support: Escalating any issues as needed and assisting with the training of new paralegal staff. Job Requirements Bachelor’s Degree Preferred or Paralegal Certificate 5+ years of default law experience Strong knowledge of AP foreclosure process Understanding of judicial and non-judicial foreclosure processes Previous default industry experience Analytical document review capabilities Able to respond appropriately to constructive feedback from management. Self-starter with exceptional ability to identify and solve problems. Ability to recognize changing environments and think analytically. General Competency Factors Must be proficient in software tools, including but not limited to Word, Excel, Outlook, and the Internet. Must possess strong written and verbal communications skills. Must provide excellent customer service to internal and external customers Identifies and solves issues in a timely manner. Must be a team player and willing to help others in their department whenever necessary. Must be extremely organized and be able to multi-task. Conscientious with respect to work completion, deadlines, time management and attendance. Takes initiative in face of obstacles and identifies what needs to be done and takes action. Demonstrates commitment to Firm’s vision, mission, and core values. Analytical and detail oriented, while working at a fast pace and capable of multi-tasking. Develops professional relationships and builds rapport with others. Overall good work ethic and willingness to adapt to change. Originally posted on Himalayas

Perhaps you were a scientist, engineer, or R&D leader who has since moved into commercial sales — that path is welcome here. In this role you will get to : Lead Territory & Named Account Strategy : Own the design and execution of a segmented go-to-market approach across EMEA — balancing territory coverage with focused, strategic named accounts across life sciences/pharma, specialty chemicals, CPG, F&B, F&F, and energy. Direct how the team allocates coverage and effort across this segmentation. Instill a repeatable, metrics-driven sales methodology and hold the team accountable to it. Translate the value of Data Science & Analytics, AI, and agentic/orchestration capabilities into compelling narratives for scientific, operational, IT, and executive audiences. Solution Selling with Impact : Coach your team to go beyond the software and solve critical business and scientific challenges — ensuring pitches are customized to resonate with scientists, plant and quality leaders, IT, and C-suite stakeholders across multiple industries. Pipeline Generation Powerhouse : Direct pipeline-building efforts across multiple personas within each account, leveraging an established global user base, ABM, cold outreach, warm referrals, partner-sourced leads, and events. Ensure the team has the coverage and tools to execute consistently. Negotiation & Closing Excellence : Support and unblock complex, multi-national negotiations from discovery to signature, helping the team navigate organizational and procurement complexity to secure high-value, 7-figure+ deals. Strategic Account Management : Build trust and long-term partnerships across named accounts, ensuring solutions align to both scientific/technical goals and broader operational and business objectives. Collaborate Across Siemens : Work closely with the broader Siemens Digital Industries Software organization — including adjacent business units, industry verticals, and shared account teams — to bring the full weight of the Siemens portfolio to bear on customer challenges and expand deal scope. Leverage Partners & Channels : Working with our Partners & Channels leader to build and activate relationships with systems integrators (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, TCS) and technology partners (e.g., AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Snowflake, GCP) to extend reach, accelerate deal cycles, and co-sell into strategic accounts. description: Vaan is a Shopify Platinum design & technology agency and the home of Brand Conversion Design. It requires someone who can walk into a complex merchant environment, understand how systems connect, identify friction, and turn that into a requirements picture engineering and design can build against. We value specificity over generalism, forward-thinking over comfort with the status quo, and partners over vendors. marketing, and ops functions, and turn what surfaces into documentation the full team can act on Translate ambiguous business needs into scoped functional and technical requirements, including an explicit account of what is out of scope and why Decompose requirements into epics and stories an engineer can pick up without a follow-up conversation, working alongside the Product Owner to keep the backlog accurate as the engagement moves Maintain the requirements record page by page and section by section, covering features and functions, metafields, and the apps in play, with every line traceable to scope Work with Tech Leads to document architecture, data flows, and business rules, and to validate feasibility and scope before requirements become commitments Build and maintain the discovery frameworks and templates the rest of the team works from Translate what a client asks for into what they actually need, then identify the tool that serves it, with reasoning legible to the client, engineering, and the account team Maintain working awareness of what is already implemented across our portfolio, so recommendations build on existing stack decisions instead of duplicating or contradicting them Evaluate third-party tools across loyalty, search, reviews, personalization, subscriptions, and headless commerce, knowing each category well enough to ask the right questions and judge honestly Recognize when someone else on the team knows a tool better than you, and pull them in early Track Shopify platform updates, deprecations, and roadmap signals, and translate what changes into client guidance Advise on stack composition with a focus on long-term maintainability, scalability, and cost Map complex client environments across ERPs, PIMs, OMS platforms, CRM systems, and marketing stacks, including how they connect and where Shopify fits Identify integration requirements, data flows, and failure points before they become project risks Audit existing Shopify implementations for technical debt, architectural gaps, and unused platform capability, and articulate what should change and why Understand how AI works inside the apps our clients already run. Most of the ecosystem is adding AI features across search, merchandising, personalization, support, and retention. The question is never whether the feature exists. It is whether turning it on moves a business objective this client actually has Hold a working read on where AI creates genuine value in ecommerce and where it is noise, and be able to explain the difference to a client without hedging Identify where AI-enabled tooling could improve conversion, retention, or operational efficiency for a client, and build the case Use AI in your own delivery work: drafting specs, scripting audits, analyzing rulesets, reconciling data, roughing out wireframes to move a conversation along Work as a peer to Growth Strategists. You are the reason a commercially attractive roadmap item is deliverable, or the reason it gets reshaped before it is promised to a client Contribute technical context to scoping and estimation that makes the numbers more accurate Keep engineering, design, and the account team working from the same requirements picture, and surface the conflict early when they are not Qualifications A track record of picking the right tool for a specific client context and being able to defend the choice to both the client and the engineers who have to live with it Working familiarity with Shopify Plus across admin, metafields, theme architecture, and B2B, enough to reason about what is possible without needing to build it Understanding of headless and composable architectures, and of when they are the wrong call Comfort saying you do not know a tool well, and a habit of finding the person who does A track record of leading discovery on complex digital projects, with documentation habits that survive contact with a deadline Ability to run stakeholder sessions that surface the real requirements, meaning what clients actually need rather than what they say they want Experience writing requirements engineering can execute against with minimal ambiguity, and breaking them down to a granularity a developer can pick up Experience holding requirements for several clients at once without context bleeding between them Exposure to platform migration from Magento, BigCommerce, or Salesforce Commerce Cloud to Shopify Plus Working comfort in Figma or FigJam, Jira, and Excel. You don't need mastery. You should be able to run a session on a canvas, author a story, and keep a structured requirements sheet clean Experience evaluating AI features inside tools a merchant already pays for, rather than only standalone AI products, and judging whether switching one on is worth the change Comfort with rapid change. You update your position when the evidence warrants it, and you say so out loud Confident in client-facing environments, able to ask hard questions diplomatically and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders Able to propose a compromise a client will accept, an engineer will respect, and the account team can still deliver inside the SOW Strong written communication. Your requirements documents, briefs, and follow-ups are clear and trusted by the people who use them Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Contract / Remote)
description: About EnrollWise EnrollWise is a leading enrollment management platform trusted by major U.S. school districts. We deliver robust, secure, and scalable solutions built on a modern tech stack, including Python/Django with Graphene for GraphQL APIs, Next.js (React + TypeScript), PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery for task queuing, and cloud-based infrastructure with dynamic horizontal scaling using AWS services like ECS, Fargate, S3, and CloudWatch. We're committed to innovation in education technology, powering seamless integrations with third-party services like Twilio, SmartyStreets, Census, ArcGIS, and Student Information Systems. Role Overview We're seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to audit our current infrastructure and Python/Django application, provide expert recommendations, and guide the transition to a shared tenant (multi-tenant) architecture. Our existing DevOps team handles day-to-day operations, but we need your specialized expertise in high-availability, high-traffic systems to optimize for peak enrollment cycles and ensure enterprise-grade performance as we scale. This position is a contract role and can work remotely anywhere in the US. Collaboration with our team during US business hours is required. Key Responsibilities Conduct a comprehensive audit of our AWS-based infrastructure (including ECS, Fargate, Terraform IaC, CloudWatch/Sentry monitoring, and disaster recovery setups) and Python/Django application to identify scalability, performance, reliability, and security gaps. Recommend and implement best practices for high-availability architectures, fault-tolerant mechanisms, and elastic scaling to handle high-traffic scenarios without downtime. Design and set up a shared tenant instance model, ensuring data isolation, independent scaling per tenant, and compliance with security standards. Facilitate load testing processes to identify performance optimization opportunities. Collaborate with our engineering team to enhance CI/CD pipelines, automate deployments, and integrate observability tools for proactive monitoring and alerting. Qualifications 7+ years of DevOps experience, with proven expertise in building and optimizing high-availability, high-traffic applications (e.g., handling peak loads in SaaS environments). Deep knowledge of AWS services (ECS, Fargate, S3, CloudFront, WAF, CloudWatch) and Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform. Familiarity with Python/Django ecosystems, including GraphQL (Graphene), task queues (Celery), and databases (PostgreSQL, Redis). Experience designing multi-tenant architectures with emphasis on isolation, scalability, and security. Expert knowledge of containerization (Docker), monitoring/anomaly detection. Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to communicate technical recommendations clearly. Prior consulting or auditing roles in fast-growing startups or enterprise environments. Why Join Us? Make a meaningful impact on education by enhancing a platform that serves millions of students and families. Flexible part-time schedule. Fully remote. Competitive hourly rate commensurate with experience. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Technical Architect- Remote, India
description: This is a remote position. We are seeking a Technical Architect with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including proven experience architecting and delivering production Generative AI systems. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on command of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and Agentic architectures with the judgement to design AI solutions that hold up under real enterprise constraints of cost, latency, security, and compliance. This role owns the technical architecture of AI engagements end-to-end: shaping the solution during discovery and pre-sales, defining reference architectures and integration patterns, selecting models and platforms, and guiding delivery teams through implementation. You will work directly with client stakeholders, product managers and engineering leads, and will help set the technical standards of our AI practice. This is a senior, hands-on architecture role rather than a purely advisory one. This role owns multiple concurrent AI engagements from discovery through production. Beyond technical architecture, the Technical Architect is expected to act as a trusted advisor to clients, lead engineering teams, mentor future technical leaders, and drive engineering excellence through hands-on involvement. Requirements Responsibilities Own the end-to-end architecture of GenAI solutions across the retrieval, orchestration, model, integration, and deployment layers. Translate ambiguous business problems into AI solution designs with clear scope, feasibility assessment and success metrics. Define reference architectures, design patterns and reusable accelerators for RAG, agentic workflows and LLM integration. Lead model and platform selection, documenting the cost, latency, accuracy and data-residency trade-offs behind each decision. Design the non-functional envelope: scalability, latency budgets, availability, observability and inference cost control. Architect data and retrieval pipelines covering ingestion, chunking, embedding strategy, vector store selection and hybrid search. Define evaluation strategy and guardrails so accuracy, groundedness, safety and hallucination rates can be measured and governed. Embed security, privacy and compliance into the design: PII handling, tenancy isolation, access control and audit. Support pre-sales and discovery through solution workshops, effort estimation, technical proposals and client presentations. Guide delivery teams, run design reviews and mentor engineers, while staying hands-on in prototyping and unblocking hard problems. Maintain architecture documentation and decision records, and assess which advances in generative AI are ready for enterprise adoption. Own multiple client engagements simultaneously while maintaining delivery quality. Lead discovery workshops, challenge assumptions, and refine business requirements into technically sound solutions. Push back on unrealistic timelines, architectures, or requirements using engineering judgement and data. Build strong relationships with Team, product owners, and executive stakeholders. Mentor senior engineers and cultivate future architects and technical leaders. Lead architectural governance, design reviews, and technical decision records. Set engineering standards, coding guidelines, AI development best practices, and review critical code. Remain hands-on by building prototypes, solving difficult technical problems, and contributing production-quality code when needed. Drive cross-project reuse through internal frameworks, accelerators, and reference implementations. Present architecture, trade-offs, risks, and implementation strategy confidently to executive audiences. Essential Skills Job 10+ years in software engineering, data or AI roles, including at least 3 years in an architect or technical lead capacity. Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering production Generative AI systems, not only prototypes or POCs. Strong hands-on Python, with the ability to prototype designs and review production code. Deep expertise in LLM application architecture: prompt and context engineering, structured output, tool calling and orchestration. Proven experience designing RAG systems end-to-end, including chunking, embedding selection, hybrid retrieval and re-ranking. Proven ability to manage multiple enterprise AI programs simultaneously. Strong client-facing consulting experience with executive communication. Excellent presentation, whiteboarding, and workshop facilitation skills. Demonstrated experience influencing technical decisions across multiple teams. Experience managing senior engineers and mentoring future technical leaders. Strong engineering judgement balancing quality, cost, delivery timelines, and business value. Comfortable making architectural decisions with incomplete information. title: Senior Microsoft AI Engineer - Copilot, Foundry & Power Automate
description: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives. Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results. Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team. The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate. You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products. Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve. Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control. We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry. Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively. Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries. Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery. Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems. Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them. Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs. Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions. Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections. Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows. Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures. Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions. Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure. Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria. Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication. Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership. Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer. Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget. Required Qualifications Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate. Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows. Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs. Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output. Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting. Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms. Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling. Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell. Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement. Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub. Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions. Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration. Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication. Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors. The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result. Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget. Especially Valuable Experience Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment. Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access. Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps. Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control. Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search. Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security. Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions. Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain. Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership. Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity. Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice. Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years. Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment. What We Offer A fully remote role with a long-term perspective. Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery. The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team. Close collaboration with startup leadership. Varied projects with practical business impact. Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops. Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment. Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work. Please submit your CV and a short overview of: A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results. A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures. A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed. A project you managed or a team you led or mentored. Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors. Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential information or credentials. Originally posted on Himalayas
