Job Description This is a technical role responsible for executing the design, building, testing, and implementation of security systems across our environment, with a specific emphasis on endpoint security and mobility. You will work closely with other members of the Information Security team to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities and develop strategies and solutions to mitigate these risks, securing the end-user device estate and the mobile platforms through which the enterprise increasingly operates, and contributing to our overall information security strategy. This position can be virtual anywhere in the U.S. You will join the Business Technology Solutions (BTS) Information Security and Risk Management (ISRM) Architecture organization. Our team translates business objectives and cyber risk strategy into concrete security measures — processes, technologies, and services — across a diverse and complex infrastructure landscape, including on-premises, cloud, and X-as-a-Service models. Responsibilities: Define and evaluate security architecture for the end-user device estate — workstation and laptop hardening, EDR/endpoint protection (e.g., CrowdStrike, Defender), data protection, and configuration baselines. Advise on mobility security: MDM/UEM (e.g., Microsoft Intune), mobile application management, conditional access, and BYOD posture across iOS and Android. Perform Security Architecture Reviews — adjudicate submissions, align the risk and controls with the system owner, and ensure review quality. Deliver Security Architecture Consulting engagements with business partners — own each engagement end to end, with timely turnaround and clear customer communication. Provide Risk Evidence Review on request, partnering with Risk Management to evaluate control and mitigation effectiveness for risk owners. Plan, design, build, and implement enterprise security architecture, and create relevant documentation of same. Evaluate security technologies and controls across the environment — including those employed by third-party providers — developing strategies, determining which controls fit a given situation, and adapting them to business needs, risk, and the threat landscape. Identify and communicate current and emerging security threats and risks; design security architecture elements and propose new or revised measures to mitigate them as they emerge. Help develop solutions that balance information security needs with the needs of the business, in collaboration with team members and business and IT stakeholders. Be fluent with AI concepts and incorporate AI into your daily workflows — using AI to accelerate design reviews, threat modeling, documentation, and analysis — targeting improved efficiency, quality, and speed. Create reusable security-architecture artifacts — reference architectures, design patterns, security guidelines, and security positions — that scale the team's expertise beyond one-off engagements. Identify recurring problems and build durable systems, patterns, and standards that solve them at the root — not only technical problems, but process and people problems too — so the same issue does not keep resurfacing. Support training and mentorship of more junior employees as well as employees outside the Information Security Team, as needed. Qualifications Required: Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of experience OR Master's Degree and 7 years of experience OR PhD and 3 years of experience. Demonstrated proficiency with security controls and concepts. Working knowledge of security frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST, CIS Controls, OWASP, Cloud Security Alliance). Advanced knowledge of operating systems, networking protocols, systems administration, and security technologies. Advanced knowledge and application of cybersecurity terminology and concepts, and foundational understanding of the cyber threat landscape and attack vectors. Understanding of risk management principles and the ability to integrate them into security practices. Capable of learning new concepts and processes quickly and adapting to a constantly changing environment. Fluency with AI concepts and demonstrated use of AI tools to improve how you work. Demonstrated critical thinking, problem solving, and analytical skills. Strong organizational skills with attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills with a high level of professionalism. Ability to work independently and effectively as part of a team. Willingness to be available, as needed, for major and critical security issues. Demonstrated skills and experience in the following tools: Endpoint protection and detection (EDR/EPP), data protection, and configuration-baseline tooling. Mobile device and endpoint management (MDM/UEM, e.g., Microsoft Intune), mobile application management, and conditional access. Operating systems, networking protocols, systems administration, and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure). Security control frameworks and the cyber threat landscape and attack vectors. AI tools and AI-assisted workflows to drive speed and quality. Collaboration and documentation platforms (ServiceNow ITSM, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft 365 / SharePoint) Preferred: Professional cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, SANS/GIAC, etc.) are highly desirable. title: FSP Clinical Trial Coordinator
description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Join Us as a Clinical Trial Coordinator – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years. The Clinical Trial Coordinator (CTC) assists in the coordination and administration of the study activities from the start up to execution and close out, and within the Local Study Team (LST) to ensure quality and consistency of interventional study deliverables to time, cost and quality objectives. CTCs might have different internal titles based on the experience level (CTC, Senior CTC). The experience level depends on the years of experience, performance record, level of independence to execute, ability to take on additional tasks or tutor more junior colleagues. The Director, Country Head may assign this internal title after confirmation with Senior Director, Cluster Head / Executive Director, Regional Head. Typical Accountabilities Assists in coordination and administration of clinical studies from the start-up to execution and close-out. Collects, assists in preparation, reviews and tracks documents for the application process. Assists in timely submission of proper application/documents to EC/IRB and, where appropriate to Regulatory Authorities for the duration of the study. Interfaces with Investigators, external service providers and CRAs during the document collection process to support effective delivery of a study and its documents. Serves as local administrative main contact and works closely with the CRAs and/or the LSAD for the duration of the study. Operational responsibility for the correct set-up and maintenance of the local eTMF and ISF including document tracking in accordance with ICH-GCP and local requirements. Ensures essential documents under their responsibility are uploaded in a timely manner to maintain the eTMF “Inspection Readiness”. Ensures that all study documents are ready for final archiving and completion of local part of the eTMF and supports the CRA in the close out activities for the ISF. Contributes to the production and maintenance of study documents, ensuring template and version compliance. Creates and/or imports clinical-regulatory documents into the Global Electronic Management System (e.g. ANGEL) ensuring compliance with the client Authoring Guide for Regulatory Documents. Contributes to electronic applications/submissions by handling clinical-regulatory documents according to the requested technical standards i.e., Submission Ready Standards (SRS), supporting effective publishing and delivery to regulatory authorities. Sets-up, populates and accurately maintains information in client tracking and communication tools (e.g. CTMS such as VCV, SharePoint, etc) and supports others in the usage of these systems (with the exception of countries where there is a specific role dedicated to set up and update the systems). Prepares and/or supports contract preparation at a site level (with the exception of countries where there is a specific role dedicated to preparing site contracts). Prepares/supports/performs Health Care Organisations (HCO)/Health Care Professionals (HCP) payments in accordance with local regulations. Manages and contributes to coordination and tracking of study materials and equipment. Coordinates administrative tasks during the study process, audits and regulatory inspections, according to company policies and SOPs. Leads the practical arrangements and contributes to the preparation of internal and external meetings e.g., study team meetings, Monitors’ meetings, Investigators’ meetings. Liaises with internal and external participants and/or vendors, in line with international and local codes. Prepares, contributes to and distributes presentation material for meetings, newsletters and websites. Responsible for layout and language control, copying and distribution of documents. Supports with local translation and spell checks in English to/from local language, as required. Responsible for printing and distribution of documents such as letters and meeting minutes, and for handling and archiving of study/country related e-mails. Interfaces with Data Management Centre and/or Data Management, Global Clinical Solutions representatives to facilitate the delivery of study related documents/material. Ensures compliance with client’s Code of Ethics and company policies and procedures relating to people, finance, technology, security and SHE (Safety, Health and Environment). Ensures compliance with local, national and regional legislation, as applicable. Additional country-specific tasks might be added depending on local needs. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Director, Market Growth Strategy, Molecule to Market (Biologics)
description: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics , a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research. We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. What do we need We are looking for an experienced market leader, thought leader and SME in Biologics Biologics research is where molecular therapeutic discovery begins. Scientists are discovering and engineering proteins, antibodies, bispecifics, and other large molecule formats, then deciding which candidates are worth taking forward. They run huge numbers of experiments across assays, instruments, and teams. The data is rich but often not well organized, and the best candidates can get lost in the noise. Good decisions here shape everything that comes after. We’re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. Biologics research is a core part of our Molecule to Market story. We need someone to own the market strategy for it. This is a customer and market facing role. You’ll spend real time with biologics research leaders at pharma, biotech, and academic and government institutes, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You’ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to this market with confidence and one consistent story. Your job is to drive software adoption and AI use cases in biologics research. You will shape where we play, who we sell to, how we position, and how we win. How you’ll spend your time Customer engagements: meeting research leaders and scientists, joining pursuits, and bringing what you hear back to the business Market analysis: sizing segments, tracking competitors, and spotting trends early Sales enablement: giving teams across regions the talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and proof points to win Solution marketing: partnering with the Siemens Solution Marketing team on content, campaigns, events, and messaging for the biologics research audience Thought leadership: working with industry thought leaders, inside and outside Siemens, to shape the conversation on AI driven discovery and the future of the research lab Adoption and AI use cases: identifying, proving, and spreading the use cases that get scientists using Luma and putting AI to work on their data Cross organization alignment: working across Siemens DISW and DI Automation teams so we show up as one company with one story for the biologics research market The goal is simple. Drive excellence in how we represent ourselves to biologics research buyers, and turn that into real software adoption. What you’ll do Own the market growth strategy for Luma in biologics research, including antibody discovery, protein engineering, lead optimization, and developability Define target segments, buyer personas, and priority accounts, including Heads of Biologics Research, Discovery Biology, Protein Sciences, Antibody Engineering, Research IT, and Lab Automation Build positioning and messaging that speaks to bench scientists, research leaders, and executives Drive software adoption by working with customers and field teams to find the workflows where Luma delivers value fastest, and by capturing what works so others can repeat it Define and prove AI use cases for biologics research, including how scientists prepare, trust, and use their data with tools like NVIDIA BioNeMo Translate research pain points into clear value, including faster design, build, test, and learn cycles, better capture of experimental context, easier sharing of data across teams, and cleaner handoffs into development Partner with the Siemens Solution Marketing team to build content, campaigns, and events for the research market Work with industry thought leaders, analysts, and partners to build credibility and bring outside voices into our story Create the competitive view against other informatics vendors, point solutions, and in house builds Develop the business case, pricing inputs, and value story with Finance and Sales Equip global teams with talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and customer proof points Partner with DISW and DI Automation teams to align messaging, joint offers, and customer conversations Partner with Product on roadmap priorities based on what research teams tell us Connect biologics research to the bigger Molecule to Market narrative, including ELN, Lab Orchestration, and Biologics registration Support strategic pursuits and executive conversations with customers and partners Track market trends, including AI driven discovery, autonomous labs, lab automation, and data analytics, and turn them into action We are looking for people who have 10 or more years in life sciences, with hands on biologics research experience in a pharma, biotech, or research institute setting. You wiil bring Strong analytical skills, including sizing markets and building a business case, excellent writing and presentation skills, and ideally hold a degree in biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, or a related field. Advanced degree strongly preferred, and a PhD is a plus The key skills Deep understanding of how biologics discovery works day to day, including target validation, antibody and protein engineering, expression and purification, assay development, screening, characterization, and candidate selection Knowledge of how research leaders make decisions, balance speed and quality, and work with development, automation, and data science teams Familiarity with ELN, LIMS, registration systems, or assay data platforms Experience in product marketing, market strategy, product management, or commercial roles at a software, informatics, or life sciences solutions company A track record of driving software adoption, or of turning new technology such as AI into use cases customers actually adopt Proven ability to turn complex science and technology into clear, simple messaging Comfort working with senior leaders, industry experts, and customers Ability to work across a large, global, matrixed organization and build trust with teams in different regions and business units Nice to have Experience running or supporting a biologics discovery team Experience with lab automation, high throughput screening, or self driving lab concepts Experience with AI, machine learning, or data platforms in a scientific setting Existing relationships with industry thought leaders, analysts, or research institutes Prior time at a biotech or in a discovery organization at a large pharma What success looks like A clear biologics research market strategy adopted by Sales, Product, Services, and Solution Marketing Messaging and sales tools that teams around the world actually use One consistent story for biologics research across Dotmatics , DISW, and DI Automation Growing software adoption and a library of proven AI use cases in biologics research Industry voices who help tell our story Growing pipeline and wins tied to biologics research Research leaders who can say, in their own words, why Luma helps their scientists find and advance better molecules faster Total Rewards Dotmatics utilises a national market-based approach to base pay benchmarking and pay band development. The candidate's final starting pay is based on job-related skills, experience, job specific qualifications & location. In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition. Base Pay Range $185,000—$256,000 USD Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR (Required) Native app design specialism, with proven experience designing with Liquid Glass on iOS 26+ and/or iPadOS 26+ . This must be clearly stated on your CV. Advanced Figma mastery: Auto Layout, components, variants, component properties, variables, styles and libraries High attention to detail and visual rigour, with a strong eye for discrepancies in layout, spacing, typography, colour, iconography and behaviour Solid web and app interaction design background: responsive behaviour, platform conventions and states (loading, error, empty, success, unavailable) Strong analytical and documentation skills, so you can describe issues clearly and constructively for designers and developers Systematic, organised thinking to keep screens, journeys and shared files consistent across teams Working knowledge of digital accessibility, to flag issues and guide future decisions Autonomy and clear communication: you manage your own workload, resolve ambiguity and escalate what needs validation Fluent English (written and spoken) NICE TO HAVE (Preferred) Previous experience building, contributing to or maintaining a Design System, beyond consuming one Compensation: €1,800 – €2,500/month net, depending on experience and seniority level. title: Solution Architect
description: About the Company: Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences. Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us! About the Role: The Solution Architect plays a critical role in guiding customers through their AI adoption journey — from discovery and architecture design to implementation and go-live. You will serve as the technical leader and trusted advisor in customer engagements, owning the solution blueprint and ensuring seamless delivery. This is a customer-facing, hands-on architecture role requiring deep technical expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms, cloud-native solutions, and multi-tenant architectures, as well as strong communication skills to present solutions to senior stakeholders (CIOs, CTOs, VPs, and Directors). Responsibilities Customer Engagement & Advisory: Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and architecture reviews with enterprise customers. Translate business challenges into scalable, secure, and cost-effective solution designs. Present high-level architecture and roadmaps to executive stakeholders in a clear, concise, and consultative manner. Build strong relationships as a trusted technical advisor to customer leadership teams. Solution Architecture & Design: Define and document solution architectures leveraging tech stacks (Java, Python, Kafka, Spring Boot, MySQL, Redis, Docker, and AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, IAM, Lambda, etc.). Design and validate multi-tenant SaaS architectures addressing scalability, reliability, security, and compliance. Recommend integration patterns (APIs, microservices, event-driven) for seamless enterprise adoption. Ensure solution designs align with Netomi ’s product roadmap and best practices. Implementation Leadership: Own the technical delivery of customer solutions, from PoC through production rollout. Collaborate with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to implement and optimize solutions. Provide guidance on CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, observability, and performance tuning. Lead solution validation, testing, and customer onboarding activities. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Support pre-sales and RFP processes by crafting technical proposals and architecture decks. Partner with Customer Success and Account Management to ensure long-term adoption and satisfaction. Mentor engineers and solution consultants on architectural best practices and customer engagement. Requirements 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise consulting roles. Proven expertise with Java, Python, Spring Boot, MySQL, Redis, and microservices-based architectures. Strong experience in AWS infrastructure (ECS, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM, networking, scaling strategies). Hands-on knowledge of Docker, containerized deployments, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience building or implementing multi-tenant SaaS solutions in B2B environments. Excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills, with experience engaging CXOs and senior leadership. Ability to lead technical discussions, influence decisions, and drive alignment across business and engineering teams. Preferred Skills Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, or conversational AI platforms. Knowledge of Kafka, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch for distributed data processing and search. Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, etc.), and identity management (OAuth, SSO). Exposure to large-scale B2B SaaS solution design in customer support, contact center, or AI-driven automation domains. Collaborative startup culture with the scale and reach of enterprise SaaS. Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits. Continuous learning and growth opportunities in Generative AI and SaaS solution architecture. Cutting-Edge Technology: Work with advanced LLMs, agent orchestration, and multi-channel automation. Career Growth: Opportunities to expand into leadership, specialization (AI, integrations), or product strategy roles. Collaborative Culture: Work closely with engineering, product, and customer success in an environment that values innovation and execution. Global Reach: Shape solutions that operate across continents, languages, and industries. title: Coordinateur Financier des Programmes H/F
description: Nous recrutons actuellement un(e) Coordinateur(trice) Financier(ère) des Programmes pour rejoindre notre équipe Finance. Il s'agit d'un poste en télétravail, ouvert aux candidats basés dans l'un des pays d'intervention de Relief International , idéalement dans un fuseau horaire compris entre le Royaume-Uni et la Jordanie, avec jusqu'à 20 % de déplacements internationaux. À propos de Relief International Relief International est une organisation humanitaire internationale qui travaille aux côtés des communautés touchées par les conflits, les catastrophes et le changement climatique afin de sauver des vies, renforcer leur résilience et améliorer durablement leur bien-être. Présente en Afrique, en Asie et au Moyen-Orient, elle met en œuvre des programmes de santé, nutrition, WASH, éducation et moyens de subsistance en partenariat avec des acteurs locaux. À propos du poste Le/la Coordinateur(trice) Financier(ère) des Programmes assure le pilotage financier et la conformité des portefeuilles financés par les bailleurs, tout en apportant un appui stratégique aux équipes pays en matière de budgétisation, gestion des subventions, suivi financier et gestion des risques. Vos responsabilités Le poste comprend notamment les responsabilités suivantes : Agir comme partenaire financier principal des bureaux pays assignés et fournir un appui financier stratégique tout au long du cycle des programmes et des financements. Piloter la revue financière et l'élaboration des budgets de propositions, notes budgétaires, méthodologies d'allocation des coûts et soumissions aux bailleurs, dans le respect des exigences de conformité et de rentabilité. Apporter une expertise financière lors des décisions Go/No-Go en évaluant les opportunités de financement, les risques, le recouvrement des coûts et la faisabilité opérationnelle. Assurer le suivi de la performance financière des portefeuilles à travers les analyses budget/réalisé, les prévisions financières et le suivi du pipeline, tout en recommandant les actions correctives nécessaires. Soutenir les bureaux pays dans la préparation des budgets pluriannuels et des prévisions de financement afin d'identifier les écarts de financement et les opportunités de croissance. Garantir le respect des réglementations des bailleurs, des politiques internes et des procédures financières relatives aux subventions, financements et partenariats. Contribuer aux revues de portefeuille, aux discussions sur les programmes pays et aux processus de gestion des financements en apportant des analyses financières pertinentes. Appuyer les audits, les actions de mitigation des risques, les clôtures de subventions et le suivi des recommandations d'audit. Renforcer les capacités des équipes pays par la formation, le mentorat et l'accompagnement en matière de conformité bailleurs, de gestion financière et de budgétisation des subventions. Votre profil Vous disposez de l'expérience et des compétences suivantes : Diplôme en Finance, Comptabilité, Administration des Affaires ou domaine connexe. Expérience confirmée en finance de programmes, gestion de subventions et financements bailleurs au sein d'ONG internationales. Maîtrise de la conformité bailleurs, de la budgétisation, du suivi financier et du reporting. Bonne connaissance des exigences financières des principaux bailleurs institutionnels. Expérience dans l'accompagnement des équipes Finance et la collaboration avec les équipes Programmes, Subventions et Partenariats. Excellentes capacités d'analyse pour identifier les risques et améliorer la performance financière. Très bonnes compétences de communication en anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Maîtrise avancée d'Excel et des systèmes de gestion financière ; la connaissance d'Oracle NetSuite est un atout. La maîtrise de l'arabe constitue un avantage. Date limite de candidature 16 octobre 2026 Originally posted on Himalayas
